newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_1: The Citadel is the economic center of our planet. The higher level, the more Cubits we can collect.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_2: Our economic center recovered, now let's try the Collection.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_3: Battles aren't going to get easier, we need a stronger fleets, which the Engineering Hub can make it. Lets get it back online right now!
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_4: The basic measure to improve fleet strength is to enhance your equipment. Making sure that your Commander level equals your equipment level helps a lot. Enhance it at once!
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_5: Our defense network has found signs of pirates within our planets vicinity - lets wipe them out.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_6: We've defeated Scout Fleets, it's time to sort them out! Destroy the Scout Captain!
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_7: We've defeated Scout Fleets, it's time to sort them out! Destroy the Scout Captain!
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_9: Construct the Celestial Portal to unlock and recruit more powerful fleets, Commander.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_10: Lyon: the former commander of Lawsry District who left the Star District after retiring. Well acquainted with Sylver.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_11: We need to ensure safety of our star zone. Attack the pirate stronghold and take out their patrols.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_12: Dexter is an old geezer on our planet, he invented Galaxy Slots.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_14: We have discovered the location of Priate Main Force, defeat them at once!
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_15: Our fleets are not strong enough to defeat the Priate Captain, we can upgrade our fleets through Rush Priate Main Force.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_16: Although we don't have much information, we know that Duyal is the leader of pirates within the vicinity. Rumors indicate that he used to be commander of the fleet directly affiliated to the Emperor.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_17: Duyal reported our name to Arena. Let's give him an example of our true strength.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_18: The security situation is much better now, but  Expedition Force Fleets appear around Star District. Before find the patrol flagship we need to defeat the Pratrols.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_19: As was expected, their flagship is right there, done with them!
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_20: The rebel patrol has been destroyed, and the flagship is vulnerable. Let's strike!
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_21: The rebel patrol has been destroyed, and the flagship is vulnerable. Let's strike!
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_22: Here's the new invention of Dexter, it's a Mine Machine which can help boost our economy.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_23: The remaining fleet is retreating, catch them!
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_24: The remaining fleet is retreating. Perhaps we can find some clues as to what happened - let's start with their leader.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_25: Unfortunately, we weren't able to find any useful information from rebel mayor. Defeat the rebel commander right now!
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_26: We have a lot to learn in the Conservatory, including valuable plans on weapon development. Lets get it back online.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_27: Conservatory restore completed, let's challenge the elite boss!
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_28: The battle to reclaim the 7th Spaceport begins, first step - defeat the Rebel Task Force, find their commander and finish them!
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_29: Battles becoming more and more difficult, we need a stronger fleets, plans acts a big role in evolving our equipments.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_30: We can move onto the second stage of battlefield recapturing after destroy the rebel guard fleet. Defeat  the 2nd Lieutenant as soon as possible!
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_31: The Empire cut down their supply rations suddenly, fortunately Greenspan can help us. Let's construct a Diplomacy Center.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_32: Rebels have taken control of the 7th Spaceport. We need to destroy them if we want to recapture the Spaceport, now defeat Task Force Commander！
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_33: Rebels have taken control of the 7th Spaceport. We need to destroy them if we want to recapture the Spaceport, now defeat Raider Commander!
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_34: Good news! Our Galactonite Center is ready. Our fleet strength stands to make great gains.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_35: O'Neal is said to be among the most skilled rebel commanders out there. Let's find out if what they said is true. And then defeat him.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_36: The 5th Fleet are right there, wipe them out right now!
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_37: We've entered the zone controlled by rebels. No choice but to go forward and fight, Commander. Defeat the commander of the 5th fleet.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_38: The 5th Fleet still fight for the last chance, don't let them get away!
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_39: Congratulations, victory is in sight! Defeat the rebel's 5th fleet commander.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_40: The main force were defeated, the remaining are all elite fleets, be careful!
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_41: The Empire will no longer support us - we're on our own. We stand to gain an edge if we destroy the core of the rebel's 5th fleet now, though.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_42: Damon is a well known rebel general. And he's fair-minded, nobody knows why he appears here, among the rebels.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_43: Time to upgrade our Engineering Hub, Commander. The higher the level of our Engineering Hub, the stronger we can make our equipment.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_44: This arsenal is currently protected by a small rebel guard which shouldn't present too much of a challenge for us. Let's take them out.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_45: Defeat the guard commander to take over the arsenal that he's defending, Commander.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_46: To ensure that we keep up combat chops up, we should participate in arena battles. Not just to make sure that our skills stay sharp, but also to collect the spoils of war that are waiting for us, Commander.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_47: The enemy surrounding the arsenal has been defeated. Let's keep the pressure on and defeat the guard commander to take control as soon as possible, Commander.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_48: Gonzalo is a senior rebel general who's famous for his unshakable will and faith.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_49: Commander, we'll need a steady supply of resources if we want to keep Star District safe and active. Let's have our Diplomats get on this.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_50: An unknown force has attacked the imperial military parade and caused major damage. Let's strike back immediately and without mercy.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_51: Our allies have been attacked and struck down in cold blood. We need to find out who did it and strike back.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_52: That attack hurt, badly. Don't forget to upgrade the Citadel to keep our economy strong.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_53: Rebels have killed our allies and people of the empire. They'll pay for what they've done.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_54: We cannot allow the rebel commander to get away.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_55: If we're going to take revenge, we'll need to improve our military strength. Let's upgrade the Engineering Hub, Commander.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_56: We'll break down the rebel defense before taking out their leader, Commander. Let's locate and take him out.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_57: Well done, Commander. Our next target is Raikkonen.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_58: Our plans are proceeding without incident so far. Upgrade the Research Lab to ensure that we increase our combat capacity, Commander.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_59: The enemy that we currently face is the rebel's 18th fleet. First, let's take out the 18th fleet commander.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_60: Lattice is a rebel senior military officer who possesses undying concern for troops under his command. He's also known to be as temperamental as he is protective.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_61: Although Lattice has joined our fleet, he remains unconvinced. Let's challenge him in the Conservatory to make sure we get him on our side, Commander.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_62: An unknown fleet has attacked us, Commander. It seems that they're shooting to kill. Take out their leader and find a way to escape.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_63: The commander of the unknown force is the last thing standing in our way. Take him out!
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_64: A win in the galaxy arena will surely give everyone a taste of our true strength, Commander.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_65: There's no doubt that the rebel fleet possesses strength, Commander. In their own words, they call it a "Carat Mixed Fleet". Whatever they call it, let's destroy it.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_66: Assar is the leader of the rebel group known as "Son of Kara". He looks well-meaning, but we have our doubts, Commander.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_67: Although we've taken out Assar, it's also necessary that we locate and eliminate our own combat weaknesses. Defeat Elite Assar.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_68: Too many unknown adversaries make combat difficult. If we want to protect our people, we need to strike at the head of unknown forces which oppose us.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_69: This fleet doesn't seem to be under human control. The same rules apply though, Commander: locate their commander and take him out.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_70: The alien ships have been defeated, Commander. Rest easy. Let's get an arena victory to further boost morale.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_71: The alien fleet has suddenly retreated, Commander. Let's seek them out and strike to gain what could be a valuable position.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_72: Our next target: the unknown force commander.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_73: This one's for our economy, Commander. Upgrade the Citadel to level 9.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_74: Defeat the officer of the guard. How could such a desolate place have a Spaceport on it? Whatever. Defeat the officer here and lets move on.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_75: It's surprising to see rebels here, to say the least. Defeat the commander of this guard, Commander.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_76: Our failure has proven that we aren't strong enough, yet. Upgrade the Engineering Hub to increase our fleet power.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_77: The Empire's intelligence agency has located the Apostle's stronghold. Our first task is to investigate and attack, if necessary. Attack anyone who poses a threat to us, Commander.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_78: We've located a clue, Commander: there seems to be an unusual ship among their fleet. Attack and capture it, and let's find out what's going on here.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_79: We're headed for the Empire's Science Academy, Commander. We won't be able to avoid combat, so let's enhance equipment 3 times in preparation.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_80: Aliens have appeared, as expected, but it seems that they're calling themselves "The Sentry". Let's show them who we are.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_81: Something is strange about these enemies, Commander. Don't let them escape.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_82: These fights won't get easier, Commander. Let's take advantage of the Galactonite Center and see how we can put it to use.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_83: An alien fleet has emerged within the orbit of the Science Academy. They are out for blood. Be careful, Commander.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_84: We're gaining the edge, Commander. Deal the final blow!
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_85: We need a stronger fleet, and Warp Energy will help. Collect some, Commander.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_86: The enemy will never stop attacking, Commander. Let's proceed.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_87: A bizarre adversary has emerged. We don't know who they are, but they're about to know who we are.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_88: The imperial fleet suffers from low morale, Commander. They need a victory badly. Show them what victory means in the arena.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_89: The leader of the Ronea Star District is within our grasp. Take him out!
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_90: Only the destroyer commander remains. Show no mercy, friendly forces are depending on us.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_91: The battle before fully proved the strong power of the enemy. Try every means to defeat the elite destroyer in Miliary Academy.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_92: The enemy fleet attempt to destroy our planet. We mush handle an head-on attack to them! Tell them who has the final say! Kill their military governor!
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_93: The enemy's flagship is exposed. Kill them off!
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_94: The enemy retreated. And we should seize time to strengthen our economy. Upgrade Citadel to level 10.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_95: The same as before, they want to attack our compatriots! We can't let them succeed. Kill the military governor!
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_96: The military governor is dead. The next is their flagship!
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_97: Good job! It's time to upgrade Research Lab to level 10.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_98: The enemy must convoy something of value. Defeat their flagship and make certain what it is.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_99: The rebel takes refuge with the alien indeed. Sink their flagship as soon as possible.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_100: Should we win in the arena, the troop's morale would rise significantly. Go ahead and try!
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_101: According to the information in our hand the combined fleet of the enemy and the alien are here. Defeat their advisor.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_102: Strange enemy again. We can't treat them lightly before we make clear about their purpose. Defeat it!
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_103: The alien strength has surfaced. We should keep on reinforcing our military power. Upgrade Engineering Hub to level 11.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_104: The apostle launched attack to us. Kill their advisor!
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_105: Next is their commander to tell them human are not the fault of good.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_106: Compose Galactonite twice to see what's good in it.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_107: It's time to return our homeland peace from the alien! Let's start from their Nullifier Warlord.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_108: Until now we still know nothing about the alien but we need victory!
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_109: We are stuck in the planet. Collect WARP energy twice and warp more fleet here.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_110: The enemy launched new fleet which we call it Reaper as well as the rebel appearing. How they are actually friendly forces. Anyhow, the Reaper leader is our first target.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_112: The Lord Rasyon is not in the palace which is the reason that our economy has been cut off and fight alone until now. Disparch the affairs officer to ask for some resources and ask about some news.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_113: The affairs officer came back with resources as usual. But the enemy near us means Raphael's control of the empire is not that strict as we image. Let's focus to kill their officer.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_114: The fleet direct under Raphael is really with strong power. Seize time to defeat their commander. Maybe Raphael want to deliver some message to us.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_115: Since we openly broke up with Raphael we need to reinforce our fleet power much more. Enhance the equipment 3 times.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_116: Raphael, what a cunning guy, deployed the incomplete imperial fleet on the News Center. Now launch attack to the core of the sixth fleet -- Heavy Cruiser.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_117: The flagship of the sixth fleet has lost their protection. Defeat if and reduce unnecessary damage.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_118: The economy situation of the empire is not optimistic. We have to rely on ourselves. Upgrade Citadel to level 12.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_119: Matthias is looking for the Divine Will and cannot be disturbed. We should give them a preemptive strike and defeat the legion guard.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_120: Cassandra is the leader of the 9th aerocade team who owns excellent skiil and always challenge the senior pilot.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_121: This lively girl seems unwilling to submit. Defeat her in conservatory.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_122: The wrecked 13th fleet has been placed in the guard here. Defeat their leader.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_123: Sophietia is the captain of the 13th fleet and the sister of Cassandra. She is skilled at combat support.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_124: According to the battle before Cassandra didn't exert all her strength. Let's see how much ability she has inCONSERVATORY.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_125: How could Raphael deploy the second fleet of the empire to attack us. Destroy their destroyer which are the core of their battle
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_126: Du'doria is the officer of the empire.. But he doesn't have firm position and always follow the victory.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_127: As Du'doria don't take any stand we can show them who is the real victor with our strength.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_128: Matthias deployed his fleet to proceed a millitary exercise with us. It is said that Stargazer is very powerful. Defeat it. Don't make huame be shamed.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_129: Matthias is one of those apostles who first follow Divine Will to galaxy. And he is seeking Divine Will with the rebel.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_130: The battle data before is very useful. We need to improve more. Defeat elite Matthias.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_131: Matthias looks for Divine Will here. He cannot be disturbed. We should give them a preemptive strike. Defeat the legion guard.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_132: Matthias is still looking for it. Let's keep on attacking. Before that please upgrade Engineering Hub to 13.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_133: We are going to launch large-scale attack to the WARP port. Before that please upgrade Engineering Hub to level 13.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_134: Great! The defense here is weak. Defeat the Garrison Commander.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_135: Richter is the battleship commander of the seventh fleet and he is a warmonger.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_136: Richter joined us. But as usual we should show them our power. Defeat elite Richter.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_137: Richter launched mighty fleet to wipe us out. It seems Divine Judge is the breakthrough.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_138: Only one last obstacle left. Defeat it and we can excape from the dangerous condition. Defeat Divine Executors.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_139: It's the difficult battles that reveal our weakness, Commander. Let's upgrade the Research Lab.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_140: Raphael has made major strides toward increasing the strength of the forces under his command. Let's defeat the Repressor Captain.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_141: Well done, Commander. Only the Repressor Captain remains.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_142: Don't forget to keep improving the strength of our fleet, Commander. Compose Galactonite twice.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_143: Raphael has attempted to pin us in. A win for us here is crucial. Defeat the Repressor Commander.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_144: Batis is the 5th fleet captain, who believes in the power of authority above all else. She'll perform any duty asked of her, with no questions asked.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_145: We're into a new stage of battle, Commander. We'll need better equipment for it. Enhance equipment 3 times.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_146: Let's continue to put pressure on Raphael. Our current mission is to kill the Punisher Commander.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_147: The only defensive force in Star District is Vorsehung - take him out!
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_148: Raphael is even crazier than we thought - he's begun construction of the Death Star. Let's get in the arena and hone our skills, Commander.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_149: Prevent Raphael from attacking with the Death Star by taking out the Strangler Captain, Commander.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_150: It's too late, Commander, this star zone has been destroyed by the Death Star. We need to eliminate this threat before it's too late.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_151: Upgrade the Citadel to solidify our economy.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_152: In the name of his victims, eliminate the Strangler!
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_153: The Death Star - take it out!
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_154: Let's not waste any time upgrading the Engineering Hub. The existance of the Death Star presents a great threat to the entire galaxy.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_155: We can't be safe existing in the same galaxy as the Death Star. Destroy it.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_156: At last the commander of the Death Star becomes a target. Don't forget about all the innocent victims that lie in his wake, Commander.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_157: Time's running out, upgrade the Tech Lab post-haste!
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_158: The final battle looms ahead of us, Commander. Our target is the Arbiter Commander.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_159: Well done, Commander. Press forward and let's go after their leader.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_160: Galactonite really is a remarkable thing. Fuse Galactonite twice.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_161: Raphael's end is in sight, but obstacles remain. Take out Divine Lord.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_162: Raphael awaits, Commander. The end is near. All who value justice are hoping for our victory.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_163: It's all about tactics from here, Commander. Take advantage of the Conservatory to defeat Raphael.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_165: Should we win in the arena, the troop's morale would rise significantly. Go ahead and try!
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_167: Good job! It's time to upgrade Research Lab to level 16.
newquest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_169: Compose Galactonite twice to see what's good in it.

quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_1: The Citadel is the economic center of our planet. The higher its level, the more Cubits we can collect.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_4: Our defense network has found signs of pirates within our planets vicinity - lets wipe them out.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_5: Although we've defeated the pirate scouts, their main force remains. Lets make them regret their decision to mess with us, Commander.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_2: These fights aren't going to get any easier, Commander. We need a stronger fleet, which the Engineering Hub can provide. Lets get it back online as soon as possible.

quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_9: Duyal knows who we are, but not what we're capable of. Let's give him a taste of our true strength.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_10: Commander, we're taking major steps to improve our security but there are still Rebel forces around the Star District. We must find their patrol flagship and destroy it!
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_11: This battle presents a major threat to our safety and security. Making sure that our fleet emerges with more than 50% of its strength will be crucial, but fortunately for us, the Construction Yard can help with that.

quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_20: Improving fleet power is all about research, Commander. It's time for us to build a Research Lab.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_18: The battle to reclaim the 7th Spaceport begins here. The first step is to destroy the rebel guard fleet.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_19: We can move onto the second stage of recapturing the battlefield after the rebel guard fleet has been taken care of.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_21: As battle progresses, the financial gap between us and our adversaries grows wider. Let's upgrade our Citadel to bolster our economy.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_22: Rebels have taken control of the 7th Spaceport. We need to destroy them if we want to recapture the Spaceport, and that'll require sinking their commander.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_23: O'Neal is said to be among the most skilled rebel commanders out there. Let's find out if what they've told is true. And then defeat him.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_24: Our strength is derived from our research and development. Let's upgrade the Research Lab to increase our research capacity.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_25: We've entered the zone controlled by rebels. No choice but to go forward and fight, Commander. Defeat the commander of the rebel's 5th fleet.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_26: Congratulations, victory is in sight! Defeat the rebel's 5th fleet commander.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_28: Good news, Commander: our Galactonite Center is ready. Our fleet strength stands to make great gains.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_29: Our Galactonite Center has recovered and is fully functional. Let's see what we can gain from it.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_27: The Empire will no longer support us - we're on our own. We stand to gain an edge if we destroy the core of the rebel's 5th fleet now, though.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_30: Damon is a well known rebel general. It's said that his demeanor is that of a white knight though, so no one really knows why he's fighting for the rebels.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_31: Time to upgrade our Engineering Hub, Commander. The higher the level of our Engineering Hub, the stronger we can make our equipment.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_32: This arsenal is currently protected by a small rebel guard which shouldn't present too much of a challenge for us. Let's take them out.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_33: Defeat the guard commander to take over the arsenal that he's defending.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_34: To ensure that we maintain our combat chops, we should participate in Arena battles: Not just to make sure that our skills stay sharp, but also to collect the spoils of war that are waiting for us, Commander.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_35: The enemy surrounding the arsenal has been defeated. Let's keep the pressure on and defeat the guard commander to take control as soon as possible, Commander.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_36: Gonzalo is a Senior rebel General, famous for his unshakeable will and faith.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_37: Commander, we'll need a steady supply of resources if we want to keep Star District safe and active. Let's have our Diplomats get on this.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_38: An unknown force has attacked the imperial military parade and caused major damage. Let's strike back immediately and without mercy.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_39: Our allies have been attacked and struck down in cold blood. We need to find out who did it and strike back.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_40: That attack hurt badly. Don't forget to upgrade the Citadel to keep our economy strong.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_41: Rebels have killed our allies and people of the empire. They'll pay for what they've done.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_42: We cannot allow the rebel commander to get away.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_43: If we're going to take revenge, we'll need to improve our military strength. Let's upgrade the Engineering Hub, Commander.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_44: We'll break down the rebel defense before taking out their leader, Commander. Let's locate and take him out.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_45: Well done, Commander. Our next target is Raikkonen.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_46: Our plans are proceeding without incident so far. Upgrade the Research Lab to ensure that we increase our combat capacity, Commander.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_47: The enemy that we currently face is the rebel's 18th fleet. First, let's take out the 18th fleet commander.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_48: Lattice is a rebel senior military officer who possesses undying concern for troops under his command. He's also known to be as temperamental as he is protective.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_49: Although Lattice has joined our fleet, he remains unconvinced. Commander, let's challenge him in the Conservatory to make sure we get him on our side.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_50: An unknown fleet has attacked us, Commander. It seems that they're shooting to kill. Take out their leader and find a way to escape.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_51: The commander of the unknown force is the last thing standing in our way. Take him out!
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_52: A win in the galaxy arena will surely give everyone a taste of our true strength, Commander.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_53: The rebel fleet is undoubtedly strong, Commander. In their own words, they call it a "Carat Mixed Fleet". Whatever they call it, let's destroy it.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_54: Assar is the leader of the rebel group known as "Son of Kara". He looks as though he means well, but we have our doubts, Commander.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_55: Although we've taken out Assar, it's imperative that we identify and eliminate our own combat weaknesses. Defeat Elite Assar.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_56: Too many unknown adversaries make combat difficult. If we want to protect our people, we need to attack and defeat the head of the unknown forces that oppose us.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_57: This fleet doesn't seem to be under human control. The same rules apply though, Commander: locate their commander and take him out.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_58: Rest easy, Commander. Alien ships have been defeated. Now it's time for an arena victory to further boost morale.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_59: The alien fleet has suddenly retreated, Commander. Let's find them and strike to gain what could be a valuable position.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_60: Our next target: the unknown force commander.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_61: This one's for our economy, Commander. Upgrade the Citadel to level 9.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_62: Defeat the officer of the guard. How could such a desolate place have a Spaceport? Whatever. Defeat the officer here and lets move on.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_63: It's surprising to see rebels here, to say the least. Defeat the commander of this guard, Commander.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_64: Our failure has proven that we aren't strong enough, yet. Upgrade the Engineering Hub to increase our fleet power.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_65: The Empire's intelligence agency has located the Apostle's stronghold. Our first task is to investigate and attack, if necessary. Attack anyone who poses a threat to us, Commander.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_66: Commander, we found a clue: there seems to be an unusual ship among their fleet. Attack and capture it, and let's find out what's going on here.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_67: We're headed for the Empire's Science Academy, Commander. We won't be able to avoid combat, so let's enhance equipment 3 times in preparation.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_68: Aliens have appeared, as expected, but it seems that they're calling themselves "The Sentry". Let's show them who we are.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_69: Something is strange about these enemies, Commander. Don't let them escape.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_70: These fights won't get easier, Commander. Let's take advantage of the Galactonite Center and see how we can put it to use.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_71: An alien fleet has emerged within the orbit of the Science Academy. They are out for blood. Be careful, Commander.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_72: We're gaining the edge, Commander. Deal the final blow!
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_73: Commander we're in a new stage of the battle. We'll need better equipment for battle. Enhance your equipment 3 times.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_74: The enemy will never stop attacking, Commander. Let's proceed.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_75: A bizarre adversary has emerged. We don't know who they are, but they're about to know who we are.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_76: The imperial fleet suffers from low morale, Commander. They need a victory badly. Show them what victory means in the arena.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_77: The leader of the Ronea Star District is within our grasp. Take him out!
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_78: Only the destroyer commander remains. Show no mercy, friendly forces are depending on us.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_79: The last battle served to prove the immense power of the enemy! Use all possible means to defeat the elite destroyer in the Military Academy.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_80: The enemy fleet is attempting to destroy our planet. We must attack them head-on! Show them who has the final say! Kill their military governor!
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_81: The enemy's flagship is exposed. Kill them off!
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_82: The enemy retreated. We should take time now to strengthen our economy. Upgrade Citadel to level 10.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_83: The same as before, they want to attack our compatriots! We can't let them succeed. Kill the military governor!
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_84: The military governor is dead ! Now is the turn of their flagship !
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_85: Good job! It's time to upgrade Research Lab to level 10.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_86: The enemy convoy must have something of value. Defeat their flagship and see what it is.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_87: The rebels have indeed taken refuge with the aliens. Destroy their flagship as soon as possible.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_88: If we win in the arena, troop's morale will raise. Anyway go and try.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_89: According to the information at hand, the combined fleet of the enemy and the alien are here. Defeat their advisor.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_90: Strange enemy again. We can't treat them lightly before we make clear about their purpose. Defeat it!
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_91: The alien strength has surfaced. We should keep reinforcing our military power. Upgrade Engineering Hub to level 11.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_92: The apostle launched an attack on us. Kill their advisor!
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_93: Next is their commander to tell them human are not the fault of good.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_94: Compose Galactonite twice to see what's good in it.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_95: It's time to restore peace and take our homeland back from the aliens! Let's start with their Nullifier Warlord.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_96: There is very little information about the alien enemy, but we must be victorious!
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_97: Commander we're in a new stage of the battle. We'll need better equipment for battle. Enhance your equipment 3 times.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_98: The enemy launched a new fleet which we call the Reaper fleet. Also the rebels are now appearing, but they may actually be friendly forces. Anyway, the Reaper leader is our first target.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_100: Lord Rasyon is not in the palace which is why our economy has been cut off and and we've been left to fight alone until now. Dispatch the affairs officer to ask for some resources and gather new intel.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_101: The affairs officer came back with resources as usual, but nearby enemies show Raphael's control of the empire is not as strong as it appears. Let's focus on taking out their officer.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_102: The fleet directly below Raphael is very powerful. Let's seize this opportunity to defeat their commander. Maybe Raphael is trying to send us a message.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_103: Since we openly broke up with Raphael we need to reinforce our fleet power much more. Enhance the equipment 3 times.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_104: Raphael shrewdly deployed the incomplete imperial fleet on the News Center. Now launch an attack on the core of the sixth fleet -- the Heavy Cruiser.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_105: The flagship of the sixth fleet has lost its protection. Defeat it now and avoid unnecessary damage.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_106: The economic situation of the empire is not good. We have to rely on ourselves. Upgrade Citadel to level 12.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_107: It seems Raphael has taken control of the empire's 9th fleet and the military base's defenses. Defeat their lieutenant.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_108: Cassandra is the leader of the 9th aerocade team who owns excellent skill and always challenges the senior pilot.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_109: This lively girl seems unwilling to submit. Defeat her in the Conservatory.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_110: The wrecked 13th fleet has been placed in the guard here. Defeat their leader.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_111: Sophietia is the captain of the 13th fleet and the sister of Cassandra. She is skilled at combat support.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_112: According to the battle with Cassandra, she didn't exert all of her strength. Let's check her full potential in the Conservatory.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_113: How could Raphael deploy the second fleet of the empire to attack us? Destroy their destroyer, which is the core of their battle.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_114: Du'doria is an officer of the empire... but he doesn't have a firm position and is always hunting for glory.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_115: As Du'doria don't take any stand we can show them who is the real victor with our strength.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_116: Matthias deployed his fleet to proceed on a military exercise with us. It is said that Stargazer is very powerful. Defeat it. Don't allow humans to be shamed.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_117: Matthias is one of those apostles, who first followed Divine Will to galaxy. And he is seeking Divine Will with the rebels.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_118: The previous battle data was very useful. We need to collect more. Defeat elite Matthias.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_119: Matthias looks for Divine Will here. He cannot be disturbed. We should give them a preemptive strike. Defeat the legion guard.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_120: Matthias is still looking for it. Let's keep on attacking but, before that, please upgrade your Engineering Hub to lvl 13.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_121: We are going to launch a large-scale attack at the WARP port. Before that please upgrade Engineering Hub to level 13.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_122: Great! The defences here are weak. Let's defeat their Garrison Commander!
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_123: Richter is the battleship commander of the seventh fleet and he is a warmonger.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_124: Richter joined us. But as usual we should show them our power. Defeat elite Richter.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_125: Richter launched mighty fleet to wipe us out. It seems Divine Judge is the breakthrough.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_126: Only one last obstacle left. Defeat Divine Executors and we can escape from the dangerous condition.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_127: It's the difficult battles that reveal our weakness, Commander. Let's upgrade the Research Lab.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_128: Raphael has made major strides toward increasing the strength of the forces under his command. Let's defeat the Repressor Captain.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_129: Well done, Commander. Only the Repressor Captain remains.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_130: Don't forget to keep improving the strength of our fleet, Commander. Compose Galactonite twice.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_131: Raphael has attempted to pin us in. A victory for us is crucial. Defeat the Repressor Commander.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_132: Batis is the 5th fleet captain, who believes in the power of authority above all else. He'll perform any duty asked of him, with no questions asked.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_133: Commander we're in a new stage of the battle. We'll need better equipment for battle. Enhance your equipment 3 times.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_134: Let's continue to put pressure on Raphael. Our current mission is to kill the Punisher Commander.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_135: The only defensive force in Star District is Vorsehung - take him out!
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_136: Raphael is even crazier than we thought - he's begun construction of the Death Star. Let's get in the arena and hone our skills, Commander.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_137: Commander, prevent Raphael from attacking with the Death Star by taking out the Strangler Captain.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_138: It's too late, Commander! This star zone has been destroyed by the Death Star. We need to eliminate this threat before it's too late.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_139: Upgrade the Citadel to solidify our economy.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_140: In the name of his victims, eliminate the Strangler!
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_142: Let's not waste any time upgrading the Engineering Hub. The existence of the Death Star presents a great threat to the entire galaxy.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_143: We can't be safe with the existence of the Death Star in the same galaxy, we have to destroy it.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_144: At last the commander of the Death Star becomes our primary target. Don't forget about all the innocent victims that are in his wake, Commander.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_145: Time's running out. Upgrade the Tech Lab with haste!
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_146: The final battle looms ahead of us, Commander. Our target is the Arbiter Commander.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_147: Well done, Commander. Press forward and let's go after their leader.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_148: Galactonite really is a remarkable thing. Fuse Galactonite twice.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_149: Raphael's end is in sight, but obstacles remain. Take him out Divine Lord.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_150: Raphael awaits, Commander. The end is near. All who value justice are hoping for our victory.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_151: It's all about tactics from here, Commander. Take advantage of the Conservatory to defeat Raphael.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_153: If we can win in the arena the troop morale would be enhanced a lot. Anyhow, go and try.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_155: Good job! It's time to upgrade Research Lab to level 16.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_157: Compose Galactonite twice to reap the rewards
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_159: This one's for our economy, Commander. Upgrade the Citadel to level 16.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_161: We're into a new stage of battle, Commander. We'll need better equipment for it. Enhance equipment 3 times.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_163: If we can win in the arena, the troop morale will be enhanced by a lot. Anyway go and try it out.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_165: Compose Galactonite twice to see what's good in it.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_167: It's time to upgrade our Engineering Hub, Commander. The higher the level of our Engineering Hub, the stronger we can make our equipment.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_169: If we can win in the arena, the troop morale would be greatly enhanced. Anyway, give it a try!
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_171: Good job! It's time to upgrade Research Lab to level 17.

quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_215: As the newest imperial intel displays, an unknown signal was found on location RL_883. Let's go to check out.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_216: Should we win in the arena, the troop's morale would rise significantly. Go ahead and try!
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_217: Unknown forces were detected near the signal source. They don't bear any markings known by humanity. Defeat them and try to find out some valuable info.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_218: Commander we're in a new stage of the battle. We'll need better equipment for battle. Enhance your equipment 3 times.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_219: All enemy ships were converted to hydro-molecules then annihilated in space. Yet a wormhole appeared behind them. Let’s go pass the wormhole to find out where they come from and what their purpose is.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_220: Compose Galactonite twice to see what's good in it.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_221: Somehow we were met with enemies in this unstable wormhole channel. We have to defeat those guys in front of us.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_222: Commander, we'll need a steady supply of resources if we want to keep Star District safe and active. Let's have our Diplomats get on this.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_223: The rampaging spinning electric charge and cosmos radiation overwhelmed our defensive system. Defeat the enemy at the other end of the wormhole, or we can’t hold any longer.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_224: We're into a new stage of battle, Commander. We'll need better equipment for it. Enhance equipment 3 times.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_225: Unbelievable! We have arrived at another universe. When those guardians were defeated, the wormhole morphed incredibly. However, the most important thing now for us is to defeat our attackers.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_226: Should we win in the arena, the troop's morale would rise significantly. Go ahead and try!
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_227: The wormhole technology of different universes has gradually destabilized the whole framework of the greater cosmos. When the dimensional wall broke, our universe and this alien universe unexpectedly merged together. A new universe has formed. It is time for humanity to prove ourselves with our strength!
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_228: Compose Galactonite twice to see what's good in it.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_229: It looks like in this alien world, there's no universal sovereignty or ruler. If we want to impress our new neighbors, we have to give it all we've got.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_230: This one's for our economy, Commander. Upgrade the Citadel to level 20.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_231: Their fleet has a feeling of sincerity. Whatever, defeat them.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_232: Time to upgrade our Engineering Hub, Commander. The higher the level of our Engineering Hub, the stronger we can make our equipment.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_233: Finally Norm district is our ally. Let's move on to the next area!
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_234: Good job! It's time to upgrade Research Lab to level 20.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_235: According to the customs here, the winners decide the truth!
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_236: Compose Galactonite twice to see what's good in it.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_237: The area up ahead has become a fierce battlefield! Yet we have to advance. Tell those raging elements that humanity fears nothing.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_238: Commander we're in a new stage of the battle. We'll need better equipment for battle. Enhance your equipment 3 times.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_239: These non-organic beings are powerful, but we can overcome them.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_240: We're into a new stage of battle, Commander. We'll need better equipment for it. Enhance equipment 3 times.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_241: Negotiation with them requires first defeating them. Fear not, commander!
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_242: Should we win in the arena, the troop's morale would rise significantly. Go ahead and try!
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_243: That is the reason why the inhabitants here in this universe only worship strength. Since we are in the same space now, it's a problem we'll have to deal with.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_244: Compose Galactonite twice to see what's good in it.
quest170.MAIN_QUEST_DES_245: These enemies can absorb our attack and convert our ships. According to the latest analysis from the Empire, not just their ships possess this kind of ability, but also their alien beings. It is in their nature to feed on the DNA of others to evolve their own. We have to fight them!
quest170.SUB_QUEST_DESC_10001: Collect tax at the Citadel to obtain Cubits
quest170.SUB_QUEST_DESC_10002: Purchase various resources at the DIPLOMACY CENTER
quest170.SUB_QUEST_DESC_10003: Enter the Laboratory, obtain lots of Cubits
quest170.SUB_QUEST_DESC_10004: Obtain ranking rewards once per day
quest170.SUB_QUEST_DESC_10005: Purchase Tech Points for chances to get ship rewards
quest170.SUB_QUEST_DESC_10006: At the Galactonite Center, spend Cubits to obtain Galactonites, Galactonites can improve your fleet's power dramatically
quest170.SUB_QUEST_DESC_10007: At the Engineering Hub, consuming Cubits to enhance your equipment, raise your power effectively

Nezha's heads and arms have transmorphic powers, he cycles between different forms in the order of Ranger, Protector, and Rover, possessing the corresponding skill of each form.

A reconstructed Nezha possesses strong rebirth abilities. After casting a skill, he increases both his S-ATK and S-DEF by 300K. Nezha always enters battle as a Ranger.

Ranger: Cross attack; deals 300% S-ATK damage to targets. Targets also take additional S-ATK damage based on their current Accumulator (2% more damage per 10 Accumulator). There's a 40% chance to Lock targets for 1 round. Finally, recovers 100 Accumulator.

fleet.SKILL_DES_1437:
When the battle begins, plant 5 Seeds of Life for each ally except for yourself. Units with a Seed of Life will lose 1 seed whenever they are targeted by a Normal Attack and 2 seeds whenever they are targeted by an S-ATK. Each Seed of Life grants 8% S-ATK damage reduction, 20% S-DEF and 20% DEF (stacks). Cross Attack, deals 300% S-ATK damage to the targets and reduces your damage received by 70% for 2 rounds. Consumes the Seeds of Life on allied units to grant one of the following buff - or an ability - based on the number of seeds consumed (one unit may only be granted one type of ability):
5 Seeds: Rebirth (Lieutenant rebirth effects are prioritized). Revive immediately upon death with 100% of initial HP and Accumulator. Lasts 1 round.
4 Seeds: 75% chance to gain immunity to debuffs: Lock, Confuse, Freeze, Curse, Petrify, Forbidding Skill Use (chance is calculated independently for each one) for 1 round.
3 Seeds: Grants Entangle (ability) for 1 round: attacks have a 50% chance to entangle targets, rendering them unable to act for 1 round.
2 Seeds: Grants 80% S-ATK, 80% ATK, 50% Critical (absolute value) and Eye of True Sight for 2 rounds.
1 Seed: Grants Bounce Damage (ability) for 1 round: attack the enemy ship with the least HP True Damage equal to 180% of your Normal Attack damage.
After which you once again plant 5 Seeds of Life for each ally except for yourself. Finally, you recover 100 Accumulator.

quest.QUEST_INFO_AFFAIRS: Complete the following tasks to ensure the steady growth of our economy.
quest.QUEST_INFO_FLEETS: Complete the following tasks to enhance the power of our fleet.
quest.QUEST_INFO_EXP: Complete the following tasks to receive additional experience.
quest.QUEST_INFO_FUNCTION: Complete the following tasks to receive additional prestige.
quest.QUEST_INFO_ALLIANCE: Complete the following tasks to receive additional materials.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_1: The Citadel is the economic center of our planet. The higher its level, the more Cubits we can collect.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_2: Our defense network has found signs of pirates within our planets vicinity - lets wipe them out.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_3: Although we've defeated the pirate scouts, their main force remains. Lets make them regret their decision to mess with us, Commander.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_4: These fights aren't going to get any easier, Commander. We need a stronger fleet, which the Engineering Hub can provide. Lets get it back online as soon as possible.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_5: The most straight forward path to improving fleet strength is to enhance your equipment. Making sure that your Commander level equals your equipment level helps, too.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_6: We need to lock down the Star District and ensure its safety. Attack the pirate stronghold and take out their patrol units.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_7: Duyal: The leader of nearby pirates. Other details unknown. Rumours indicate that he used to be commander of the fleet directly affiliated with the Emperor.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_8: Duyal knows who we are, but not what we're capable of. Let's give him a taste of our true strength.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_9: Commander, we're taking major steps to improve our security but there are still Rebel forces around the Star District. We must find their patrol flagship and destroy it!
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_10: This battle presents a major threat to our safety and security. Making sure that our fleet emerges with more than 50% of its strength will be crucial, but fortunately for us, the Construction Yard can help with that.
quest.EX_MAIN_QUEST_DES_10: The most straight forward path to improving fleet strength is to enhance your equipment. Making sure that your Commander level equals your equipment level helps, too.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_11: The rebel patrol has been destroyed, and the flagship is vulnerable. Let's strike!
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_12: Construct the Celestial Portal to unlock and recruit more powerful ships, Commander.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_13: Well acquainted with Sylver, Lyon is the former commander of Lawsry District, who left the Star District after retiring.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_14: We have a lot to learn in the Conservatory, including valuable information on weapon development. Let's get it back online.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_15: The remaining fleet is retreating, Commander. Perhaps we can find some clues as to what happened - let's start with their leader.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_16: The Empire has suddenly cut out their supply rations, but Greenspan can help. Let's construct a Diplomacy Center.
quest.EX_MAIN_QUEST_DES_16: Commander, we'll need a steady supply of resources if we want to keep Star District safe and active. Let's have our Diplomats get on this.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_17: Unfortunately, we weren't able to find any useful information from the rebel mayor. Defeat the rebel commander as soon as possible.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_18: Improving fleet power is all about research, Commander. It's time for us to build a Research Lab.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_19: The battle to reclaim the 7th Spaceport begins here. The first step is to destroy the rebel guard fleet.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_20: We can move onto the second stage of recapturing the battlefield after the rebel guard fleet has been taken care of.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_21: As battle progresses, the financial gap between us and our adversaries grows wider. Let's upgrade our Citadel to bolster our economy.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_22: Rebels have taken control of the 7th Spaceport. We need to destroy them if we want to recapture the Spaceport, and that'll require sinking their commander.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_23: O'Neal is said to be among the most skilled rebel commanders out there. Let's find out if what they've told is true. And then defeat him.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_24: Our strength is derived from our research and development. Let's upgrade the Research Lab to increase our research capacity.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_25: We've entered the zone controlled by rebels. No choice but to go forward and fight, Commander. Defeat the commander of the rebel's 5th fleet.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_26: Congratulations, victory is in sight! Defeat the rebel's 5th fleet commander.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_27: Good news, Commander: our Galactonite Center is ready. Our fleet strength stands to make great gains.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_28: Our Galactonite Center has recovered and is fully functional. Let's see what we can gain from it.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_29: The Empire will no longer support us - we're on our own. We stand to gain an edge if we destroy the core of the rebel's 5th fleet now, though.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_30: Damon is a well known rebel general. It's said that his demeanor is that of a white knight though, so no one really knows why he's fighting for the rebels.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_31: Time to upgrade our Engineering Hub, Commander. The higher the level of our Engineering Hub, the stronger we can make our equipment.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_32: This arsenal is currently protected by a small rebel guard which shouldn't present too much of a challenge for us. Let's take them out.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_33: Defeat the guard commander to take over the arsenal that he's defending.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_34: To ensure that we maintain our combat chops, we should participate in Arena battles: Not just to make sure that our skills stay sharp, but also to collect the spoils of war that are waiting for us, Commander.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_35: The enemy surrounding the arsenal has been defeated. Let's keep the pressure on and defeat the guard commander to take control as soon as possible, Commander.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_36: Gonzalo is a Senior rebel General, famous for his unshakeable will and faith.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_37: Commander, we'll need a steady supply of resources if we want to keep Star District safe and active. Let's have our Diplomats get on this.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_38: An unknown force has attacked the imperial military parade and caused major damage. Let's strike back immediately and without mercy.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_39: Our allies have been attacked and struck down in cold blood. We need to find out who did it and strike back.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_40: That attack hurt badly. Don't forget to upgrade the Citadel to keep our economy strong.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_41: Rebels have killed our allies and people of the empire. They'll pay for what they've done.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_42: We cannot allow the rebel commander to get away.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_43: If we're going to take revenge, we'll need to improve our military strength. Let's upgrade the Engineering Hub, Commander.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_44: We'll break down the rebel defense before taking out their leader, Commander. Let's locate and take him out.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_45: Well done, Commander. Our next target is Raikkonen.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_46: Our plans are proceeding without incident so far. Upgrade the Research Lab to ensure that we increase our combat capacity, Commander.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_47: The enemy that we currently face is the rebel's 18th fleet. First, let's take out the 18th fleet commander.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_48: Lattice is a rebel senior military officer who possesses undying concern for troops under his command. He's also known to be as temperamental as he is protective.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_49: Although Lattice has joined our fleet, he remains unconvinced. Commander, let's challenge him in the Conservatory to make sure we get him on our side.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_50: An unknown fleet has attacked us, Commander. It seems that they're shooting to kill. Take out their leader and find a way to escape.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_51: The commander of the unknown force is the last thing standing in our way. Take him out!
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_52: A win in the galaxy arena will surely give everyone a taste of our true strength, Commander.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_53: The rebel fleet is undoubtedly strong, Commander. In their own words, they call it a "Carat Mixed Fleet". Whatever they call it, let's destroy it.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_54: Assar is the leader of the rebel group known as "Son of Kara". He looks as though he means well, but we have our doubts, Commander.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_55: Although we've taken out Assar, it's imperative that we identify and eliminate our own combat weaknesses. Defeat Elite Assar.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_56: Too many unknown adversaries make combat difficult. If we want to protect our people, we need to attack and defeat the head of the unknown forces that oppose us.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_57: This fleet doesn't seem to be under human control. The same rules apply though, Commander: locate their commander and take him out.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_58: Rest easy, Commander. Alien ships have been defeated. Now it's time for an arena victory to further boost morale.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_59: The alien fleet has suddenly retreated, Commander. Let's find them and strike to gain what could be a valuable position.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_60: Our next target: the unknown force commander.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_61: This one's for our economy, Commander. Upgrade the Citadel to level 9.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_62: Defeat the officer of the guard. How could such a desolate place have a Spaceport? Whatever. Defeat the officer here and lets move on.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_63: It's surprising to see rebels here, to say the least. Defeat the commander of this guard, Commander.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_64: Our failure has proven that we aren't strong enough, yet. Upgrade the Engineering Hub to increase our fleet power.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_65: The Empire's intelligence agency has located the Apostle's stronghold. Our first task is to investigate and attack, if necessary. Attack anyone who poses a threat to us, Commander.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_66: Commander, we found a clue: there seems to be an unusual ship among their fleet. Attack and capture it, and let's find out what's going on here.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_67: We're headed for the Empire's Science Academy, Commander. We won't be able to avoid combat, so let's enhance equipment 3 times in preparation.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_68: Aliens have appeared, as expected, but it seems that they're calling themselves "The Sentry". Let's show them who we are.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_69: Something is strange about these enemies, Commander. Don't let them escape.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_70: These fights won't get easier, Commander. Let's take advantage of the Galactonite Center and see how we can put it to use.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_71: An alien fleet has emerged within the orbit of the Science Academy. They are out for blood. Be careful, Commander.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_72: We're gaining the edge, Commander. Deal the final blow!
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_73: Commander we're in a new stage of the battle. We'll need better equipment for battle. Enhance your equipment 3 times.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_74: The enemy will never stop attacking, Commander. Let's proceed.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_75: A bizarre adversary has emerged. We don't know who they are, but they're about to know who we are.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_76: The imperial fleet suffers from low morale, Commander. They need a victory badly. Show them what victory means in the arena.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_77: The leader of the Ronea Star District is within our grasp. Take him out!
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_78: Only the destroyer commander remains. Show no mercy, friendly forces are depending on us.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_79: The last battle served to prove the immense power of the enemy! Use all possible means to defeat the elite destroyer in the Military Academy.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_80: The enemy fleet is attempting to destroy our planet. We must attack them head-on! Show them who has the final say! Kill their military governor!
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_81: The enemy's flagship is exposed. Kill them off!
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_82: The enemy retreated. We should take time now to strengthen our economy. Upgrade Citadel to level 10.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_83: The same as before, they want to attack our compatriots! We can't let them succeed. Kill the military governor!
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_84: The military governor is dead ! Now is the turn of their flagship !
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_85: Good job! It's time to upgrade Research Lab to level 10.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_86: The enemy convoy must have something of value. Defeat their flagship and see what it is.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_87: The rebels have indeed taken refuge with the aliens. Destroy their flagship as soon as possible.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_88: If we win in the arena, troop's morale will raise. Anyway go and try.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_89: According to the information at hand, the combined fleet of the enemy and the alien are here. Defeat their advisor.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_90: Strange enemy again. We can't treat them lightly before we make clear about their purpose. Defeat it!
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_91: The alien strength has surfaced. We should keep reinforcing our military power. Upgrade Engineering Hub to level 11.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_92: The apostle launched an attack on us. Kill their advisor!
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_93: Next is their commander to tell them human are not the fault of good.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_94: Compose Galactonite twice to see what's good in it.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_95: It's time to restore peace and take our homeland back from the aliens! Let's start with their Nullifier Warlord.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_96: There is very little information about the alien enemy, but we must be victorious!
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_97: Commander we're in a new stage of the battle. We'll need better equipment for battle. Enhance your equipment 3 times.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_98: The enemy launched a new fleet which we call the Reaper fleet. Also the rebels are now appearing, but they may actually be friendly forces. Anyway, the Reaper leader is our first target.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_100: Lord Rasyon is not in the palace which is why our economy has been cut off and and we've been left to fight alone until now. Dispatch the affairs officer to ask for some resources and gather new intel.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_101: The affairs officer came back with resources as usual, but nearby enemies show Raphael's control of the empire is not as strong as it appears. Let's focus on taking out their officer.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_102: The fleet directly below Raphael is very powerful. Let's seize this opportunity to defeat their commander. Maybe Raphael is trying to send us a message.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_103: Since we openly broke up with Raphael we need to reinforce our fleet power much more. Enhance the equipment 3 times.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_104: Raphael shrewdly deployed the incomplete imperial fleet on the News Center. Now launch an attack on the core of the sixth fleet -- the Heavy Cruiser.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_105: The flagship of the sixth fleet has lost its protection. Defeat it now and avoid unnecessary damage.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_106: The economic situation of the empire is not good. We have to rely on ourselves. Upgrade Citadel to level 12.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_107: It seems Raphael has taken control of the empire's 9th fleet and the military base's defenses. Defeat their lieutenant.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_108: Cassandra is the leader of the 9th aerocade team who owns excellent skill and always challenges the senior pilot.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_109: This lively girl seems unwilling to submit. Defeat her in the Conservatory.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_110: The wrecked 13th fleet has been placed in the guard here. Defeat their leader.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_111: Sophietia is the captain of the 13th fleet and the sister of Cassandra. She is skilled at combat support.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_112: According to the battle with Cassandra, she didn't exert all of her strength. Let's check her full potential in the Conservatory.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_113: How could Raphael deploy the second fleet of the empire to attack us? Destroy their destroyer, which is the core of their battle.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_114: Du'doria is an officer of the empire... but he doesn't have a firm position and is always hunting for glory.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_115: As Du'doria don't take any stand we can show them who is the real victor with our strength.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_116: Matthias deployed his fleet to proceed on a military exercise with us. It is said that Stargazer is very powerful. Defeat it. Don't allow humans to be shamed.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_117: Matthias is one of those apostles, who first followed Divine Will to galaxy. And he is seeking Divine Will with the rebels.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_118: The previous battle data was very useful. We need to collect more. Defeat elite Matthias.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_119: Matthias looks for Divine Will here. He cannot be disturbed. We should give them a preemptive strike. Defeat the legion guard.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_120: Matthias is still looking for it. Let's keep on attacking but, before that, please upgrade your Engineering Hub to lvl 13.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_121: We are going to launch a large-scale attack at the WARP port. Before that please upgrade Engineering Hub to level 13.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_122: Great! The defences here are weak. Let's defeat their Garrison Commander!
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_123: Richter is the battleship commander of the seventh fleet and he is a warmonger.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_124: Richter joined us. But as usual we should show them our power. Defeat elite Richter.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_125: Richter launched mighty fleet to wipe us out. It seems Divine Judge is the breakthrough.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_126: Only one last obstacle left. Defeat Divine Executors and we can escape from the dangerous condition.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_127: It's the difficult battles that reveal our weakness, Commander. Let's upgrade the Research Lab.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_128: Raphael has made major strides toward increasing the strength of the forces under his command. Let's defeat the Repressor Captain.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_129: Well done, Commander. Only the Repressor Captain remains.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_130: Don't forget to keep improving the strength of our fleet, Commander. Compose Galactonite twice.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_131: Raphael has attempted to pin us in. A victory for us is crucial. Defeat the Repressor Commander.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_132: Batis is the 5th fleet captain, who believes in the power of authority above all else. He'll perform any duty asked of him, with no questions asked.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_133: Commander we're in a new stage of the battle. We'll need better equipment for battle. Enhance your equipment 3 times.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_134: Let's continue to put pressure on Raphael. Our current mission is to kill the Punisher Commander.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_135: The only defensive force in Star District is Vorsehung - take him out!
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_136: Raphael is even crazier than we thought - he's begun construction of the Death Star. Let's get in the arena and hone our skills, Commander.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_137: Commander, prevent Raphael from attacking with the Death Star by taking out the Strangler Captain.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_138: It's too late, Commander! This star zone has been destroyed by the Death Star. We need to eliminate this threat before it's too late.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_139: Upgrade the Citadel to solidify our economy.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_140: In the name of his victims, eliminate the Strangler!
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_142: Let's not waste any time upgrading the Engineering Hub. The existence of the Death Star presents a great threat to the entire galaxy.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_143: We can't be safe with the existence of the Death Star in the same galaxy, we have to destroy it.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_144: At last the commander of the Death Star becomes our primary target. Don't forget about all the innocent victims that are in his wake, Commander.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_145: Time's running out. Upgrade the Tech Lab with haste!
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_146: The final battle looms ahead of us, Commander. Our target is the Arbiter Commander.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_147: Well done, Commander. Press forward and let's go after their leader.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_148: Galactonite really is a remarkable thing. Fuse Galactonite twice.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_149: Raphael's end is in sight, but obstacles remain. Take him out Divine Lord.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_150: Raphael awaits, Commander. The end is near. All who value justice are hoping for our victory.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_151: It's all about tactics from here, Commander. Take advantage of the Conservatory to defeat Raphael.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_153: If we can win in the arena the troop morale would be enhanced a lot. Anyhow, go and try.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_155: Good job! It's time to upgrade Research Lab to level 16.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_157: Compose Galactonite twice to reap the rewards
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_159: This one's for our economy, Commander. Upgrade the Citadel to level 16.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_161: We're into a new stage of battle, Commander. We'll need better equipment for it. Enhance equipment 3 times.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_163: If we can win in the arena, the troop morale will be enhanced by a lot. Anyway go and try it out.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_165: Compose Galactonite twice to see what's good in it.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_167: It's time to upgrade our Engineering Hub, Commander. The higher the level of our Engineering Hub, the stronger we can make our equipment.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_169: If we can win in the arena, the troop morale would be greatly enhanced. Anyway, give it a try!

quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_215: As the newest imperial intel displays, an unknown signal was found on location RL_883. Let's go to check out.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_216: Should we win in the arena, the troop's morale would rise significantly. Go ahead and try!
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_217: Unknown forces were detected near the signal source. They don't bear any markings known by humanity. Defeat them and try to find out some valuable info.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_218: Commander we're in a new stage of the battle. We'll need better equipment for battle. Enhance your equipment 3 times.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_219: All enemy ships were converted to hydro-molecules then annihilated in space. Yet a wormhole appeared behind them. Let’s go pass the wormhole to find out where they come from and what their purpose is.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_220: Compose Galactonite twice to see what's good in it.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_221: Somehow we were met with enemies in this unstable wormhole channel. We have to defeat those guys in front of us.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_222: Commander, we'll need a steady supply of resources if we want to keep Star District safe and active. Let's have our Diplomats get on this.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_223: The rampaging spinning electric charge and cosmos radiation overwhelmed our defensive system. Defeat the enemy at the other end of the wormhole, or we can’t hold any longer.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_224: We're into a new stage of battle, Commander. We'll need better equipment for it. Enhance equipment 3 times.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_225: Unbelievable! We have arrived at another universe. When those guardians were defeated, the wormhole morphed incredibly. However, the most important thing now for us is to defeat our attackers.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_226: Should we win in the arena, the troop's morale would rise significantly. Go ahead and try!
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_227: The wormhole technology of different universes has gradually destabilized the whole framework of the greater cosmos. When the dimensional wall broke, our universe and this alien universe unexpectedly merged together. A new universe has formed. It is time for humanity to prove ourselves with our strength!
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_228: Compose Galactonite twice to see what's good in it.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_229: It looks like in this alien world, there's no universal sovereignty or ruler. If we want to impress our new neighbors, we have to give it all we've got.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_230: This one's for our economy, Commander. Upgrade the Citadel to level 20.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_231: Their fleet has a feeling of sincerity. Whatever, defeat them.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_232: Time to upgrade our Engineering Hub, Commander. The higher the level of our Engineering Hub, the stronger we can make our equipment.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_233: Finally Norm district is our ally. Let's move on to the next area!
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_234: Good job! It's time to upgrade Research Lab to level 20.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_235: According to the customs here, the winners decide the truth!
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_236: Compose Galactonite twice to see what's good in it.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_237: The area up ahead has become a fierce battlefield! Yet we have to advance. Tell those raging elements that humanity fears nothing.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_238: Commander we're in a new stage of the battle. We'll need better equipment for battle. Enhance your equipment 3 times.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_239: These non-organic beings are powerful, but we can overcome them.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_240: We're into a new stage of battle, Commander. We'll need better equipment for it. Enhance equipment 3 times.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_241: Negotiation with them requires first defeating them. Fear not, commander!
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_242: Should we win in the arena, the troop's morale would rise significantly. Go ahead and try!
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_243: That is the reason why the inhabitants here in this universe only worship strength. Since we are in the same space now, it's a problem we'll have to deal with.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_244: Compose Galactonite twice to see what's good in it.
quest.MAIN_QUEST_DES_245: These enemies can absorb our attack and convert our ships. According to the latest analysis from the Empire, not just their ships possess this kind of ability, but also their alien beings. It is in their nature to feed on the DNA of others to evolve their own. We have to fight them!
