story.DEXTAR_STORY_1: I'm Dexter. I know you must be amazed at all of my inventions. They're very complex. I'll show you new ones as I perfect them.
story.DEXTAR_STORY_2: I have been around since the beginning of space travel.  All I need is my laboratory.
story.DEXTAR_STORY_3: No one can figure out the entirety of space. Why is it that humans have sole proprietorship of the Galaxy? It seems as if we were created by a God, doesn't it?
story.DEXTAR_STORY_4: This universe is full of Galactonite, which may be very useful to us. It needs to be studied further.
story.DEXTAR_STORY_5: Where I'm from, I'm able to travel through space as easily as you're able to wave your hand. I can't do that here. Something's not right.
story.DEXTAR_STORY_6: There are lots of mystical inventions in Dexter's lab and many sensitive experiments in progress. <player> was so naughty and clumsy.
story.DEXTAR_STORY_7: Commander, please be careful in the lab.  There are many sensitive experiments in progress.
story.DEXTAR_STORY_LOCKED: I call my latest invention, the Galaxy Slot Machine. It awards Cubits, Tech Points, and even Credits, all without paying anything. Good luck!
story.DEXTAR_STORY_slot: I have another new invention, called the Auto Miner. I got sidetracked while working on a wormhole to take me home. Check it out.
story.DEXTAR_STORY_mining: I have another new invention, called the Auto Miner. To be honest, I originally wanted to build nothing but a wormhole to take me home.
story.DEXTAR_STORY_ac: If you truly want to sharpen your skills Commander, there's really no substitute for Battle Training. You still have much to learn.
story.DEXTAR_STORY_crusade: Yes! It works! But now we have some unwelcome guests. Take care of them would ya?
story.DEXTAR_STORY_worldboss: This trouble maker always messes up my lab! Is there anyone here who can get rid of him? I give you my word; I won't let you down.
story.DEXTAR_STORY_wc: Alright, I can provide you a shortcut to participate in the Cross-Cosmos Competition, but come on, quieten them down!
story.DEXTAR_STORY_infinite_cosmos: Infinite Cosmos can be used to transport goods, run tactics, drills or explore new veins...oh, this is the place where your imagination becomes reality.
story.DEXTAR_STORY_prime_wve: Oh my god, look at these red dots on the radar, what a big swarm! Keep them away, we can't let the Primus legions get too close to here.
story.DEXTER_PRIMUS_LOCKING:
Take It easy there, youngun.
Based on my calculations, PRIMUS's next warp will occur after %s. Kill some time at the Galaxy slots until then.
story.SUBTITLE_1: Five months ago on December 7th at 4:37pm in the year GE 1137.
story.SUBTITLE_3: A rebel guerilla fleet is about to be completely eradicated by the imperial forces.
story.NEW_SUBTITLE_14: About to exit warp speed, please wait...
story.SUBTITLE_16: 72 hours after the end of the Triffid Nebula incident
story.SUBTITLE_26: Memory recovery process complete. Please head to the city command center.
story.TUTORIAL_1: Regeneration complete! Confirm your name to activate command system protocol.
story.TUTORIAL_3: Computer! Where's my fleet? What happened?
story.TUTORIAL_4: Commander, your fleet was destroyed and you were critically injured in that skirmish that happened several months ago. Now that your regeneration is complete, please return to the Planetary Command Center.
story.TUTORIAL_5: Commander, Tech points obtained from battle can be used to upgrade technology.
story.TUTORIAL_6: This place is nice. Real nice. I could get used to this.
story.TUTORIAL_7: Commander, I can arrange for funds to be dispatched to you daily, but it won't be a large amount. You can always acquire more if you need.
story.TUTORIAL_8: Just try. Don't worry about winning or losing.
story.TUTORIAL_9: Come here, turn on <font color='#FFBF00'>Vein monitor system</font>，we may find that someone is digging veins
story.TUTORIAL_10: We're looking for mines which will yield the most resources, Commander. Once we get the process in motion, we'll be able to operate with remarkable efficiency. You'll soon see what I mean.
story.TUTORIAL_11: Yeah, I guess you could say Dexter is an oddball. It is what it is. Shall we get back to crushing pirates?
story.TUTORIAL_12: Skill System activated, Commander. The currently available skill, <font color='#FFBF00'>Laser Blaster</font>, attacks enemies arranged in a line. It will be effective in battle.
story.TUTORIAL_13: As you level up, your ship will develop new skills. Using the right <font color='#FFBF00'> skills </font> in combat can make all the difference.
story.TUTORIAL_14: The Engineering Hub, industrial heart of our planet, enables equipment and fleet enhancements.
story.TUTORIAL_15: Everything should be okay now. Let's give it another shot.
story.TUTORIAL_16: The <font color='#FFBF00'>Engineering Hub</font> has been restored, and is ready to make equipment alterations, Commander.
story.TUTORIAL_17: The Conservatory allows us to hone combat skills and can assist in upgrading equipment at later levels. Experienced military commanders will feel at home there.
story.TUTORIAL_18: Has the Engineering Hub been completed? If so, we can move onto the Conservatory and test the capabilities of our fleet.
story.TUTORIAL_19: Commander, you should focus on your combat mission.
story.TUTORIAL_20: Commander, let's put the new ship into the formation, you need to enter<font color='#FFBF00'> FORM </font> to adjust your formation.
story.TUTORIAL_21: Commander, let's put the new ship into our formation. This will help us achieve victory much faster!
story.TUTORIAL_22: Commander, if you upgrade the level of the <font color='#FFBF00'>Citadel</font> we will be able to collect more Cubits.
story.TUTORIAL_23: We don't have enough Cubits to execute that command, sir. Try getting some more from the <font color='#FFBF00'>Citadel</font>.
story.TUTORIAL_24: Commander, we'll need to <font color='#FFBF00'>collect</font> more energy in order to warp in new ships successfully.
story.TUTORIAL_25: Commander, recruiting Lyon's fleet will require more <font color=#FFBF00'>Lepton</font>. Ensure that our Lepton recharging system has been activated.
story.TUTORIAL_26:
Lepton charging system online. 
Commander, note that manual charging is <font color='#FFBF00'> unstable </font>. Under high pressure, the system can overload and lose energy.
story.TUTORIAL_27: For efficiency and safety <font color='#FFBF00'> Credits </font> can be exchanged to automatically reach <font color='#FFBF00'> the maximum capacity </font>.
story.TUTORIAL_28: If we're short on warp energy, we can either recharge it or <font color='#FFBF00'>collect now</font>.
story.TUTORIAL_29: Commander, <font color='#FFBF00'>Recruit</font> me from the Celestial Portal, If you have use for my services.
story.TUTORIAL_30: Lyon, it's been a while. How are things?
story.TUTORIAL_31: Not bad, but I'm concerned about this rebellion <font color='#FFBF00'> getting out of hand </font>. We need to act quickly.
story.TUTORIAL_32: We've received a distress signal, Commander. The 7th Space Port is currently under attack by rebel forces.
story.TUTORIAL_33: The <font color='#FFBF00'>Laboratory</font> is where all the Galactonite fusing happens, Commander.
story.TUTORIAL_34: In the Laboratory you can <font color='#FFBF00'>Fuse</font> Galactonite using our specialized machinary.
story.TUTORIAL_35: Indicators on the sides of the fusing machine show the energy level. The higher<font color='#FFBF00'> the energy level</font>, the greater the chance that we can collect <font color='#FFBF00'>Prism Galactonite</font>. Note that this also comes at a higher cost.
story.TUTORIAL_36: We can also equip <font color='#FFBF00'>Galactonite </font>on our ships in the <font color='#FFBF00'>Galactonite Center</font>. They make significant improvements to our ship attributes.
story.TUTORIAL_37: Just like equipment, Galactonite can be equipped on our ships to enhance ship performance.
story.TUTORIAL_38: Time to return to the battlefield, Commander. Locate their <font color='#FFBF00'> flagship </font>and take it down.
story.TUTORIAL_39: Hold your horses, our fleet has sustained significant damage. Let's make repairs before heading out again.
story.TUTORIAL_40: Construction Yard is online and functional - ready to make repairs on your command.
story.TUTORIAL_41: <player>, Choose to repair<font color='#FFBF00'> a single ship </font> or <font color='#FFBF00'>the whole fleet </font>. Your call, commander.
story.TUTORIAL_42: Well done! Next step is to get these repairs done.
story.TUTORIAL_43: Impressive. These ships look as good as new. They'll do nicely.
story.TUTORIAL_44: <player>, when you unload equipment, it prevents us from making improvements. Keep that in mind, Commander.
story.TUTORIAL_45: He's right. We should go after the<font color='#FFBF00'> retreating terrorists</font> and try to obtain more information.
story.TUTORIAL_46: That scientific research spaceport? Oh yeah, it's well known. All of the Empire's military technolgy is developed there.
story.TUTORIAL_47: Once our ships are fully equipped we'll be ready to face this threat, Commander.
story.TUTORIAL_49:
......(I didn't notice there were so many pirates nearby).
Keep moving.
story.TUTORIAL_50: Then start the <font color='#FFBF00'>mine scanner</font> to find potential resource deposits that we can mine.
story.TUTORIAL_51: If you see another fleet mining nearby, you can <font color='#FFBF00'>Plunder</font> their resoures if you can get past their defenses. But beware, others will come to steal yours as well. I'll leave that decision up to you.
story.TUTORIAL_52: The <font colr='#FFBF00'>Citadel</font> is our main administration center. Currently, it will supply you with Cubits.
story.TUTORIAL_53: Alright, we need more resources to support our investigation on the Progression and the Triffid Nebula incident.
story.TUTORIAL_54: The battlefield scanning system has been activated. You can command your fleet to go to any active star system directly from here.
story.TUTORIAL_55: Pirate ships are approaching the planet. Requesting orders.
story.TUTORIAL_57: The ship being used by Sylver is classified as a <font color='#FFBF00'>Striker</font> class which has excellent attack power but weak defense.
story.TUTORIAL_58: Our scouts were able to salvage equipment that we can use.
story.TUTORIAL_59: Commander, based on battle analysis, it is recommended that you use the <font color='#FFBF00'>Laser Blaster</font>.
story.TUTORIAL_60: I'm in the Laboratory, come here quickly.
story.TUTORIAL_61:
Don't know why I arrived here after the "arrogant" tour.
I need some resources to find my way home.
story.TUTORIAL_62: You're welcome in my lab whenever you like. <font color='#FFBF00'>Just don't interfere with my experiements.</font>
story.TUTORIAL_63: Well, you see that shiny thing over there? Go ahead and play around with it.
story.TUTORIAL_64: Well, that was interesting, but I've got some work to do.
story.TUTORIAL_65: I've successfully developed a type of unmanned mining ship. Use it to mine for resources that can be exchanged for Cubits.
story.CHAPTER1_1_1: I need a report on the current status of this planet, now!
story.CHAPTER1_1_2:
The facilities on the current planet have not yet been attacked by pirates.
Task log update: restore <font color='#FFBF00'>Citadel</font> function.
story.CHAPTER1_1_4:
(It's a pirate scouting force......)
Attack! Find the <font color='#FFBF00'>Scout Captain</font> as soon as possible. Do not allow them to dock on our planet.
story.CHAPTER1_1_5: Their locations are marked <font color='#FFBF00'> on the radar</font>. Awaiting your command...
story.CHAPTER1_1_6: There's a lot of battle debris in this area. There could be salvageable items there. Computer, <font color='#FFBF00'>Explore</font> this area immediately.
story.CHAPTER1_1_7:
Commander, we have recovered an undamaged weapon which can be equipped on our ship.
Installation can be performed in the <font color='#FFBF00'>Fleet</font> management system.
story.CHAPTER1_1_8: Equipment installed successfully! Ready for use!
story.CHAPTER1_1_9: The duty of the imperial army is to protect it's civilians and prevent anything from threatening their safety and freedom.
story.CHAPTER1_1_10: Commander, residents on the planet claim that you have motivated them to fight against the pirates. You've gained quite a bit of <font color='#FFBF00'>Prestige</font>.
story.CHAPTER1_1_12: Destroy them immediately before they alert more pirates about our position!
story.CHAPTER1_1_13:
Pirate scout fleet has been completely destroyed. Mission accomplished. 
Pirate Ship confirmed, target change: Defeat Pirate Flagship！
story.CHAPTER1_1_14:
Imperial officer, 
<font color='#FFBF00'>Sylver</font> from Lawsry SDF joined the battle.
story.CHAPTER1_1_15: Sylver, why are you alone? Where is the imperial defense force on the planet?
story.CHAPTER1_1_16: The Empire withdrew them a very long time ago. You can count on me though.
story.CHAPTER1_1_17: There is debris from a destroyed space station nearby. Go examine it. I'll wait for you here.
story.CHAPTER1_1_18:
Wow, new equipment!
Since you already have these, how about you equip them on my ship?
My ship is also in the <font color='#FFBF00'>Fleet</font> management system.
story.CHAPTER1_1_19: Look who it is. Another imperialist lackey.
story.CHAPTER1_1_20: You will pay for what you have done!
story.CHAPTER1_1_21: Haha! I rule at beating up pirates!
story.CHAPTER1_1_22: Battle data shows that you dealt a negligible amount of damage to the pirates.
story.CHAPTER1_1_23: It's called strategy! Damn this useless Robot!
story.CHAPTER1_1_24: Stop arguing, let's return to base.
story.CHAPTER1_1_25: Computer, what other tasks are there?
story.CHAPTER1_1_26:
Commander, <font color='#FFBF00'>Engineering Hub</font> rebuilding procedure is complete.
Equipment can be enhanced and upgraded here according to <font color='#FFBF00'>design plans</font>.
story.CHAPTER1_1_27:
The <font color='#FFBF00'>Engineering Hub</font> is online.
Equipment upgrades can also be made here with the proper  plans.
story.CHAPTER1_1_28: Don't worry. Let's try it out.
story.CHAPTER1_1_29: Fleet equipment needs to be enhanced. It's suggested that you rebuild the <font color='#FFBF00'>Engineering Hub</font>.
story.CHAPTER1_1_30: <font color='#FFBF00'>Engineering Hub</font>has been rebuilt. Equipment enhancement is readily available.
story.CHAPTER1_1_31: There should be no problems now, let's try again
story.CHAPTER1_1_32: Equipment ready. Ships are ready for battle.
story.CHAPTER1_1_33: Commander, be reasonable. You should now upgrade the Engineering Hub and enhance the ships in your fleet.
story.CHAPTER1_1_34: (The report on the Triffid Nebula battle suggests that star pirates were the attackers......) Attack at once!
story.CHAPTER1_1_35: Target acquired: weapon systems ready. All stand by.
story.CHAPTER1_1_37:
Commander, our scouts have found more usable equipment.
Use the <font color='#FFBF00'>Fleet</font> Management system to equip them.
story.CHAPTER1_1_38: Commander, you've received a private transmission
story.CHAPTER1_1_39: Relay the message to me later, I want to examine the signal first.
story.CHAPTER1_1_40:
Hey!
Take note of the battle formations!
story.CHAPTER1_1_41: What the... <font color='#FFBF00'>Pirates</font> hiding in the debris?
story.CHAPTER1_1_42: It's certainly possible.  You're a bit inexperienced in space combat.
story.CHAPTER1_2_3: <player>, there are reports of small strongholds of pirates in the Kuiper belt.
story.CHAPTER1_2_5: All hands to battle stations! This is going to be a tough fight.
story.CHAPTER1_2_6: Hey, <player>, there's a rumor that the Pirate Commander used to be a commander for the imperial fleet. What do you intend to do?
story.CHAPTER1_2_7: I'm planning to capture the <font color='#FFBF00'>Pirate Patrol Commander</font>, let's try to sneak up on them.
story.CHAPTER1_2_9: <font color='#FFBF00'>Pirate Patrol  Commander</font> in sight, clear to attack.
story.CHAPTER1_2_10: <player>,there is a strange old man on our planet called <font color='#FFBF00'>Dexter</font>, he cried to see you immediately.
story.CHAPTER1_2_11: Yes! It's you! <player>! Come to my lab! I've got some things to show!
story.CHAPTER1_2_12: You'd better get there ASAP, that old man is crazy. I'm always concerned that he might blow up the entire planet one day.
story.CHAPTER1_2_17: <player>, this is a recently abandoned dock space station.
story.CHAPTER1_2_18: Commander, we can update our weapons control system here.
story.CHAPTER1_2_19:
Fleet system update completed.
<font color='#FFBF00'>SKILL system</font> activated.
story.CHAPTER1_2_20:
I am <font color='#FFBF00'>Duyal</font>, tell me your name, kid!
I like to know who my opponents are before I defeat them.
story.CHAPTER1_2_21:
I am <player>, commander of the first planet of Lawsry District Galaxy Empire.
There's no way out, Duyal, give up!
story.CHAPTER1_2_22: Ah, so I see you survived the battle of the <font color='#FFBF00'> Triffid Nebula </font>. Let's see what you've got.
story.CHAPTER1_2_23: (...Hmm, that's odd. How does he know about me?)
story.CHAPTER1_2_24: Well done, kid! Let's head back, I've been investigating the battle of <font color='#FFBF00'>the Triffid Nebula</font>, and I believe that there was a huge conspiracy going on.
story.CHAPTER1_2_25:
Don't give me that look. I had no choice but to join the pirates.
I was undercover to investigate the conspiracy, OK?
story.CHAPTER1_2_26:
You'd better not be trying to pull any tricks. 
I'll be watching you closely.
story.CHAPTER1_2_27:
Excellent! <player>.
I can't believe we took this stronghold. Their officers even joined forces with us.
story.CHAPTER1_2_28: <player>, I have entered your name in the imperial <font color='#FFBF00'>Arena</font> rankings. Let's see your skills!
story.CHAPTER1_2_30:
I've also configured battle simulations in the <font color='#FFBF00'>Conservatory</font>.
I want to see what kind of face you make when you fail.
story.CHAPTER1_2_31: I don't appreciate your cockiness but I might forgive you if you can give me some information about the rebels.
story.CHAPTER1_2_32:
The rebel organization is complicated. They claim loyalty to the <font color='#FFBF00'>Son of Cara</font>. I personally know quite a few good people there.
Why do you ask?
story.CHAPTER1_2_33: Because the empire commands us to attack the surrounding rebels immediately.
story.CHAPTER1_2_34: That sounds great and all, but I want to try out the <font color='#FFBF00'>Arena</font> first. It shouldn't take too much time.
story.CHAPTER1_2_35: Scanners are showing a large number of approaching enemy ships.
story.CHAPTER1_2_36: This Medium <font color='#FFBF00'>Supply Pack</font> will come in handy! Let's put it to good use. To use it, open the <font color='#FFBF00'>Item</font> menu.
story.CHAPTER1_3_1: It's the <font color='#FFBF00'>Rebel Patrol</font>. Attack immediately!
story.CHAPTER1_3_2: Here comes the loser of the Empire. Entertain us.
story.CHAPTER1_3_3: <font color='#FFBF00'>Cara</font> will save me and I will live foever.
story.CHAPTER1_3_5: Something that the terrorists worship. It all sounds a lot like <font color='#FFBF00'> a cult </font> if you ask me.
story.CHAPTER1_3_6:
Ah, if it isn't the loser of the Empire. Once we send you to your grave, 
we will finally rule the whole galaxy!
story.CHAPTER1_3_7: So little respect in the galaxy these days.
story.CHAPTER1_3_8:
This voice sounds familiar......
<player>, be careful, this may be a trap.
story.CHAPTER1_3_9: Thanks a lot, I have enjoyed the battle, signing off.
story.CHAPTER1_3_11: Everyone retreat at the fastest speed and get out of the war zone!
story.CHAPTER1_3_12: Duyal, do you know where the pirates are?
story.CHAPTER1_3_13:
I have no idea, but I think it is most likely that this guy has something to do with the battle of the <font color='#FFBF00'>Triffid Nebula</font>.
We will find out soon.
story.CHAPTER1_3_14: We need to build a more powerful fleet.
story.CHAPTER1_3_15: Computer, start <font color='#FFBF00'>Celestial Portal</font> repair process immediately.
story.CHAPTER1_4_1: Channel confirmed. We have visual of the target.
story.CHAPTER1_4_2:
Scan the whole area. Make sure to examine every speck of stardust!
Go!
story.CHAPTER1_4_6:
Thank god, I thought I was going to die out here.
You saved my life!
story.CHAPTER1_4_7: Commander, the Empire has cut off our financial support.
story.CHAPTER1_4_8: I think I can assist with that.  I know people in high places. But, I will need an office.
story.CHAPTER1_4_9: We can recover the Diplomacy Center and provide him an office there.
story.CHAPTER1_4_10: Target identified, don't let them get away!
story.CHAPTER1_4_11: <font color='#FFBF00'> Cara </font>, protect us and give us strength against our enemies!
story.NEW_CHAPTER1_4_13: The entire fleet has returned safely from the battlefield.
story.NEW_CHAPTER1_4_14:
It's time to rebuild the <font color='#FFBF00'>Conservatory
</font>.
story.NEW_CHAPTER1_4_15: Great! I can't wait to challenge the Elite Commanders!
story.NEW_CHAPTER1_4_16: The Conservatory allows us to hone combat skills and can assist in upgrading equipment at later levels. Experienced military commanders will feel at home there.
story.NEW_CHAPTER1_4_17: Well done, you've proven yourself to be an experienced commander!
story.NEW_CHAPTER1_4_18: <player>, reports show the Rebels have attacked <font color='#FFBF00'>the 7th Spaceport</font>.
story.NEW_CHAPTER1_4_19:
<font color='#FFBF00'>The 7th Spaceport</font>?
Our civilian facilities are there! We can't stay here and do nothing, let's gear up!
story.CHAPTER1_4_13: All ships retreat immediately! The area is unstable and I have already been blown up enough times.
story.CHAPTER1_5_2:
Is that the Research Center?
I've seen it before. Imperial military technology has been developed there.
story.CHAPTER1_5_3: The imperial army should have easily conquered the 7th spaceport.
story.CHAPTER1_5_4: We will take it back as soon as we finish preparing the fleet.
story.CHAPTER1_5_5: Entering the airspace of the 7th spaceport. Confirm indentity of the rebel fleet.
story.CHAPTER1_5_6: Destroy all enemy ships in the vicinity of the spaceport ASAP. Prepare for landing.
story.CHAPTER1_5_7: Foolish imperial army! You all don't understand anything!
story.CHAPTER1_5_9: <player>, come to my lab, I have created something that you might be interested in.
story.CHAPTER1_5_10: Hahahaha, it is too late! We have complete control over this spaceport. You've wasted your time.
story.CHAPTER1_5_11: Hurry up, if they get their hands on our technology, we'll be in big trouble.
story.CHAPTER1_5_12: We're almost done! Let's get going!
story.CHAPTER1_5_13: No need to hurry. We've got this.
story.CHAPTER1_5_14: <font color='#FFBF00'> Cara's </font> light shines on me.
story.CHAPTER1_5_15: Prepare for battle. We must retake the 7th spaceport. Who knows what the rebels will do with it.
story.CHAPTER1_6_2: Phase two of the battle is beginning.
story.CHAPTER1_6_3: Take out the ships surrounding the spaceport as soon as possible and open the landing route.
story.CHAPTER1_6_4: Stupid imperialists! Your ignorance will be the end of you!
story.CHAPTER1_6_5: Attacking innocent civilians is an act of <font color='#FFBF00'> terrorism </font>. You won't get away with it.
story.CHAPTER1_6_6: Enemy ships down. Acquiring new objectives.......
story.CHAPTER1_6_8: I get all excited when fighting for justice. Let's move!
story.CHAPTER1_6_9: You need to calm down, girl.
story.CHAPTER1_6_10:
You don't stand a chance against the mighty<font color='#FFBF00'> O'Neil</font>?
Bring it on!
story.CHAPTER1_6_12: Bio records show that O'Neil appeared in the space reality show, "The Real Space Husbands of the Pegasus Quadrant".  He was suspended from the show after nude photos of him and his pet horse went viral on the galactic interweb.
story.CHAPTER1_6_13: ...To hell with you! You like to play dirty huh? I still destroy you.
story.CHAPTER1_6_14: I...I can't believe I lost to you.
story.CHAPTER1_6_15: <player>，let him fight for us. We could use his knowledge and services.
story.CHAPTER1_6_16: Why do you seem attracted to all of our enemies?
story.CHAPTER1_6_17: O'Neil, tell us what are you doing in the 7th spaceport? Why would you say the Empire will destroy humanity?
story.CHAPTER1_6_18: Many shady dealings are going on behind closed doors.  I'm sworn to secrecy, but you wouldn't believe me if I told you anyways.
story.CHAPTER1_6_19: I intend to take advantage of being here to learn about all of the empire's technology and tactics.
story.CHAPTER1_6_20: O'Neil is pretty cute. What do you think, Lyon?
story.CHAPTER1_6_21: I think there's something wrong with your brain.
story.CHAPTER1_6_22:
So now we have the coordinates of the rebel base.
Computer, report it to empire immediately.
story.CHAPTER1_6_23:
Report complete.
The Empire ordered us to independently attack the rebel base.
story.CHAPTER1_6_24:
Are they trying to get <player> killed? Attack without backup?
We cannot comply with this order! It's insane!
story.CHAPTER1_6_25: I fight for the Empire. I will do anything to keep the peace. Prepare the fleet to move out!
story.CHAPTER1_7_1: Are you sure you want to do this?
story.CHAPTER1_7_2: We've explored the entire galaxy and human beings are still the only intelligent lifeforms, however O'Neil claims that the rebels are cooperating with other beings. They could be dangerous. We need to take this risk to protect humanity.
story.CHAPTER1_7_3:
You are correct.
Computer, broadcast our battle to the empire and request assistance from imperial army.
story.CHAPTER1_7_4: Ha! You must be kidding if you think that you can defeat me alone!
story.CHAPTER1_7_5: The enemy is too strong. I'm too young to die. I want to go home.......
story.CHAPTER1_7_6: There's nothing to fear while I'm here.
story.CHAPTER1_7_8: What good timing. Galactonite systems could significantly enhance the strength of the fleet.
story.CHAPTER1_7_9: The imperial fleet sent us a transmission: they will provide support to attack the rebel base after taking back the starport.
story.CHAPTER1_7_10: Well it's about time. I was beginning to think <player>that they wanted us to perish <font color='#FFBF00'> in battle </font>.
story.CHAPTER1_7_11:
You ignorant fools!
What you have done today will bring annihilation to the human race!
story.CHAPTER1_7_12: I wonder why all the rebels keep saying that...
story.CHAPTER1_7_13: It's the result of being brainwashed.
story.CHAPTER1_7_14: Commander, our next order is to attack the rebel base.
story.CHAPTER1_7_16: The imperial fleet has reported that their fleet is not yet ready for deployment.
story.CHAPTER1_8_1: We're on our own so we have to stick together.
story.CHAPTER1_8_2: You will soon feel <font color='#FFBF00'> the wrath of Cara </font>.
story.CHAPTER1_8_3: Establishing communication channel with Imperial ship
story.CHAPTER1_8_4: Heroes! Attack the rebel base with everything that you've got, I will take care of their ships.
story.CHAPTER1_8_5:
Raphael!
Thanks for your support! Let's move!
story.CHAPTER1_8_6: You have gotten lucky to have made it this far, but it all ends here!
story.CHAPTER1_8_7: You fools will all suffer in the end...
story.CHAPTER1_8_8:
I have never met anyone who has accomplished so much at such a young age.
You are an inspiration to the empire.
story.CHAPTER1_8_9:
Thanks for the praise, but I want to know why the rebels have been claiming that the empire will destroy humanity.
Also where are they getting their mysterious techonology from.
story.CHAPTER1_8_10: As a reminder, all empires in history have been lost to corruption and authoritarian governments.
story.CHAPTER1_8_11:
Honestly, I don't care so much about their technology. I am more concerned about the damage that they are doing to their followers.
It seems they have gone too far.
story.CHAPTER1_8_13: The rebels are wreaking havoc all over the galaxy and no one understands their motives.  Please join us in stopping them.
story.CHAPTER1_8_14:
With pleasure.
Give me the next order.
story.CHAPTER1_8_15:
The rebel base is defended by <font color='#FFBF00'> the Arsenal Guard </font>.
You lead the attack on the guard and I will secure the arsenal.
story.CHAPTER2_1_3:
The enemies have broken through our defenses!
We need backup!
story.CHAPTER2_1_5: Commander, the battle was a complete success. What's our next mission?
story.CHAPTER2_1_6: <font color='#FFBF00'>Gonzalo</font> is a senior officer of the son of Cara. He will be a tough adversary.
story.CHAPTER2_1_7: Mr. Gonzalo... he's tough, there's no doubt about that. When he wants something, he destroys anything that stands in his way.
story.CHAPTER2_2_1: Locate Gonzalo's forces and eliminate them one by one.
story.CHAPTER2_2_2: Commander, <font color='#FFBF00'>Gonzalo's fleet</font> is not far ahead.
story.CHAPTER2_2_3: So you're the ones that destroyed our base. You will pay dearly for that.
story.CHAPTER2_2_4: That was way too easy. Did you let up, Gonzalo?
story.CHAPTER2_2_5: I've lost faith in <font color='#FFBF00'> the Sons of Cara </font> anyway. I've been looking for a way out.
story.CHAPTER2_2_7:
They are collaborating with aliens and attacking civilians.
I can't stand by them anymore.
story.CHAPTER2_2_8: I see. So that's what they've been up to.
story.CHAPTER2_2_9: I know you: survivor of the Triffid Nebula, protector of Lawsry District... you're a famous commander.
story.CHAPTER2_2_10:
I'll be waiting for you in the Conservatory.
No more talk. Let's fight.
story.CHAPTER2_2_11: <player>, Raphael has invited us to attend the imperial <font color='#FFBF00'> military parade </font> . Yay party time!
story.CHAPTER2_2_12: We'd better not keep him waiting. Let's go.
story.CHAPTER2_3_1: An emergency alert! What's this about?
story.CHAPTER2_3_2:
Imperial ships have been attacked by unknown ships. Half of the imperial fleet has been destroyed and the other half is heavily damaged.
Currently, Raphael's fleet is also under attack by the unknown ships.
story.CHAPTER2_3_3: We need to help him now! Take out their command repeaters first.
story.CHAPTER2_3_4: Indra weapons ready. Seek and destroy everything. Spare no survivors, including civilians.
story.CHAPTER2_3_6: I didn't know they were targeting civilians as well. Unacceptable.
story.CHAPTER2_3_7:
If that's true, we must act quickly. Let's keep moving. 
We need to take out their flagships.
story.CHAPTER2_3_8: This dark area of space will be your final resting place.
story.CHAPTER2_3_10: But nothing that we couldn't handle.
story.CHAPTER2_3_11: You saved my life and you saved the Empire. Commander, you're a real hero!
story.CHAPTER2_3_12: How were the rebels able stage such a large attack?
story.CHAPTER2_3_13: No one can say for sure, but they have managed to destroy half of the imperial fleet along with civilian targets in a single attack.
story.CHAPTER2_3_14:
We cannot let them escape, Commander. 
Engage immediately.
story.CHAPTER2_3_15: Commander, the empire is counting on you.
story.CHAPTER2_4_3: Well done, Commander. It's a shame we didn't find anything, though.
story.CHAPTER2_4_4: Don't worry. Raphael is staging an attack on the fortress. We'll emerge victorious.
story.CHAPTER2_5_1:
Engage the enemy.
Find their commander and take him out.
story.CHAPTER2_5_5: Save yourself the trouble and surrender, you traitor.
story.CHAPTER2_5_6: What makes you think that I would give up so easily?
story.CHAPTER2_5_7: Now I don't have much choice but to surrender.
story.CHAPTER2_5_3: Thank you for your efforts. Imperial commanders will attack the rebel base with your help. We will soon restore the peace.
story.CHAPTER2_5_4: We need to take out the rebels, to avenge the innocent civilians that were killed.
story.CHAPTER2_6_1: We'll strike first. Raphael will be there to back us up soon. Seek and destroy the enemy officer.
story.CHAPTER2_6_2: Well done, the imperial fleet has secured almost all of the rebel base. We just need to take out Commander <font color='#FFBF00'>Lattice</font> and we'll have the whole base.
story.CHAPTER2_6_3: You have slaughtered my loyal followers. You will pay for that with your lives.
story.CHAPTER2_6_4:
Alright, then. 
But we don't have...
story.CHAPTER2_6_5: Stay alert! There are more ships approaching! We can't identify them, and they don't look friendly.
story.CHAPTER2_6_6: We've been surrounded by an unknown fleet!
story.CHAPTER2_6_7:
We have to fight our way out.
Lattice, the choice is yours: stay here and die or fight together.
story.CHAPTER2_6_8: It's possible for us to unite our forces if it means survival. Let's get started.
story.CHAPTER2_7_1: These ships are not part of my fleet. We should find their <font color='#FFBF00'> commanding ship </font>.
story.CHAPTER2_7_2:
I trust your judgement. 
All ships target <font color='#FFBF00'>Unidentified Force Commander</font>.
story.CHAPTER2_7_4: There's no way they're imperial forces.
story.CHAPTER2_7_5: They can't be part of the Son of Cara either.
story.CHAPTER2_7_6: Then who? Regardless, they pose a major threat. Our goal is to take them out.
story.CHAPTER2_7_7: <player>, There's no time to relax. The rebel leader is located in <font color='#FFBF00'>Palle</font>, but the imperial forces have been destroyed, so we'll need your help.
story.CHAPTER2_7_8: We'll find the rebel leader and end this.
story.CHAPTER2_7_9: The Empire thanks you. Good luck.
story.CHAPTER2_8_1: <player>, If you're trying to kill the Son of Cara, <font color='#FFBF00'>Assar</font>, then you'll have to get past me first. He's not responsible for all of this!
story.CHAPTER2_8_2: Calm down, fool. <player> is a level-headed commander and won't kill anyone unless absolutely necessary. Right now, we have to find <font color='#FFBF00'>Assar</font> for answers. Let's all try to keep cool.
story.CHAPTER2_8_3:
<font color='#FFBF00'> Assar </font>! Surrender now! 
Make it easy on yourself.
story.CHAPTER2_8_4: We were not responsible for the attack on Raphael.
story.CHAPTER2_8_5:
Can it really end like this?
Retreat!
story.CHAPTER2_8_6: He got away, but he can't run forever.
story.CHAPTER2_8_7: I don't know who or what has us surrounded, but they're certainly not human.
story.CHAPTER2_8_8: It seems like they're looking for a fight, so <font color='#FFBF00'> let's give them some action </font> !
story.CHAPTER3_1_1: What kind of ships are those? I've never seen anything like them. Do we even stand a chance?
story.CHAPTER3_1_2: Stay calm and focused. Remember your training. We can beat them.
story.CHAPTER3_1_3: Well done. Try to capture their <font color='#FFBF00'> commander </font> .
story.CHAPTER3_1_4: They retreated? Well that was unexpected.
story.CHAPTER3_1_5: We have to take the initiative. If they retreat, we will pursue, to gain a strategic advantage.
story.CHAPTER3_1_6: There's no time to waste - prepare your fleet and catch them before they escape.
story.CHAPTER3_2_1: The enemy is within range. Prepare for battle.
story.CHAPTER3_2_2: Engage immediately. Don't let them get away.
story.CHAPTER3_2_4: Computer, initialize message decryption. Let's continue the attack.
story.CHAPTER3_2_5: Well, that's unfortunate. We have no information about this fleet.
story.CHAPTER3_2_6:
Perhaps there's another way. 
Let's check the intercepted message.
story.CHAPTER3_2_7:
Decryption complete.
 Message content: "VIP is in RKA 71-31. Rendezvous after task."
story.CHAPTER3_2_8:
They have hostages? 
We need to save them. 
Right, Lyon?
story.CHAPTER3_2_9: I concur. Let's figure out the details and move as soon as possible.
story.CHAPTER3_3_1:
Coordinates confirmed... destination reached...
Rebel ships detected.
story.CHAPTER3_3_2: We don't have time for rebels right now. With the hostages at risk, our priority must be the <font color='#FFBF00'>Garrison Officer</font> here.
story.CHAPTER3_3_4: Visual confirmation acquired. Eliminate the <font color='#FFBF00'>Garrison Commander</font> and our units will be clear to secure hostages.
story.CHAPTER3_3_6:
Please allow me to express my sincere appreciation for your efforts. 
We managed to stage the rescue successfully.
story.CHAPTER3_3_8: Word of your exploits have traveled far, <player>. I'm sorry. But there is good news: we've discovered the location of the alien fleet, although the we lack enough force to take action.
story.CHAPTER3_3_9: Leave it to me, I will figure it out.
story.CHAPTER3_3_10: I know it won't be a problem for you. According to our intelligence, this alien fleet shows signs of religious belief and a central command structure. The leader is known as <font color='#FFBF00'>the Apostle</font>.
story.CHAPTER3_3_11:
The Apostles...
It matters not, we will emerge victorious.
story.CHAPTER3_4_1: Once you get onto the battlefield you'll feel better. We can't let them flee. Take out the <font color='#FFBF00'>Defender Commander</font> first.
story.CHAPTER3_4_2: Don't give up now. Perhaps we can take their commander alive.
story.CHAPTER3_4_4: I am <player>, commander of Lawsry District within the Galaxy Empire. Identify yourself!
story.CHAPTER3_4_5: The weak and the ignorant will be consumed by the universe.
story.CHAPTER3_4_6: Look who's weak and ignorant now, you scum.
story.CHAPTER3_4_7: The wreckage is currently being analyzed by a salvage team. Hopefully we'll find something useful.
story.CHAPTER3_4_8: Analysis complete.  Many objects remain unidentified. Samples seem to indicate a combination of human and alien technology.
story.CHAPTER3_4_9: Get those samples to the Science Academy for further analysis. Perhaps they can come up with something.
story.CHAPTER3_4_10:
Roger that, ships being dispatched. 
Warning: risk of Apostle interception.
story.CHAPTER3_5_1:
Human! The cargo you carry is ours.
Return it to us, or we will take by force.
story.CHAPTER3_5_3:
Then I have no choice, Commander <player>.
I've heard you are quite powerful. I hope you live up to your reputation.
story.CHAPTER3_5_4: Tell your leader to watch his back. I'm coming for him.
story.CHAPTER3_5_5:
Surrender immediately, Commander <player>.
Return what is ours, and I will let you live.
story.CHAPTER3_5_7: Apostles, exercise caution. I'm here to take you down.
story.CHAPTER3_5_8: Quite the arrogant fool, you are.
story.CHAPTER3_5_9: Turn back while you can. Facing me will lead to your demise.
story.CHAPTER3_5_10: I fight for peace and fear nothing.
story.CHAPTER3_5_11:
You have exceeded my expectations, Commander <player>.
It has been an honor.  I will be back for you.
story.CHAPTER3_5_13: Yeah. They are such respectful adversaries. It's like they are playing mind games with us.
story.CHAPTER3_5_14: The "cargo" has been transferred to the imperial academy of science. We are just waiting for the analysis report.
story.CHAPTER3_5_15:
Warning!
Large number of Apostles' ships approaching!
story.CHAPTER3_5_16:
Attack immediately! Eliminate these aliens.
We can't let them attack our planet.
story.CHAPTER3_6_3:
Do whatever it takes to stop him.
Find the <font color='#FFBF00'>Punisher Commander</font>, and take him out!
story.CHAPTER3_6_4:
We did it!
The next goal, is to find the <font color='#FFBF00'>Extraterrestrial</font>.
story.CHAPTER3_6_7: Don't worry. We can take them! <font color='#FFBF00'> Bring it on </font>!
story.CHAPTER3_7_1: We're completely outnumbered! What do we do?
story.CHAPTER3_7_2: Take out each enemy one by one. We don't stop until we've achieved victory!
story.CHAPTER3_7_5: There are too many. We're going to die here!
story.CHAPTER3_7_6: Commander, we received the communications of multiple Star Zones and all of them have been attcked by apostles, support needed.
story.CHAPTER3_7_7: <player>，things are more serious than we thought. The apostles start to attack our Star Zones spread in the Galaxy in a large scale. Now, I order you get out of the battle field of the Ronea Star Zone as soon as possible. If it's possible, please save the imperial fleet as many as you can.
story.CHAPTER3_8_1: Our task is to fight our way out of the Ronea Star Zone.
story.CHAPTER3_8_3: We're on the verge of defeating the Apostles. The final hour is upon us.
story.CHAPTER3_8_4: Let's do this and get out of here.
story.CHAPTER3_8_5: There may be a usable path to warp out. We're taking it.
story.CHAPTER3_8_6: What's our next move? The Apostles possess significant power. We should be careful.
story.CHAPTER3_8_7: I'm confident that <player> will find a way out of this. Think of all we've been through.
story.CHAPTER3_8_8: Go ahead, <player>. Let's hear your plan.
story.CHAPTER3_8_9: We're at war. We need to lock down surrounding areas to ensure our safety.
story.CHAPTER3_8_10: You're right. I've already singled out the most important Star Zones. Let's keep them safe and in control.
story.CHAPTER3_8_11: Imperial Officer reporting for duty. Other imperial commanders are standing by, ready to be recruited.
story.CHAPTER4_1_1: The mission is to take the star zone back and defeat the <font color='#FFBF00'> Apostles </font>.
story.CHAPTER4_1_3: Luckily these Apostles haven't yet attacked civilians.
story.CHAPTER4_1_4: That's good. I can't wait for this war to be over.
story.CHAPTER4_1_5: The Apostle fleet seems to be in transition. Shall we pursue?
story.CHAPTER4_1_6:
We're at a strategic disadvantage at the moment.
Let's regroup and make a new plan.
story.CHAPTER4_1_7:
<player>, we've identified the next target. 
Let's get a move on.
story.CHAPTER4_2_2: Well done. After this, you all deserve a long break.
story.CHAPTER4_2_3: <player>, I'm surprised that the Apostles didn't attack our planet.
story.CHAPTER4_2_4: I'm not certain either. We need time to figure this out.
story.CHAPTER4_2_5: According to Empire intelligence, a small group of Apostles is escorting a carrier.
story.CHAPTER4_2_6: Time to fight again. We're going to find out what's inside those carriers.
story.CHAPTER4_3_1: Find the enemy <font color='#FFBF00'>Mixed Fleet Flagship</font> and take it down.
story.CHAPTER4_3_3: The rebels? They must have joined the Apostles. Well, they're as nefarious as we thought.
story.CHAPTER4_3_4:
I think I saw Apostle carriers. 
Looks suspicious to me.
story.CHAPTER4_3_5: We weren't able to obtain any useful information from the flagship.
story.CHAPTER4_3_6: Commander, after decrypting a rebel transport communication, we located a joint base of the rebels and Apostles.
story.CHAPTER4_3_7: What's the strength of their defense?
story.CHAPTER4_3_8: According to our data, we have a chance.
story.CHAPTER4_3_9: Let's give it a shot. The situation can't be too bad.
story.CHAPTER4_4_1:
Alright, let's move out.
We're going after the <font color='#FFBF00'>Staff Officer</font>.
story.CHAPTER4_4_2: You have no idea who you are dealing with
story.CHAPTER4_4_3: Human beings... took away the will... the Apostles... are just... searching.
story.CHAPTER4_4_4:
I'm having a really hard time understanding these aliens.
Maybe the<font color='#FFBF00'> Extraterrestrial</font> has the answers.
story.CHAPTER4_4_5: The Apostles mean you no harm. Withdraw from the battlefield.
story.CHAPTER4_4_6: Hold your fire. The apostles here are quite different from those we've met before.
story.CHAPTER4_4_8: These Apostles don't seem to be of the same origin. Standby.
story.CHAPTER4_5_1: Detecting high-energy weapons stemming from the apostles.
story.CHAPTER4_5_3: The fact remains that the Apostles are forces of evil and cannot be trusted. They proclaimed peace then attacked.
story.CHAPTER4_5_4: Let's not jump to conclusions. We know nothing about the Apostles aside from our own experience and Raphael's rhetoric.
story.CHAPTER4_5_5: I suddenly have a terrible feeling. <player>, our planet may be under attack!
story.CHAPTER4_5_6: The planetary warning system has detected incoming ships.
story.CHAPTER4_5_8: I'm getting really sick of the Apostles.
story.CHAPTER4_5_9: I told you they're not to be trusted!
story.CHAPTER4_6_1: It's time to protect our home. Battle stations everyone!
story.CHAPTER4_6_2: The imperial army is finished now.
story.CHAPTER4_6_3: That was just the beginning. More enemies await.
story.CHAPTER4_6_4: Is the Apostle fleet controlled by humans?
story.CHAPTER4_6_5: <player>, this Apostle group appears to be under human control.
story.CHAPTER4_6_6:
No time to think.
Prepare your fleet quickly to deal with the incoming threat.
story.CHAPTER4_7_1:
Unrecognized fleet detected. 
It appears to be Apostle and rebel ships.
story.CHAPTER4_7_2: Inform the humans that we are requesting support for an incoming threat.
story.CHAPTER4_7_3: How can this be? The Emperor - Lord Rasyon - is fighting alongside the rebels?
story.CHAPTER4_7_4:
No time to explain, finish this battle first.
<font color='#FFBF00'>Reaper Commander</font> is our common goal.
story.CHAPTER4_7_5:
It's nice to receive support. 
Onto the next target.
story.CHAPTER4_7_7: Lord Rasyon, why aren't you in the imperial palace?
story.CHAPTER4_7_8:
Palace? 
Raphael arrested me years ago. You can call me Rayson.
story.CHAPTER4_7_9: Is Raphael responsible for the current state of the Empire, or what?
story.CHAPTER4_7_10: The consipracy is revealed: his ambition is greater than we all imagined. Let's focus on defense of this planet before more of Raphael's fleet arrive.
story.CHAPTER4_8_1: So it turns out that Raphael has been the one in control this whole time. What an interesting turn of events.
story.CHAPTER4_8_2: Don't worry about politics when in the heat of battle. If we die, the planet will be in a much worse situation.
story.CHAPTER4_8_3: So... why is Raphael working with the Apostles?
story.CHAPTER4_8_4: I've been confused this whole time.
story.CHAPTER4_8_6:
You know what, <player>, I feel pretty torn about all of this. 
You are an excellent commander but you're fighting for the wrong side.
story.CHAPTER4_8_7:
I never had to choose a side to fight for, since
my planet and crew have all been attacked by you.
story.CHAPTER4_8_8: Have you figured out that I've been trying to eliminate you for a long time? Going all the way back to the battle of the Triffid Nebula.  You got lucky there.
story.CHAPTER4_8_9: They've been messing with us this entire time.
story.CHAPTER4_8_10: Well Duyal was onto me, but he never caught me. I'm still irked that you took back Rasyon. But it doesn't matter now, as all of you will die here.
story.CHAPTER4_8_12: You must be running out of luck. Your time will come soon.
story.CHAPTER4_8_13: I can tell this is depressing for you, <player>.
story.CHAPTER4_8_14: I thought Raphael could revive the Empire. Not so easy, it turns out.
story.CHAPTER4_8_15: Don't dwell on the past, it does no good. The Son of Cara has already returned to the Empire.
story.CHAPTER4_8_16: We've heard stories of you before. You run a tight ship. We're willing to help.
story.CHAPTER4_8_17: I hope you will lead this fleet. You bring much potential.
story.CHAPTER4_8_18: If this has a chance of peace returning to the Empire, then I accept.
story.CHAPTER4_8_19:
May I cut it off here?
Why does Raphael has Apostle's fleet?
story.CHAPTER4_8_20:
I will explain everything in due time. 
For now, we need to determine our next action.
story.CHAPTER4_8_21: We have the Empire's communication center within our sights: the <font color='#FFBF00'>Cien-N District</font>. There we can find all the evidence we need to reveal Raphael's plan.
story.CHAPTER4_8_22: Then that's what we'll do: reveal Raphael's sinister plot.
story.CHAPTER5_1_1: It's the 6th fleet - take down their <font color='#FFBF00'>Heavy Crusier</font> first.
story.CHAPTER5_1_2: Let's end this once and for all!
story.CHAPTER5_1_3: Their first line of defense has fallen. Our next target is the <font color='#FFBF00'>the 6th fleet Flagship</font>.
story.CHAPTER5_1_4: Let's see what they're holding. Attack!
story.CHAPTER5_1_5: Communications systems online. Now broadcasting Lord Rasyon's words to the entire Empire.
story.CHAPTER5_1_6: Each imperial Star Zone is resisting Raphael. If we can support the resistance, we can minimize civilian casualties.
story.CHAPTER5_1_7: I've chosen a military target called <font color='#FFBF00'>Yokozuka</font>, currently under Raphael's control. It can be easily destroyed.
story.CHAPTER5_1_8: Depart as soon as you can. There's no time to waste.
story.CHAPTER5_2_1: Destroy the base occupied by resistance army.
story.CHAPTER5_2_2: How would you feel if you got beat by a girl?
story.CHAPTER5_2_3:
That  won't happen!
Come on, girl on girl.
story.CHAPTER5_2_4: Wait! I'm not an ally of Raphael, actually. I just wanted to see who was the best fleet commander.
story.CHAPTER5_2_5: Join us and you'll be in the company of the strongest fleet commanders in the galaxy.
story.CHAPTER5_2_6: Lyon, can you not hit on someone right in front of me? Too obvious.
story.CHAPTER5_2_7: Don't do it behind my back either...
story.CHAPTER5_2_8: The resistance army has taken control of this base. What's our next move?
story.CHAPTER5_2_9: Let's capture Raphael's resource installation, called <font color='#FFBF00'>Izaq</font>, and utilize it ourselves.
story.CHAPTER5_3_1: We'll need to take out a commander named <font color='#FFBF00'>Sophitia</font>. Then we can take control of this area.
story.CHAPTER5_3_2: It's over, give it up. Where is Raphael?
story.CHAPTER5_3_3: I was abandoned by Raphael so he could get away. Take heed, he is building up his fleet.
story.CHAPTER5_3_4:
This again?
Why does it always have to be like this?
story.CHAPTER5_4_1: Raphael's tricks are getting pretty stale.

story.STORY_FLEET_2:
Lyon is one of the Lawsry Star District Guard members. Unlike Sylver, he was lowborn from a junior military officer family, and had been a warrior from a very young age. The Empire’s long-lasted warring state produced masses of professional soldiers, and aristocratic families from generations of soldiers. Those from such powerful families were often entitled to better education, which translated into a life and death asset in the battlefield. Unfortunately, despite his extraordinary gift, Lyon didn’t get the opportunity to attend the best Conservatory when he was a teenager. 

Lyon’s father was once the lieutenant to a major general on the Empire Main Star who was exiled for unknown reasons. His parents had settled on the first planet of Lawsry for 7 years when Lyon was born. 

In spite of his own career setback, Lyon’s father hoped to train Lyon to become an excellent warrior. For a veteran who had been in real battles, with rich experiences, he was distressed by the fact that Lawsry’s Sergeant School was only tasked to train ordinary soldiers that would be taught only fighting skills and compliance. Given that Lawsry was too far away from the Main Star, to provide more to help for his son in battlefield, he returned to the warship after years of retirement to coach Lyon on in-field fighting skills and strategic deployment.
Thanks to his father’s guidance, Lyon became one of the few brilliant sergeants of the Lawsry Star District Guard. What’s more, he was able to survive the cruel Triffid Nebula Battle.
story.STORY_FLEET_4:
Lawsry Star Zone was located on the border of the Galaxy Empire. This place was not a strategic strong hold, and did not produce any valuable resources. The empire often hired the militia to guard this place.
Sylver was the daughter of a farmer on the outskirts of Lawsry. When a pirate vessel landed on their vegetable field, her father demanded the whole family to hide in the cellar. However "lady boy" Sylver didn't do so. Sylver who had been adventurous from a young age shouted "coward" before charging towards the interstellar pirates with a hunting rifle.

Sylver's bravery alone of course was not enough to save the farm. When Sylver, a teenage girl, shot the first bullet from the hunting rifle, the captain of the Lawsry SDF who received pirate warnings arrived. Lyon who just graduated from Conservatory was also here. The Captain ordered Lyon to protect the brave girl. It was maybe from then that Lyon and Sylver fell for each other.
After repelling the pirates, Sylver requested to join the Self-defense force. Her father agreed reluctantly. Although Sylver had already surpassed the maximum age to attend Conservatory, she was granted the right to join the Self-defense force due to her valiant attempt to stop the interstellar pirates.
A new recruit was not allowed to set foot on the battlefield. But years later, Sylver became Lawsry Star Zone's vivid striker. She and Lyon, as soldiers of Self-defense force, protected the beautiful Star Zone together.
story.STORY_FLEET_5:
O’Neal was an excellent soldier of the empire, although sometimes he seemed a bit silly in other people’s eyes. 

When he was still a student in military academy, he once stood in a cold wind and started at a target for 7 days because an instructor jokingly ordered him to do so. When students found him half-conscious and carried him to hospital, that instructor lost his job.

When preparing to join the army, he was unable to read the oath of service since there was a problem with the print job. He became the only student in the empire who did not take an oath that year, but he was still highly praised by high-level officials.

When his superior, Rachel, left the empire to join the Sons of Cara, she left a message for him. She said that without having made an oath of service to the empire, there was no betrayal to his empire. 

When Rachel’s death was  confirmed, he found that the leader of the current fleet was colluding with aliens to enslave human beings. He asked to fight in the front line, and after the defeat, he voluntarily joined new teams. This meant he was able to bring valuable information to the commander and expose the conspiracy of betrayers colluding with aliens to steal empire technology.  

Surely many people thought O’Neal was silly, but on the ancient planet Earth, there was a very famous saying: “the wise may appear foolish.”
story.STORY_FLEET_6:
Pirates lied in the shadows behind a planet, fatally attacking merchant vessels, and exchanging hostages for gold coins and freedom. This is the life of pirates!

Gonzalo was the most powerful star pirate. He was once the leader of the famous “Blue Skeleton” pirate fleet. His unique trap tactic, which captured ships and stopped their movement, gave the star police a big headache. If he had not met a certain person, Gonzalo would probably have been a pirate leader for the rest of his life.

On the 370th year of the Empire Calendar, whilst Gonzalo was attacking an interstellar passenger boat, he met the woman who would change his life. Cupid shot his arrow through Gonzalo’s heart. A female commander, called Rachel, concealed her identity and hid amongst passengers of a boat. When the boat was being attacked by Gonzalo’s pirates, Rachel led a number of untrained passengers who fought back against Gonzalo, and caused the unexpected death of his second in command. 

Of course, ordinary passengers could not defeat experienced pirates. Rachel was wounded and taken prisoner on board the “Blue Skeleton” where Gonzalo took very good care of her in the hope that she would accept him. However, when Rachel had fully recovered, she escaped by taking a small size ship. She left behind a letter for Gonzalo, written on napkin. Her message was that as “the Empire was in unprecedented danger, she could not abandon the Empire at this moment” 

On the deck of “Blue Skeleton”, Gonzalo held the letter, deep in his heart.
story.STORY_FLEET_7:
After Raphael rebelled, a part of the fleet was loyal to the Emperor. Under the banner of Son of Cara, they fought against the standard empire army. On the other hand, they were searching for the Emperor in secret who was under house arrest. And Before the truth about the rebellion came to light, the real “Son of Cara” fleet were categorized as a rebel force and hunted in all territories. Further, some real desperados recruited by Raphael, who also carried the name “Son of Cara”, planned to subvert the human beings along with the Apostles under Shadow Will’s control. 

When drifting in the universe, the real “Son of Cara” had recruited many civilian soldiers just in order to fight against Raphael’s pursuing forces. Among these non-official organizations there were many elites. One of them was Ace pilot Raikkonen. 

Raikkonen started his career as a business boat driver. Later, he spent more time in a Guard organization providing protection services for business boats. When “Son of Cara” took in this interstellar Guards, Raikkonen’s rich driving experience, and the battle skills learned in the Guards made him stand out from the crowd. He became one of the best commanders in the fleet. 

However, after being in the fleet for a period of time, Raikkonen found that the fleet had very strict rules and a very strict management structure. High-level officials were not like normal people. “Son of Cara” was a rebel force hunted by the Empire, but it had qualities and battle capabilities far beyond those of the normal rebel forces. However, it is not important who is the boss, Raikkonen thought that. If you did not die young on the battlefield, then you would have saved some money so that when you were too old and your nerve response was not up to speed with battleship control, you would be able to buy a small planet on which to live peacefully in retirement.
story.STORY_FLEET_8:
From the time he received the distress signal from Lord Rasyon, Assar knew he had encountered a dilemma. This was truly a great opportunity to help the emperor, but he knew his career would be forfeit if he failed.

Raphael had captured the Emperor, and with him had captured the power of the Empire. According to the distress signal, the Emperor had no idea where he was. Finding one man in the expanses of the galaxy is like finding a needle in a haystack. A few task forces had already failed in finding the Emperor, so Assar decided to take it upon himself. He would either go down as a rebel, or live to be the hero that saved the Emperor.

Before Raphael could form an effective interception network, Assar assembled a fleet in secret and departed from the Empire’s home planet. He decided to name the operation “Sons of Cara,” whose mission was to lead the commanders who followed him to carry out a secret rescue mission. Once the message that the Emperor had been had spread across the galaxy, there was no telling what kind of terrible things the madman Raphael would do.

Due to a lack of imperial supplies, Raphael decided to buy from black markets on remote planets. When he lacked fighters, he simply recruited some from civilian forces or hired mercenaries. Raphael sent out pursuit forces constantly, but since the first distress signal from the Emperor was received, no further information had been gathered. As the commander of Sons of Cara, Assar was not only responsible for the honor and lives of those who followed him, his mission would impact the entirety of this Galactic Empire.
story.STORY_FLEET_9:
Scarlet was the Empire fleet's renowned female commander. Not many people knew what she did to stay calm and relaxed. She would sometimes fold origami or play with kittens in her room.
Scarlet was born in an influential warlord's family. As a family from a military background in the empire, her aged father expected a lot from his baby girl. Her mother came from a rich family, a woman who closely followed social norms and laws, someone who didn't have many personal opinions, but was gentle and virtuous. At a young age, her father sent her off to the Empire Main Star 13 light years away to receive military training, in order to extend the family honor and glory.

The young girl towed a suitcase taller than herself to the girls' military academy. No doubt this gave Scarlet the best education, independence, and combat abilities. However being away from family at a military academy for such length of time also negatively affected her childhood. As she grew up into a young adult, Scarlet became rebellious, and not many people knew what was really going on in her mind. This undefeated female commander was soft inside, but never accepted any of her pursuers who were looking for love. 
 After the loss of her father, Scarlet decided to head all alone for an Apostle invaded district, leading the local civilians to fight back. To her, life was only one part of the fighting. Scarlet would often look at her slender hands then form a fist. On a war-ship, she believed only she could control her own fate.
story.STORY_FLEET_10:
Duomilian’s ancestors were merited officials who followed the first emperor. When the historic Galaxy Empire of mankind was founded, his family received rewards from the Emperor, and became a nobleman able to pass on the title of viscount from generation to generation. Duomilian was proud of fact that every head of this family knew how to ensure the family prospered. If without enough capability, politically or militarily, then it was of no use to horde large quantities of money. As a nobleman, each child of the family shouldered tremendous responsibility to maintain the honor of the empire. 
 
Without exception, as the eldest son of the family, apart from the basic aristocratic upbringing and etiquette, Duomilian chose to study at  Conservatory. Unlike most students, Duomilian understood that joining the army was not just a job. Neither was it another golden plate on the title of nobility. Honorable as a noble title was, Domilian wanted to use the knowledge and skills he learned at the Conservatory to wager his life and honor his family’s name. 

However, even with the benefit of an excellent education, if you had not experienced the life and death of the battlefield, you would never become a real soldier. Because of his noble title, when Duomilian arrived at the battlefield, he was taken care of by the battleship. They gave Duomilian non-dangerous missions, already won battles... He knew it isn’t real battle. He made many requests to his superior to be permitted to fight in the front lines. However, he did not get what he wanted. 

Duomilian reckoned that was probably just war. His aristocratic upbringing would never lead him to any non-compliance. Nonetheless, once he gained enough experience, the day would come when he would prove his worth in the front lines.
story.STORY_FLEET_11:
Cassandra was Sophitia’s sister. From childhood, her biggest wish was to protect her sister.   

When little Sophitia had wandered away while playing, Cassandra first experienced the fear of losing her own sister. Although Sophitia was sent home the next day morning, an indelible impression was left on Cassandra. Afterwards, she told her father that she was willing stop listening to fairy tales, and instead used that time to study war history. 

Most children were unable to voluntarily give up entertainment in order to study. But Cassandra stuck with it. She also successfully enrolled in the Conservatory. 

With her acute battle instincts, Cassandra quickly stood out from the other students. In answer to the other students wanting to know how she sensed danger before it happened, Cassandra would just smile in a mysterious way, and say it was just a woman’s magical sixth sense. This answer was obviously a joke. Battle instincts needed to be constantly trained from childhood, and for that, she had her father to thank for always supporting her studies. 

Pretty soon, Cassandra graduated from nursery major with excellent grades. Her sister Sophitia, who was two years elder than her, had already joined the interstellar battlefield. Their age difference did not matter as they were no longer young girls. They not only had the strength to protect themselves, but when the Empire faced a threat from enemies, they stood up to protect all of their citizens.
story.STORY_FLEET_12:
Rosha District's military command colonel Lester had two lovely daughters, his elder daughter Sophitia and younger daughter Casandra. Every father worries over the problem of education of his children, and as the colonel's daughter this was even more the case.

When the girls were young, Lester didn't want them to face realistic problems nor military practice, but rather enjoyed reading them fairy tales over a candle-lit dinner. Sophitia loved these stories and loved the knight and dragon in the stories. However Casandra was different, she was much more energetic, and liked to dismantle particle guns, much like her father.

The sisters' difference in personality didn't trouble Lester, he was rather pleased. Although he himself was a soldier, his daughter didn't have to follow his footsteps. A colonel's wages wasn't considered high, but was sufficient to give his daughters a happy life.

On one Halloween, young Sophitia got lost. After a whole night of searching someone finally brought Sophitia back. It was after this experience, Sophitia began to change. She learned to dismantle a particle gun like her younger sister, and learned how to pilot a miniature fighter. However, this wasn’t a worry of the colonel's. He would teach anything that his daughters wanted to learn, whether that be fairy tales or combat tactics.
story.STORY_FLEET_13:
Du'doria was the commander of a battleship in the Empire’s 7th Fleet. Like Richter, he was a pain in the ass for other commanders.

They were both normal soldiers from the Palle. Du’doria preferred fighting more than Richter. He believed that human beings could unleash tremendous power when they were on the fringes of life and death. Based on this belief, Du'doria became the commander who liked leading the charge. 

But a battle could not rely just on one man’s bravery to salvage everything. Du'doria’s rash behavior often disturbed the formation of the entire fleet. After one defeat, fleet admiral Brown bitterly berated the commander for being unwilling to follow orders. In a rage, Du’doria threw a battle report, which showed the largest number of enemy ships shot-down, into Brown’s face. Du’doria returned to his battleship "Chick" and left the fleet. 

It was difficult for a battleship to survive in outer space without the fleet’s protection. The universe was full of hidden dangers: Lightning storms, black holes, quasars that gave out tremendous energy, and even there was a chance of encountering hostile alien life forms. It was, however, more likely that you would die from running out of supplies. And the solid ship shell would become a floating tomb in space. 
 
No one knew how long Du'doria could survive after he left on his own. He had turned off all communication devices and made hyperspace jumps before his friend Richter could catch up with him. All contact with him was lost. 

Admiral Brown of the 7th fleet was deep in remorse. Although Du'doria did not like obeying orders, he did have a gift for fighting, and was full of enthusiasm. If a defeat and a quarrel had led to one man’s death, it could not easily be forgiven.

The vast expanse of stars were as beautiful as ever, but just one human life is so insignificant.
story.STORY_FLEET_14:
Possessing a careful, self-disciplined, and virtuous heart, Matthias was the Apostle that got along with others the best. When Matthias first came to the Galactic boundaries, he and Jacob got into an argument with Judas Iscariot about whether or not to try and contact intelligent life from within the Galaxy.    
          
The intelligent life that formed from the Galaxy had completely different social norms than the Apostle's did. These life forms were dispersed. At the same time they each had their own independent conscious. Matthias suggested to wait for Holy Will to do a simulation of the first contact, but Judah used Bug extermination as an excuse to be the first Apostle to come in contact with humans.

The contact was already made, and Matthias could feel from the Holy Will that Judas Iscariot was excited about this contact. All the Apostles shared the same will. They were all sibling-like existence, nothing was one person's fault, and everything could be forgiven. 
Later, Judas Iscariot chose a fate of destruction along with darkness. Separated from the Holy Will, Matthias could no longer feel Judas Iscariot's last thoughts. Further, Matthias could no longer share his feelings with all his siblings. He learned to store emotions like humans and wrote on the back of the last battle report: "Goodbye....return...."
story.STORY_FLEET_15:
The current admiral of the 5th Fleet, Batis, was a tough-as-nails kind of guy and a really powerful high-level general. Before the Triffid Nebula battle, he was one of General Hopkins most trusted underlings. 
In his military career, Batis followed Hopkins and received many honors. He not only had a battle record with more than 100 interstellar victories, but also while facing an ammo shortage, he led a crippled fleet to fight against alien bugs for 5 days and nights. He single-handedly crossed more than 10 blockade lines and commanded the entire 5th Fleet to victory. 
Hence, when the empire needed to rebuild the 5th Fleet, the person people first thought of was Batis. They believed  this commander who followed Hopkins for many years could salvage the broken 5th Fleet. Batis lived up to everyone's expectations and took the job. 
For Batis, Hopkins’s achievements were not a fathomless ocean, but a mountain that could be climbed. Maybe the newly-born 5th Fleet still had a long way to go compared to its peak period, but Batis believed that he could reach the same power as Hopkins and salute the old commander with this new 5th Fleet.
story.STORY_FLEET_16:
Like Ar'turis, Simon belonged to the Apostle's Dojo, and participated in a mission to protect the Holy Will. The Holy Will encouraged Simon with his will to fight. Simon was passionate about the Holy Will, and followed all orders issued by the Holy Will.
Simon believed in his battle principles such as, "offensive being the best form of defense". With the Holy Will's guidance, all Apostles could be seen as one. And sacrifice did not mean absolute death. To an Apostle, the deaths conscious would forever stay in the Holy Will and continue to exist with Apostles of the past and future.
But the invasion of human darkness changed the Holy Will completely. All of the sudden, Simon was at a loss of what to do. He did not know whether a divided Holy Will would continue to be the same. Although warrior should not doubt the weapon in hand and faith in heart, Simon was faced with a problem that had never happened in the history of Holy Will. At a loss of what to do, Simon began to massacre. Luckily Matthias and the humans were able to stop him before he did something irreversible.                                             
At times he would receive Shadow Will's callings, and Simon decided to protect the now weaker Holy Will as his new mission
story.STORY_FLEET_17:
The “Sage Guard” was one of most powerful generals among the Disciples, and he came to the Galaxy just when battles between humans and Disciples became tense. 

Andre was one of the very few generals among the Disciples who was gifted with energy attacks. Andre’s vertical energy attack tactic was invincible on the battlefield. Regardless of whether it was bugs from alien planets, or humans from the Nightmare Planet, no one could fight back against his surging energy, which made physical defense irrelevant. 

The fact that the inferior humans developed special armor that could resist energy attack rekindled the ambition within Andre. Sacred Will stored countless amounts of data and information, but the more it stored, the more difficult it was to obtain or create new knowledge. Andre believed that real men were good at learning and thinking.

Whether it was an enemy or friend, as long as the other party was stronger than you, they had something you could learn. After the defeat, Andre joined the human side. The courageous battles carried out by humans made Andre realize that humans were not like Shadow Will described. They weren’t hearts filled with darkness.

Humans possessed rich creativity, could cooperate with each other in battles, and also made sacrifices for other humans. Andre realized that in the human fleet he could find a new opportunity that would bring about a breakthrough for his race.
story.STORY_FLEET_18:
John was a quiet Apostle.
Compared to other Apostles, John was more like a book, with new chapters written each time. He would contact, understand, learn, but never go out to events. John was Holy Will's documenter. A documenter’s job was to observe and record everything from an unbiased point of view, and attempt to find the truth from the recorded documentation.                                                                                                        When the Holy Will lost its purity, John was not lost like other Apostles. A documenter’s way of thinking brought him more than just silence and loneliness, but wisdom. He respected the Holy Will, followed its guidance and thoughts, and at the same time understood that everything was continuously changing, even without the exception of the seemingly everlasting Holy Will.
John decided to leave the Shadow Will, and joined the humans! This news swayed the Apostles who were following the Shadow Will. Every Apostle knew John stood for "unbiased" and "truth", so what would him leaving mean? John's departure gave them an opportunity to reconsider. Whether to follow the Holy Will or Shadow Will's calling? Which choice is the correct one?
story.STORY_FLEET_19:
Bartholomew was once an Apostle followed Shadow Will，and he believed that orders from the Will could never be wrong until he was defeated by humans in battle. 

If Will believed that the creatures known as humans were dangerous, and it was the duty of Apostles to annihilate these dangerous creatures from the universe. 

But when Bartholomew came to human fleet, he met with his old brother Matthias.
Bartholomew didn't know the matter of Will Split, and never thought that Apostle could survive without Will. His long-held beliefs were dramatically disproved by the facts. And Bartholomew felt so sad.

However, Apostles were not as emotional as human beings. Bartholomew quickly ended his relationship with Shadow Will, and in complying with the new Holy Will, joined the human 5th fleet. 
The newly born Holy Will was weaker than Shadow Will and was often under the state of self-rehabilitation. Thus, she rarely sent orders and instructions to her followers. Currently, Bartholomew needed to learn, a concept known by human beings as “free will”, this concept had already led human beings to unite. Despite the circumstances of no direct communication, they were willing to fight, willing to sacrifice, and at the same time able to unleash powerful individual strength.
story.STORY_FLEET_20:
Carter used to be a regular soldier. If it wasn't for that one battle, maybe this tactical genius would have remained forever unknown, until the day he retired.

Planet Atacama's evacuation battle was the smallest battle in the history of war. After losing the battle, a small fleet, not being in complete establishment yet, protected the evacuating civilians. At the time, pursuing forces were closing in, and their morale was low. Thus the chances of success of strategic transfer were very limited.

If Carter failed, no one would blame the young commander. Battles were full of sacrifices. In every battle the beast named "war" would kill countless troops. A loss battle during an evacuation, no matter success or failure would not appear on battle reports of the Central Star District.

This young man succeeded in helping millions of civilians escape death. Despite the lives of the general and the defeated fleet being taken, Carter over night became a legendary commander and children's idol. Maybe while everyone was praising him for his victory, he was not satisfied himself. Since now that he was busy with all his military affairs,  he had less time for napping!
story.STORY_FLEET_21:
The Emma Empire is one of the most important allies of the Galaxy Empire. As the ruler of Emma Empire, Queen Emma has absolute power. 
All rulers of the Emma Empire insert chips into their bodies to have incredibly long lives. The current Queen Emma had been ruling for 100 years and is one of the most courageous and bold rulers in Emma Empire’s history. Under her leadership, the Emma Empire and the Galaxy Empire allied together as equals. The cooperation between the two not only promoted rapid development in political and economic fields, but also in the field of the military. Together the kept their mutual enemy, alien bugs, at the fringes of the galaxy.

After Shadow Apostle became the enemy of all humanity, Queen Emma herself led a team of the most powerful warriors to join the Galaxy Empire fleet. At a pre-war rally, the queen wore armor and proclaimed to all soldiers of the Emma Empire: “regardless of whose enemy it is, peoples of all empires will join together to oppose any enemy of human kind."
story.STORY_FLEET_22:
Under the pressures of war, the empire had no choice but to ensure everyone within the territory must prepare for war. All citizens had to perform their duty. This included young people of a certain age who had to participate in the army, limiting their leisure time. 
This situation put heavy pressure on normal citizens. Especially young children who were forced to enter military school, and learn combat and tactics from a very young age. The entertainment that brought joy to the people was now gone, entertainment programs had been reduced significantly. The 24-hour battle report broadcasts had made everyone more tense. 

Opal's dream was to stand on stage and sing for all those who loved her and those she loved. But under the Empire's battle preparations, this was hard to make happen. Young Opal practiced singing in hope to pursue her dream, but flames of battle brought disaster to her hometown.  
Shadow Apostles invaded Opal's planet separating Opal from her family. In this hopeless situation, she followed the retreating army to the Central Star District and entered the empire Conservatory. However, Opal didn't give up her singing dream, it didn't matter if it was on a stage or warship, they were platforms for her to perform and sing.
story.STORY_FLEET_111:
By the time "Triffid Nebula's" flames of battle reached the Lawsry Star Zone, Sylver was already an experienced warrior. She received orders to travel hundreds of light years for a "reinforcement" mission.
At that time Sylver was patrolling the Star Zone. As a battle maniac that she was, she rushed to the battlefield as soon as she received her orders. However, a full scale battle was far beyond the imaginations of a SDF (Self-defense force) member.
The Battle of Triffid Nebula was unusually chaotic. Both sides carried the Empire Army's flag. Similar warships were destroyed all over space, becoming unseen atoms. Sylver's communication device was able to receive transmissions from both sides unexpectedly: calling one side traitors of the empire, while requesting for Lawsry SDF's support. 
Facing similar messages, Sylver began to waver. But the battle didn't give her any time to hesitate. Stray cannons exploded near her. Weak members of SDF flee panicked. Both sides battled like the elites of the empire. Sylver's unfinished military training became her downfall. At last she was hit by a stray bullet. Before falling unconscious, she used all her might to get on an escape pod to flee the battlefield, and was rescued by the late arriving Lyon.
After battle, Sylver realized confining her goal to Star pirates was not enough. After Dexter joined the Lawsry Star Zone, she participated in Dexter's Battle Training, and obtained more strength.
story.STORY_FLEET_112:
