Gonzalo had experienced passion enough in the first half of his life, but now the pirate leader was longing to find his perfect love. 

When plundering a passenger boat, Gonzalo met the person he was destined to fall in love with. She was an Empire fleet commander called Rachel. Gonzalo took care of her, hoping she would give up serving the Empire and join the pirates. Gonzalo, however, underestimated the loyalty of  an Empire soldier. After she had recovered, Rachel left a letter and escaped in secret. 

The once all-powerful interstellar pirate leader was deep in sorrow. After several days, and guided by freedom, Gonzalo disbanded the “Blue Skeleton” fleet. He located the position of the small fighter jet, that Rachel used to make her escape, on a strange base. 
   
This self-named “Son of Cara” base was heavily guarded. Guardians stopped Gonzalo and intended to shoot him dead.  Hoping to avoid this fate and draw attention from people in the base, he created chaos at the base entrance. 

However, the base commander gave Gonzalo some bad news. They only saw Rachel’s corpse when the small fighter jet came to the base. He told Gonzalo to not grieve, and was willing to take him into the base. In sorrow and desperation, Gonzalo joined the Sons of Cara and did not explore the cause of Rachel’s death. His only thought at that time was since he had already lost Rachel, he needed to protect her empire.
 
Later on, Son of Cara used religion to brainwash its victims and repeatedly attacked poor people. Gonzalo started to raise questions when enemies appeared, who also claiming to be Sons of Cara. Because of this, the wild pirate leader left the base and joined a new organization to conduct secret investigations to discover the truth, and to remember the love he had lost.
story.STORY_FLEET_114:
Upon learning a scar would forever remain on her lover's face, Sophitia grieved for a long while. As the colonel's daughter, she had no worries for food and shelter. It was her childhood tragedy that taught her the difference between reality and fairy tale.
As an adult, Sophitia became a valiant female commander of the Empire fleets. She denied all her pursuers from outstanding youngsters, and stayed by her lover’s side. Her lover wore an iron helmet at all times because of his irreparable appearance. Sophitia didn't mind it, that scar was there because of her. And the scar was not only on her lover's face, but was also in Sophitia's heart. The scar in her heart didn't symbolize guilt, but Sophitia's love for him.
No matter how strong a person was, there would always be a soft spot in their hearts. Her lover agreed to the promise he made with Sophitia's father, striving to become the greatest commander in the Empire fleets. Sophitia awaited his proposal. She waited for the day her lover would became brave.
story.STORY_FLEET_115:
When he received the news that Sylver had already gone to the “Triffid Nebula” to assist, Lyon quietly completed the replenishment of ammunition and energy, and finished his preparations so that when the order arrived, he already had a plan for the worst scenario. 

Lyon knew clearly that in large-scale battles, the strength of the Lawsry SDF was barely enough. His advantage was not speed, but if he could not catch up with Sylver’s ship and fight beside her, he would try his best to defend or carry out strategic retreat. This fact made Lyon more grateful for his calmness. There was no question that being unable to fight beside Sylver put her in danger, but the careful preparation finally let them both return to Lawsry alive. 

When Lyon reached the battlefield, half of the first wave of the self-defense force was already dead. Although Lyon worried about Sylver’s safety, he had no choice but to order the remaining soldiers to retreat, using the wireless channel. He tried his best to use the cambered surface formation so that the guardians on the outside could provide a shield against cannon fire and protect the other damaged battleships on the inside.  

On returning to Lawsry, after watching comrades towing back depleted energy, and seeing Sylver in a coma, he realized that strength in large-scale battles was very important.
 
But this battle changed Lyon’ military career. He received respect from his comrades, and attention from some high-level Empire officials, because of his excellent management of the Lawsry SDF’s retreat. He got the opportunity to study at Empire Main Star. The new president, Raphael, expressed his wish to keep him in the Central Star District. However, Lyon refused. In his heart, his father Sylver, his comrades, and Lawsry were his home.
story.STORY_FLEET_116:
Three months after Du'doria had left the fleet, alone, the Empire wrote his name in the Death List.
 
Six months after Du'doria's left, Richter, who believed that Du'doria could cause even more damage, was listening to a special radio station. It was the “pranksters band wave” they used as military academy students. Richter's instincts told him that Du'doria was still alive, and that sooner or later he would use that band wave again. 

When he had almost fallen asleep, Richter was woken by a series of electrical sounds. He knew someone was getting on this radio. Refreshed, Richter decided to berate Du'doria for having left his friends behind in a rage, wandered in space alone. He was not being faithful to his friends.
 
The earplugs eventually started to make a sound, but Richter found that it was not a sound he was familiar with! The voice of a stranger laughing was coming from his earplugs. However, before he threw away the earplugs, the sound of Du'doria’s voice finally emerged.
 
Du'doria told Richter that interstellar drift was full of great excitement and challenges, but at the same time it was also full of dangers. He landed on a planet two weeks ago and met the bugs. After killing a few bugs, he went straight into outer space. The bugs, however, pursued him relentlessly. After he had crossed three stellar systems the battleship “Chick” was forced into a corner. At that time Du'doria was already prepared to blow up his ship and die with his enemies.

But fate decided that Du'doria would not die anonymously. He met a traveler from the Freeza Planet, and they became friends.
“I am very interested in your sufferings, so come back my friend”. Richter thought of how boring the ship was without Richter. He started to store a large quantity of fine wines, for people from the Freeza planet liked fine wines. With new friends joining in, the future looked bright.
story.STORY_FLEET_117:
Claus often wore Santa clothes and did not care about other people’s opinion. He always remembered the Christmas Eve 10 years ago in a small town on Jasmine planet. He was wearing Santa clothes and distributing gifts to children. It was on that night he met Laura, a beautiful woman, who had an eye disorder.
 
Laura saw the world as chunks of different colors and could not see the details of things. She had suffered from this condition since birth. The doctors have said she has an incurable genetic flaw. 

On that chilly Christmas night, Laura was moved by a man dressed as Santa distributing gifts to children. They quickly fell in love and later had a cute baby.  

Later on, the super-battleship, “Primus”, built by Apostles and controlled by Raphael, invading the Ferre star district. The Jasmine planet where Laura lived had also been affected by the war, and was turned to ruins. 

Claus never showed sorrow in front of people. He always wore a Santa outfit in one fierce battlefield after another. He did not fear death. Nor could he forget the memories and the yearning, and, he always was prepared to be reunited with his wife!
story.STORY_FLEET_118:
Magellan joined the Empire Fleet, but not for the purpose to protect the empire. He aimed to leave his own planet, to learn about vast space.

The tense battle atmosphere made the whole empire more anxious. Star tours weren't something regular citizens could afford. Even some royals weren't able to afford it. If you didn't have an Empire fleet’s travel pass, there was a great possibility you would be arrested by space police while enjoying the sun on the Coconut Grove Star.

Magellan's father was a retired high rank officer of the empire. He hoped that Magellan would also become an outstanding soldier. However, Magellan loved to travel. He even joined the army to make traveling easier and save all those traveling expenses. Magellan applied for as many as 231 travel passes to travel space, at the same time escaping his father's nagging.

But the fleet was not such a casual place. Heroes faced with space pirates and enemies of mankind like Alien Life, and Apostles that followed the Shadow Will. Further, the flame of battle was not a great environment to be in. Companions and citizens were continuously hurt and killed. Slowly, this made Magellan remove his "casual vacation mindset" with the fleet.
Finally, Magellan locked away the space Holographic camera that he had bought with many years of salary. He decided to put all his attention to combat techniques and tactics. Although he still thought war sucked and that traveling was the best thing in life. 
"Of course I can still enjoy space." Magellan told his father with a space phone: "But first, I need to get these fools out of the view of my Holographic camera."
story.STORY_FLEET_119:
The Galaxy Empire was the first unified empire built by humans hundreds of years ago. After countless battles, its beauty, richness, power, and bright appearance had many dark secrets.
At the beginning of the empire, Izolda's family separated from the Vittorio Family, a Dark Royal Family behind all the bad deeds of the empire. This royal family displayed a low profile in front of the public, but its existence lied within the shadows, wiping out any threat that could harm the empire.

From birth, Izolda had military status, receiving special military education, and learning techniques of a special agent. This included: infiltrating, spying, destruction, and assassination. As she grew into a beautiful and energetic young lady, she joined the 4th fleet under the orders of her family. She was just one of many noble to join the army ostensibly, but as a matter of fact, she was directly at Emperor’s service. She gathered information for the royal family, and executing those who betrayed the empire. 

Although she had the honor to report to the Emperor directly and the right to execute traitors on site, Izolda knew this life didn't belong to her. She was loyal to the empire, executing the missions to perfection, and guaranteeing the emperor's control over the army. Of course, she was hurt many times during missions even coming close to death. However she knew crying and being weak wouldn't do any good. She had seen darkness and knew that the world will not be kind to her. 
Izolda always remembered the family oath: darkness exists in order for light to shine.
story.STORY_FLEET_120:
No one knew why Red Coast Planet civilian Volkof joined the Empire fleet, and no one knew when he would leave. The civilians of the Red Coast Planet had a unique vocal organ, allowing them to produce sound frequencies of around 200-300 kHz. The Empire fleet's late General Hopkins had once joked with Volkof, saying if you hadn't join the fleet, maybe you could have trained dolphins. Of course Volkof's response was merely a sharp screech of annoyance. 

In order to communicate with aliens from each planet, Sonia developed a translator. This translator collected languages from over 50 thousand planets. However it was not able to translate Volkof's sound frequency data. Red Coast Planet was destroyed by the sudden explosion of a red giant planet in the galaxy. Now there were very few of it's people travelling around the universe. Translation was not possible if insufficient sentences were collected. No one knew why Volkof would rather talk to himself than provide sound wave recording. Certainly Interstellar Laws deemed all intelligent life as equals, but Sonia was disappointed that Volkof would rather forget his mother tongue than record it.

Dexter never paid attention to the Interstellar Laws. Intrigued by Volkof’s sound wave language, he created a sound wave recording badge. After gifting this badge to Volkof, Dexter looked forward to crack the secret of the Red Coast Planet's language.
Later, the badge transmitted back a large amount of sound wave data, but Dexter never announced any results regarding the research of the language. Several months later, Volkof’s sound frequency only revolved around one phrase: Los niven sodom. The translation of this phrase meant homeland or compatriots. In this regard, Dexter and Volkof were similar. "Los niven sodom" was sanctuary for life that had no home to return to.
story.STORY_FLEET_121:
Flynn opened his eyes and the first thing he saw was a wall of giant test tubes.
Flynn was born in Dexter's Laboratory, his body contained 42% machinery and 58% manmade organs. Other than that he looked just like an ordinary human being, although he could be called the Space Age's Franken.

Flynn's brain was 98% similar to Dexter's brain who had created him on spur of the moment. In the laboratory the only things that was significant was Dexter and the monkey, everything else was seen as an unnecessary and things that could ruin the research. Therefore, before Dexter started raging he took advantage of the equipment in lab, which was comparatively better than that of the empire's, and built a powerful ship to get away.
The battlefield in space was vast enough for the likes of Flynn, a "freak", who had a unique birth and experience.
A 2% differential in the brains of Naga and Dexter, allowed Flynn to leave the lab and travel to other places. Although he also liked technology and was abnormally smart, rhythms of battle also intrigued him. Being a genius manmade life form, Flynn was not a tragic monster like Franken. He was special, and his technology that had the ability to wipe out enemies warship energy, was welcomed by the commanders.
Flynn was different from Franken in that he wasn't troubled by others. 

To put the good and evil of human nature aside, and not cling to the opinions of others. Flynn was different from Franken in the fact that he wasn't troubled by others, of course, excluding his disappointment about the small regret in laboratory.
story.STORY_FLEET_122:
Retired Marshal Asgard used to be the greatest general of the Empire. In his time, the military power of the Empire had undergone significant development. 

He designed and built the famous Asgard Fortress, an impregnable steel fortress and an epoch-making masterpiece. His fortress was built with sturdy space alloys. Armed with state-of-the-art defense technology of the Empire, the medium size fortress was able to be suspended on a satellite and provide comprehensive defense for an entire planet. Up to now, the Asgard Fortress had become one of the most import strategic assets to the Empire. With it, tens of thousands of commanders carried out defense missions for the fleet base. 

Asgard was also a general who looked out for his subordinates. The prominent General Hopkins used to fight under his leadership. Later, when Hopkins took charge of Empire’s military, he said that he would be nowhere without Asgard. 

New Italy is one of the most important fortresses for the Empire. When the New Italy Campaign broke out, this legendary Commander appeared again on the battlefield! In the lecture rooms of the Conservatory, a new generation of commanders tirelessly analyzed Asgard’s tactics. It was as if a legend from their textbooks had come back to life, and his appearance excited everyone. When the fierce battle ended, the mentor Asgard was part of the winning side. 

Asgard is old but incredibly passionate. The commanders who were lucky enough to see Asgard during the battle spoke highly of him.
story.STORY_FLEET_123:
Zaffrey was a typical person from the Freeza Planet, he breathed carbon monoxide and fainted in environments with oxygen. He loved pretty girls, alcohol and travel. At the same time he possessed characteristics of a delinquent that were highly disliked by the others. 
Soon after Zaffrey, Du'doria rejoined the Empire fleet. They two and Du'doria's friend Richter became 7th fleet's "3 Jackasses". Low-class jokes such as lifting female soldier's skirts were of course not a part of their routine. They liked to spread false commands, making a good man like Chuyamer patrol a desolated star that was 5 light years away on a day off. They also once put cough powder into Khala's food. The poor civilian of Nami Planet's had to take a week off due to coughing. The fleet's commander-in-chief was at a complete loss as to what to do, as their pranks were flawless: everyone hated the three of them extremely, but no one had proof of whom enacted them.

On the battlefield, Zaffrey was a reliable fellow. His unique frequency interferer could clear energy storage on many enemy warships' weaponry. This was a valuable skill in crucial times. When a row of space cannons were preparing to fire, Zaffrey's interferer skill could disable all these weapons, how cool was that! This is why many commanders were beginning to like Zaffrey from the Freeza Planet, and beginning to not mind their pranks. When everyone becomes war mates, a little prank here and there did not matter!
story.STORY_FLEET_124:
The Galaxy Empire was the most powerful empire ever established by human beings. It had the largest territory, and powerful political, military and economic strength. It was the absolute Number one in the galaxy. But the universe was so vast, that the Galaxy Empire was unable to 100% control everything. 

There were still many territories that did not entirely belong to the empire. Among them, the Holy Alliance was a city alliance which based its governing on religious belief. The alliance had its own territory and was relatively independent economically and militarily, but declared that it belongs to the Galaxy Empire politically.

Within the Holy Alliance, Gambit was the archbishop and Chief Executive Official leading seven knights. Being loyal to the pope, guarding the Holy Alliance was his mission. He controlled 3/5 of the alliance’s military power, and he himself was also a brilliant battle genius. 

New Ukraine Planet, the strategic area of the Galaxy Empire, faced the biggest threat ever from dark forces. The empire asked the Holy Alliance, (which bordered on New Ukraine) for military support. For God’s glory and Holy Alliance’s honor, Gambit led 3 alliance knights and joined the Empire Fleet without hesitation. 

Gambit’s position made him unhappy with the empire people who don’t have unified faith. On the contrary, the Commanders of the empire felt Gambit was a powerful comrade but difficult to carry on a conversation with. So People often called to him as “proud Gambit”. 

However, men’s friendship often was developed on the battlefield. Gambit continued to help commanders to claim victory. He started to change his opinion about empire soldiers because of their acts of bravery in battles. When the New Ukraine crisis was over, Gambit and his knights attended the celebration party of fleet for the first time. Despite the fact that Gambit’s smile seemed a little bit stiff whilst drinking with other people, he started to initiate talks with empire commanders. This was really a good start, wasn't it?
story.STORY_FLEET_125:
Elsa’s hometown is the remote Planet Ice, a beautiful frost-covered planet. However, since the icy terrain provided little arable land, the local people lived in poverty. They could only depend on trading furs with interstellar business people for money and food. 

Elsa was one of the Executives of Planet Ice. She has applied many times to the Empire for funds and supplies with which to exploit the rich reserves of mineral ores located deep beneath the ice fields. If she could persuade the Imperial Government to disperse funds, the quality of life of the locals would be greatly improved. However, the inspection delegation always came to the same conclusion, that manpower and material resources invested for exploitation, and the cost for transportation of the mineral ores back to the Empire, would be much greater than the value of the mineral ores themselves. This was a frustrating reality, but Elsa did not want the people to live in endless poverty. During the fifth inspection of Planet Ice, Diplomat Sokolov noticed Elsa’s frustration. Elsa's care for the local residents made a deep impression on Sokolov . He told Elsa that it was not necessary for her to rely on the Imperial Government, and that she could raise funds by building her reputation. The galaxy was not peaceful at that time. The best way to build interstellar reputation was to participate in wars. After some reflection, Elsa heeded this advice. The residents of Planet Ice were gifted in combat, thanks to their rich experience in fighting against the tough environment and ferocious beasts. Actually, the icy environment itself offered some unique advantages. Local scientists were able to develop a brand new way of deep freezing after being inspired by snow storms. 

Elsa enlisted in the Imperial Forces and fought for the people of her hometown in the interstellar battle grounds. “Tomorrow will be ours,” she said to herself. This was one of the most famous proverbs of Planet Ice, the hometown for which she fought.
story.STORY_FLEET_126:
Nami Planet natives worshipped the strong, and saw nature as god. The most pious believers believed they could receive gifts and realize the power strength from the nature's star spirit. Khala was one of Nami Planet's greatest warriors.
In order to fight dark forces, the Empire fleets Government and people of the Nami Planet signed a peace treaty. Although both sides were in a tense relationship because of nature beliefs and resource problems, the Shadow Will was a greater danger. Khala supported peace with the human beings. She once visited a human city. Human alloy buildings were completely different from Nami Planet's natural buildings. However they were both symbols of civilized development.

The humans don't see nature as important, but Khala insisted that there were things both sides could learn from each other. "The survival of the fittest did not eliminate humans, instead humans developed into the mightiest empire in the galaxy. Therefore Nami Planet had no reason to hate stronger and disbelieve natural selection." Khala persuaded the Presbytery, and became the first of the Nami people to join a human fleet to fight alongside humans.
Khala did not regret her decision to leave her home and join the fleet, in order to compete with human elites. The Star Spirit gave her the gift of miraculous speed and the knowledge of understanding the source of nature. Talents that only the Nami's people had helped Khala in her journey to become strong.
story.STORY_FLEET_127:
How to more efficiently protect oneself, or destroy the enemy rapidly? These two questions were forever the basis for technology advancement in war.

Pele-Bot was a war machine developed by the Empire's Technology department. He was closely monitored by commanders and soldiers when entered in the records. In order to obtain victory of course there were necessary sacrifices that needed to be made. However if winning battles without causalities were possible, that would be the highest state of victory. 
Pele-Bot has a highly fortified galactonite-metal shell, able to withstand 3000℃ and 5000MPa strength extension, carrying a high speed processor with 1 billion interspace tactics, able to react to any situation on the battlefield. At the same time Pele-Bot carried an electromagnetic shock device that only robots could withstand. It had no fear, no change of fatigue and would never disobey an order. Qualities he had that humans couldn’t possible to have.

However, if the intelligent robot could not pass the Turing test with 100%, then it could not replace humans completely. Even if Pele-Bot had unmatchable combat abilities, it still needed to be instructed by a human commander. After all, letting a robot decide your fate was every soldier's nightmare. Cold and heartless robots may send soldiers to death for victory.
Technology to replace human deaths was a beautiful wish. Pele-Bot could be seen as revolutionary change, but the empire still needed outstanding soldier's to join for the wellbeing and freedom of human beings!
story.STORY_FLEET_128:
For his empire, the name Lance became a legend. 
He started out being a normal soldier. He kept wining honors and glories on the battlefield. Innumerable battles led him to the creation of the “Accumulator-defense-counterattack” tactic. This simple, unique yet very effective tactic led him to one victory after another, finally receiving the military rank of lieutenant general. However, the Empire became concerned about his rising reputation, and transferred Lance away from the battlefront, and appointed him as first-tier mentor in the empire military academy. 

This act did not anger Lance. He went about doing his own job diligently, spending his spare time in the library, and conducting tactical simulation interaction with other students. For Lance, this was an excellent opportunity, helping him relax the nerves that tensed up during battle and allowing him to absorb new knowledge. The Empire had no absolute advantage on the battlefield. Lance believed there would be a day when he would return to the battlefield. 

Finally, his opportunity came. The most mysterious officer of the Empire, Sokolov, was attacked while he exploring the universe. After many rescuing commanders had failed, they turned to the invincible and legendary Lance. They all presented a petition to the Empire to allow Lance to return the battlefield. For Sokolov’s safety, and because of their trust in Lance’s ability, the Empire eventually reappointed Lance and sent him to rescue Sokolov. 

Lance’s reputation reached its peak after successfully rescuing Sokolov from multiple blockades, and returning him to safety. Lance became the Empire’s first general who had a humble upbringing! While the Empire awarded him innumerable honors, it also realized that “The Empire Shield” couldn’t be hidden in the storehouse forever; Lance’s best position was on the interstellar battlefield.  

One can obtain unparalleled achievements if they use entire life to only on truth. That’s what Lance did, “Accumulator - defense - counterattack” was his one and only tactic and well tested truth.
story.STORY_FLEET_129:
When the Highland Star district was was attacked by alien forces, many perished and almost all human settlements were destroyed.         
     Kit was one unfortunate victim who lost her family in the attack. Commander Scarlett adopted her as her own.
      Kit was determined to attend the Imperial Academy to protect civilians from tragedies like the one she experienced herself. As it would turn out, she was a prodigy, as the youngest student to attend the Academy while also receiving perfect marks majoring in the Protector class. She later became the only exception to the Emperial Fleet age requirement. 
      Nicknamed ""Morningstar"", because she represents the hope of the dawn after the darkness of the night.
story.STORY_FLEET_130:
Ar'turis was an Apostle of the Holy Will. He always wore a complete set of metal armor and mask. Thus no one ever saw his true appearance. 
When the Shadow Will attempted to annihilate the humans, the virtuous Apostle stood by the humans' side. Humans and the Apostle built the renowned Planet Bayern's Iron Eagle Fortress. And Ar'turis was the strongest among the Apostles helping the humans to build this Fortress.
Ar'turis once belongs to the Apostle's Dojo, an organization symbolizing Holy Will's military force and guarantee. While Holy Will was still annihilating the Alien bugs, Ar'turis was one of the first to come in contact with humans. What was unfortunate was the human representative at the time, Raphael.
The Apostles, who shared one consciousness, could not rival Raphael. Raphael invaded the Holy Will, a portion of Apostles were contaminated and controlled by the Shadow Will. And Raphael used this to overthrow the human's Galaxy Empire.
When the war between the Shadow Will and humans reached Planet Bayern, which is only 12 thousand light years away from the Empire Main Star, Ar'turis was the first one to volunteer to help the humans who were heading for the furious battlefield.
During this disaster, humans and the Apostles suffered heavy casualties. All this was initiated by Ar'turis, who also wanted to be the one to end it. Those already dead could not be brought back. Therefore Ar'turis was determined to fight until the end.
story.STORY_FLEET_131:
“Even with 70% of their body destroyed, the bugs are able to be revived as long as their hearts are well-preserved. Complete regeneration takes about 48 hours, and during that time they have no way of fighting.”(Galactic Lives, Ch. 1023, “Bugs”)

Bugs are of the most destructive races in the universe. War and destruction is simply in their blood. On their planet, apart from the Queen who does nothing but lay eggs, all other inhabitants are warriors. They have simple minds, and their sole intent is to protect their Queen. Their highly evolved bodies allow them to stand atop the food chain. In their bug society, losers have only two options: either become food for the victors, or become workers who produce food. To them, being a worker is even more humiliating than becoming food.

After building giant Slavebugs capable of interstellar travel, the bugs starting traveling around the universe in their Slavebugs, parasitically sucking the life out of planets on their way to expansion. Since they are hellbent on destruction, they left every planet they touched barren and uninhabitable. Soon, they became the pests of the universe. Once the bugs invaded our Galaxy and started destroying the Empire’s colonies, the heroes of our Galaxy were called in to save the day. Our heroes were shocked by the terrible power of the bugs, but after a long battle they finally managed to defeat them. 

After the battle, specimens collected by Sonia were found to have mutations. After their bodies were soaked in a special liquid culture, the bugs started to regrow! Their vitality is truly shocking. The Minister of Technology launched a program with the intent of developing brain chips with which to control the bugs. If their dread power could be harnessed, there would simply be no stopping our fleet. Fortunately, the program was a success, and a chip was placed inside specimen KI_112’s brain. This reborn warrior would now obediently follow any command issued to it. 

“Kraing the Destroyer is reborn, and he has joined our human race!” Sonia was shocked to hear this news come from the television just as she was watching her 7 year old son happily playing as the bug warrior in his virtual reality game! "
story.STORY_FLEET_132:
A person who didn't like war became one of the greatest commanders in all of space. Many knew that Carter's dream wasn't on the battlefield, but no one would underestimate this man seemingly in free and leisure status. The fleet, in which he commanded, known by the enemy as a fleet was able to miraculously victory on the battlefield no matter how dangerous the situation was.  And he acquired the name of Magician of the Battlefield.
Carter delivered many letters to quit his post. People who didn't know him thought this was an act of modesty because of his youth but with honors and glories in battle. Only his friends knew, Carter's ideal life was to drink tea on a sunny afternoon (if there was alcohol even better), read historical books, or play chess with a friend. He did not want to be on the battlefield with particle cannons and traps everywhere, gambling away the lives of his comrades.
Carter, after each war, would constantly dream of when this day of leisure would come about. Every time when he lied on the soft sofa with his dark hair blocking out the bright lights on the ceiling, he would feel, these days would come soon, just after the next victory.
story.STORY_FLEET_133:
Before inheriting the throne, Queen Emma once left her territory to go to the Galaxy Empire alone. 
Although both imperial systems were monarchies, there were big differences between the Galaxy Empire and the Emma Empire in the ways they ruled. Rulers were changed more frequently in the Galaxy Empire, but the Galaxy Empire had no religious affiliations. 
As the Galaxy Empire is the most powerful in the galaxy, this short trip enlightened Emma on how to rule effectively. This advantage gave her her a distinct advantage compared to the other contenders to the throne, so when the time came to select the next Queen, she was chosen as Queen Emma V. 
Before her, the title of Queen was more symbolic than anything. Although according to the law she has absolute power, but the complex bureaucracy made it extremely difficult for her to claim total power. After Queen Emma inherited the throne, she enacted several large-scale political reformations which not only downsized institutions and got rid of unnecessary officials, but also appointed people close to her to increase her power. Moreover, she formed an alliance between the Galaxy Empire and the Emma Empire. The power of the two together was immense, at least when facing an invasion. The alliance between the two brought distinct advantages to both empires. 
“Although she is a woman, she possesses the most powerful skills and abilities in the Emma Empire’s history. Under her leadership, she will usher in a new period of great prosperity.”
— (Galaxy Empire Interstellar Paper)
story.STORY_FLEET_134:
Opal was a commander of the empire's fleet. Her graceful silhouette was seen on the star battlefield. What's special is that she was also a renowned artist here. No matter if it was the brave warriors on the battlefield or civilians hiding in their homes, they were all inspired by her voice. Opal was also publicly known for her stand against war.
The only thing war brought was wounds. No matter it's the sacrifice on flesh, culture, art, or mentally tired and fears. What's most unfortunate is that reality won't change because of a few people's wishes.
However the bugs continuously attempted to invade the galaxy and the Shadow Will commanded its Apostles to annihilate the humans. Opal was against the war, but war kept forcing her back into the warship to fight. Opal's battle tactics were not the greatest of the fleet, but she hoped her singing could bring hope to the people, and provide a place where people could rest their minds temporarily from harsh war.
story.STORY_FLEET_136:
The human city known as the "City of Furious Wind" is located at the Andromeda Galaxy (Messer 31 star system). Its time of construction had always been a mystery. It was 700,000 seconds distant from the Galaxy, outside the area governed by the Galaxy Empire. That indeed was where Celeste came from.

No one knew why this young and powerful girl left the city of furious wind and went to the Galaxy to join the battle for Heart of Emerald. It was even more strange as she joined the Empire’s fleet after the battle was over. 

The empire once sent members of the 4th Fleet to collect information from her, but they got nothing. Celeste never did anything that was outside her list of responsibilities, and took no action to investigate the Empire’s secrets. She just kept learning and growing, and used her great ability to claim one win after another. In doing so, she earned the respect of many strong commanders in the fleet. 

Lost in thought Celeste often gazed into the faraway nebula. Cassandra recognized that this was the eyes of a girl who was in love. Celeste never denied that, deep within her heart, there was a person that she was willing to give up everything for. And even though there was a 700,000 seconds distance, she believes that she will be back with great honors one day.
story.STORY_FLEET_137:
Razz was not his real name, just his code name in the Empire 4th Fleet. 
Razz was the founder of 4th Fleet. He used to act as a shadow from behind the scenes and guarded our empire. It was not until his retirement that the empire publicly recognized this powerful commander. Despite all this, no one knew what his real name was in Galaxy Notification. Razz, this code name accompanied him half of his life, carrying too much thing only kept in his mind as well as the meaning of the life. 

After the Eye of Primus was discovered, facing numerous mysterious alien technologies and unexplainable phenomenon, the empire had no choice but to call out of this legendary commander Razz from his retirement. During a special mission, Razz was the only human being who returned from Apostle's base alive. Only he could safely enter the Eye of Primus, opening a way for Empire Fleet commanders to enter this huge technological architecture.  

After Razz stayed in the Eye of Primus for 47.52 hours, the Eye of Primus finally removed its special energy protective shield. 
Razz then appeared at the entrance of the the Eye of Primus, leading his empire fleet to enter this mysterious planet but completely modified.  

After battle, Razz did not go into hiding again, but joined the most powerful fleet. Maybe this fierce Battle excited this retired Commander. He wished to renew his legend. Maybe the mysterious technology in the Eye of Primus made the empire feel danger, they have no choice but ask Razz to stay. However the addition of powerful men, no matter what kind of danger they faced, motivated commanders engaging in interstellar battles.
story.STORY_FLEET_138:
Kilian was once a star spaceship stuntman, and dangerous stunts were his life’s calling. With his gift for mechanics, he made his ship, the Lucky Fairy,” into one of the greatest stunt ships on the planet.

Unfortunately, he gambled away all his fortune after getting awards. His wife was so upset, she broke down in tears and left him. He wanted to quit gambling, but he was already in too deep. In his sorrow, he turned to alcohol to forget his problems. To make a living, he entered the Imperial Weapons Factory and within a few years, became the best engineer there. He later started defending the Lance’s Battleship.

The life of war made him think back on his time as a stunt performer, so he asked Lance if he could join the battles. Everyone thought this was just drunken rambling, but when Kilian showed his skills with a battleship, Lance was shock by what he saw. He never thought someone so obsessed with alcohol also had talents like these. 

Kilian was able to breakthrough and join the team. After fighting many victorious battles, he was appointed to captain by Lance. His improvements to “Lucky Fairy” made it into one of the most special battleships in the empire’s history. Both its Attack and Defense are excellent. Kilian’s experiences with gambling and alcohol have had a lasting impact on his life, though. The effects produced by his attack and defense systems are largely uncertain. But where’s the fun in knowing exactly what the future holds?
story.STORY_FLEET_140:
The Spiral Arm District’s main star, an artificial sun, has never lacked nuclear fuel. It provided heat and light to all residents on the planet. But Violette never felt the warmth.
 Violette was born into a life of nobility and extravagance. Noble girls long for beautiful silk dresses to wear for palace dances. They chat about the rich businessmen of the empire. However, Violette was not suited for this kind of life. 
 Violette longed to see her idol again—Izolda. When Violette was 12 years old, Izolda visited her family and took Violette through the Spiral Arm District in her battleship. The infinite shimmering stars in the blackness of space were so much more beautiful to her than any of the jewels found in fancy party dresses. Izolda was unlike anyone she had ever met before. Her grace and heroic spirit won over Violette’s endless admiration. 
 She yearned for cosmic adventures against her father's wishes. She escaped her life of luxury and from the noble prince her father had arranged for her to marry, and boarded a merchant ship leaving the Spiral Arm District. She wasn’t exactly sure where to find Izolda, but her courage took her straight towards the front lines of battle. 
 After traveling hundreds of light years away, Violette landed on the Izaq Base and met the legendary Commander Elsa. Elsa really admired the bravery of this noble girl, and took Violette under her wing. After studying with Elsa, she has followed the path of her mentors and uses ice attacks as her specialty. She has become one of the strongest commanders in the empire.
 "A rose isn’t the delicate thing it appears to be, this ice rose is blossoming. - Violette's Diary
story.STORY_FLEET_202:
10 years ago, when swearing to oath at the graduation ceremony of the military academy, Duyal prepared to devote all of his life to the Empire unlike other poor students. 

Duyal was an orphan from a war-time orphanage. His parents died for the Empire. His temperament became strange and solitary. For children, the death of their parents was the same as being abandoned. Duyal refused to trust anyone, and became more independent, but also stronger. 

The director of the orphanage was a responsible old man. He did not abandon him because he was a loner. He told Duyal that just because his parents had died for the Empire, he should not hold grudges against people that had passed away. Instead, he ought to inherit their dreams.
 
Duyal did not let the director down. After graduation he voluntarily applied to guard a remote star district and also performed well in battles. Serving the Empire, receiving a salary from the army, and returning to the orphanage on vacation, Duyal thought that would be his life. He might die on battlefield like his parents did, or he might return to the orphanage after his retirement to care for the children. Fate, however, did not develop according to his script. 
  
On the 370th year of the Empire Calendar, the Triffid Nebula Battle started and shocked the Galaxy. Duyal was also involved. The rebellion ended after two weeks. Duyal joined the battle, and in the end joined the rebel forces, becoming a pirate of the universe. The director of the orphanage, who already suffered from a mild heart problem, became seriously ill when he heard this information. 
  
While the director was lying on the hospital bed being treated, he received a letter from Duyal. There was only one sentence on the special paper: “Be loyal to the Empire”. This sentence was the message the director had given to Duyal when he first enrolled in the military academy. The old man frowned. Was the message returned because of betrayal or were there some inside stories behind the battle?
story.STORY_FLEET_206:
Women usually embody kindness and tenderness, but the commander of Empire Fleet, Emma, was not like most women. 

Emma enjoys fighting and has a fiery temper. From the first day she joined the army, she strived to build her strength. While other female soldiers were out shopping with their friends, Emma kept practicing her own battle tactics. Emma believed that soldiers must know their ship like the back of their hand before achieving real success on the battlefield. 

Later on, after Emma became the first person to use the Quantum Locking Tactic in Empire Fleet, she realized that it would be difficult to rejoin her circle of friends. She stared to slightly regret using the Quantum Locking tactic. The mysterious Flynn joined the Fleet, and these two oddballs somehow became friends. Emma loved to fight with her fiery attitude, whereas Flynn could talk for ages about technology even if no one was listening.

When a deity from a different dimension invaded the Galaxy, the empire reacted and lost many excellent commanders. The team of Emma and Flynn, however, managed to work their magic and successfully halted the advance of the deity. The other commanders seized this opportune moment and all fired at once. The deity was greatly wounded and was forced to retreat back into deep space. Emma and her comrades became heroes of the Empire. 

People joke that Emma married her ship. It’s possible that Emma understands her ship better than most people know their partner.
story.STORY_FLEET_207:
Damon, who came from a noble family, was once a high-level military officer of the empire. When he was younger he gave up his noble status in the empire and joined the rebel team of “Sons of Cara” as an ordinary commander. If someone asked him about the reason why he betrayed the empire, he just smiled mildly, and thought it was best not to say anything rather than lie.

Damon’s days in rebel forces were not easy. Elite education since childhood ensured he was extremely well disciplined, in contrast to most soldiers in rebel forces who were civilian army assembled en route. Soldiers with a normal family did not like nobleman, and some of them were suppressed by imperial noblemen. Damon, as a commander, tried to establish amicable relationships with the soldiers, but in fact it was difficult. Differences in worldviews, values, and life habits made it extremely difficult to communicate between Damon and ordinary soldiers. 

The friend that Damon met in rebel forces, Raikkonen, once asked him, "If it is so difficult in the rebel forces, have you thought about going back to the empire? You do not seem to have any deep grudges against the empire...and even seem to take effort to ease the relationship between soldiers and the empire. This is not something a commander of so-called “rebel forces “should do.”
Facing questions from his friend, Damon could not only laugh, he lit up a cigarette that once only a nobleman in the empire could enjoy, and said to Raikkonen，“I will serve a real empire, no matter how circumstances change, I hope we will always be friends”.
How could an empire be “fake”? As long as he obtained Cubits circulated in the Galaxy, Raikkonen, who from mercenary, would not care about this. As a nobleman, Damon had many beliefs that Raikkonen could not understand, but this would not affect their friendship.
story.STORY_FLEET_208:
Every time Chuyamer was mentioned, members of the 7th fleet all thought of one phrase - good man.
Chuyamer treated others with passion and generosity and never argued with others. At the same time he believed in traditional religion. Every weekend he used to set aside half a day to pray to the gods. And he would often ask for leave. Rather than go to his friends' parties, he would accompany his wife and daughter. He never rejected anyone's requests of him, and in battle he would many a time accept dangerous missions.
Sometimes his friend Green would try to advise him to not be so easy-going. Obviously it was not a bad thing with friends, but there were others who abused him. But Chuyamer just laughed it off; he only cared for his friends, and thought there was no reason to haggle over things like that.
At times if you give more, more will come back to you. Chuyamer was not the best commander, but he was a person you could really trust. On the battlefield when you could die at any moment, trust could increase your rate of survival, and could bring the Goddess of Smile to all of the people. In the battle of Triffid Nebula with mortality rates of 87.92%, Chuyamer's team was one of the only teams where all members survived.
story.STORY_FLEET_209:
Richter, in Empire 7th Fleet, was a man who looked calm but was in fact crazy. 

He was a lady’s man in the fleet. He once, on St.Valentine’s Day went to the dangerous Nightmare planet to bring back 30,000 nebula roses to give to every female soldier.

He was also a member of the “3 Jackasses”.  Richter organized the details of every prank proposed by Zaffrey; and Du'doria was responsible for implementing them. It was an assembly line service. Almost all 7th fleet soldiers were pranked. 

Once, in order to win a battle, Richter led a small team to infiltrate the enemy’s main ship, by entering the radiation zone to damage the power equipment. After he successfully escaped, 78.2% of his skin festered and he had to rely on regenerating equipment to survive. 
        
Richter, like Du’doria, was often in ballistic state on the battlefield. In the beginning, he took orders and obeyed them. However, when he was excited, he turned into a robot contaminated by a virus, leaving only “lock” and “attack” in his head. 

Richter was a member of the famous “problem fleet”—7th fleet, but he was not a ruffian or crazy person. Envied by those who brought trouble on themselves, he just followed his feelings and lives happily and freely.
story.STORY_FLEET_210:
Although sharing one will, there were certain differences among Apostles. Like human beings, they had “emotions” and “temperament”. 
Unlike brothers with individual temperaments, Thaddaeus was an Apostle that lacked emotional fluctuation. Devoted to Divine Will made him able to obtain more enlightenment, but when Divine Will was invaded by darkness, it was a catastrophe for those as pious as Thaddaeus. 
At first, Thaddaeus instinctively followed the Shadow Will affected by evil, but he was suffering from dark emotions that had been shared by Shadow Will with all Apostles. Up until Thaddaeus met Matthias on the battlefield when fighting with human beings, Thaddaeus thought that other than following the Will, Apostle he could choose another road. 
Now Thaddaeus had fully blended in with the human fleet, and his locking skills had brought him great honor. Although humans are different from Apostles, that did not mean that these differences were insurmountable between the two races. Thaddaeus and his brothers, together with human commanders, kept fighting to stop Shadow Will."
story.STORY_FLEET_211:
Similar to Judas Iscariot, Jacob was curious about new things. When the Apostles found intelligent life in the galaxy, which potentially had completely different social norms and individuality. Longing for the unknown, Jacob suggested heading straight to the heart of the human empire’s Central Star District. He wanted to get in contact with this intelligent species.
But later, Raphael's unexpected contact brought a disastrous result to the Apostles and humans. Judah self-destructed to weaken darkness, but Jacob chose to stay and sided with the humans, in order to attempt to amend all of this.
Confronting brings about more pain than fleeing, this is something admirable. And the disaster this time was due to Raphael's ambitions, so no matter what, the Apostles chose to stand strong with the humans.
Jacob remembered the moment he set foot on the galaxy. It was the detection device that found brand new intelligent life. When the long-distance transmitting device received messages from these intelligent species, all Apostles of the Holy Will conveyed the same joy and excitement with their neural signal.
"Humans, these intelligent species are called humans!"
story.STORY_FLEET_212:
Raphael was never just an ambitious schemer. He loved opera, and in his spare time cultivated stellar roses.
 
On the 29th of November, of the 365th year of Empire Calendar, the news that Raphael’s son had died in battle reached Middle-Territory. Raphael burned the rose garden he had cultivated in person, and threw the report that his son’s entire fleet had been destroyed by the bugs onto the burning roses. 

Afterwards, with deep sorrow, Raphael applied for the Empire’s permission to take a vacation in the border area. However, his chosen destination was the Meta District where the Empire army was fighting the bugs. 

No one knew what Raphael saw in the Meta District. After he returned from the vacation, he became fascinated with studying alien life. He grabbed Empire power, and quickly became first assistant minister. When the empire felt doubts about his behavior, he volunteered to go to the border area to explore for resources. It was there that he met with Apostles who had come to the Galaxy System for the first time. 

Standing at the control hub of dead planet, Raphael looked at the approaching empire fleet. He did not try to run. Maybe the next cannon would end the nightmare in which his son had been captured by the bugs. Those bugs were turning their eyes and using giant claws to aim and pull the trigger of their laser guns.
story.STORY_FLEET_143:
Earth, which now falls under the dominion of the Galactic Empire, was once home to the race of humans. However, it drifted too far away from the Empire.

Akhenaton, a Sorranto native, is fascinated by Earth. He has become obsessed with ancient Earth culture and the lost treasures and history of ancient India, mysterious China, and ancient Egypt. He even changed his name to Akhenaton, the name of a revolutionary pharaoh from ancient Egyptian history. 
However, the other commanders laugh at him for what they consider mythological nonsense. They laugh at his stature, at his armor, and at the bizarre, ancient languages he knows that no one else understands. Although their mockery makes him sad, ancient philosophy still has hold on his heart and encourages him to keep fighting until the opportune moment arises.

The “Eye of Primus” battling was fierce, and the blasts from atomic weapons have torn open a fissure in space. What excites Akhenaton the most is that this rip in time has actually presented him with an opportunity to enter into the Pharaoh’s universe!  The Pharaoh’s soul has wandered through this dimension looking for a body to rest in, so Akhenaton rushed over to offer his body as a resting place for the Pharaoh’s soul.

The Pharaoh’s soul of course didn’t completely take over Akhenaton’s body, but it did grant him new wisdom and abilities. He is not only endowed with complete understanding of ancient Egyptian culture, he can use his new powers to bless or curse others. Since the Pharaoh’s soul is not completely yet settled in its new body, Akhenaton’s abilities aren’t stable. Will it be a blessing or a curse? Get ready, because this Egyptian power is rising!
story.STORY_FLEET_144:
Vela'rath was Nami Planet's greatest warrior. According to Nami Planet's records, he had a gigantic dragon as a mount, the support of the Star Spirits, as well as has natural powers – Frozen Energy's Knowledge.       
Vela'rath left the Nami Planet, and explored corners of vast space at his early age. People of the Nami Planet recorded his achievements and praised him, still worshiping him to this day. 
Khala grew up listening to Vela'rath's stories, when Vela'rath appeared at Kilimanjar, she knew, at first sight that she had seen the legendary hero of her tribe. She also invited Vela'rath to the empire's warship and pleaded him to stop attacking the humans.
The humans were shocked at Vela'rath's power, his knowledge of nature, and his surprisingly gentle personality. If he would join, the empire's fleet they would not only gain another great commander, but Vela'rath's understanding of nature would increase other commander's abilities to combat the dark forces of the universe.
After the battle at Kilimanjar, Vela'rath accepted the human's bold request. From this battle, Vela'rath began to understand humans. Despite their use of natural resources, causing destructive results like the ruins of Kilimanjar, the human race still retained nature's spirit of vigor, struggle, and sacrifice.
story.STORY_FLEET_146:
On this Hallow's Eve, there have been reports of strange phenomena across the galaxy. Some have reported seeing the long lost battleship of the fallen commander Brom. As legend has it, commander Brom was the strongest commander of his time. Renowned across the galaxy for his ruthless battle tactics, he struck fear into the hearts of even the most experienced commanders.

Some say he was mad. But a new level of insanity was triggered by jealousy. The woman that he desired was also the most sought after maiden on the planet. He spent the rest of his life chasing away and eliminating commander after commander who dared go near her. Until one day, a determined commander was able to defeat Brom with a lucky particle beam attack, decapitating Brom. 

To this day, some say Brom Bones still haunts the space around that planet, still missing his head like the Headless Horseman. This galactic legend is enough to deter most commanders from traveling through that area, especially around this time of year, the anniversary of his death.
story.STORY_FLEET_147:
In the remote Meta District on the border of the Empire, from the Planet Panru's purple sky, falls the most pure snowflakes. Sheltered from the cold winds, the inhabitants of the planet prepare a feast. Hunter and his family carve up a plump turkey and share their collective joy with each other. But memories of the past linger at the edge of Hunter's mind.
Hunter, his father, and his mother were on a 3000 light year flight when they were ambushed by an aggressive species of bugs. As the bugs attacked the people dreamed of their promised land, but all they heard were the screams of the dying. As they huddled behind the panic room's door they prayed that it would hold. It didn't.
When all hope was lost and the remaining colonists accepted their fate, the Apostles arrived. They executed the bugs but it was to late for Hunter's mother. The survivors followed the Apostles to Panru. The Apostles helped build a settlement with a Galactonite Center and a Greenhouse and even left enough food for the coming winter. As a remembrance for all the Apostles had done, the survivors celebrate every year on the day they landed with a feast. 
After this year's feast, Hunter will leave Panru to join the Empire's fleet. He will protect the weak and help the Apostles fight against the Dark Shadow. He will never allow another family to lose one of its members.
story.STORY_FLEET_145:
The Trickster has decided to give up his former self, including his appearance. He couldn’t care less about the plans and ideas of others. 
The Empire has always labeled him an extremely dangerous person since he has a gifted mind for crime and the means to implement his depraved schemes. No one knows his real name, and he seemingly appeared out of nowhere five years ago, shocking the arm of the law. Around the same time a lawyer named Jimmy went missing, but his disappearance was no more than a statistic.
 Jimmy was just an average Joe who dreamed of becoming a comedian, but instead he followed his parents commands and studied law instead. In a mix of chaos, Jimmy’s family was taken away from him. He had locked innocent people in prison, and this was the revenge exacted on him. Jimmy realized “madness is like gravity, it just takes the slightest nudge to set chaos in motion.”
 Forget about Jimmy. The Trickster is here to stay. He paints his face like his favorite comic book character from ancient Earth culture, but with even greater craze and peculiarity. A purple suit, yellow armor, and a head of bizarre purple hair. He conceals his face behind a thick layer of white makeup, while revealing to the world how depraved and insane a human being can become. 
Do you wear your identity like a mask for all to see, or hide it deep inside? Smile! Fear is the present I give to you. "
story.STORY_FLEET_151:
In the minds of the people, Nick always helped poor people, children, and lonely old people. The young people of the Lawsry district listened to the Empire’s call to joint the front line. The leftover elderly residents spent their time watching the dying embers in the fireplace, waiting for their children to return home. 

This year, Nick invited people to his home and celebrate Christmas together. All the old people and children got together to enjoy the feast. Their happy festivities kept everyone warm even during the bitter cold winter. 

“Grandpa Nick, could you tell me a story?” A little girl asked.

Nick is not good at telling stories, but he couldn’t refuse the little girl’s request. He gave her a little Teddy bear as Christmas gift and sat her down by the stove. After sitting down, he started to tell her a story about regret.

The main character was an empire commander who loved his country and swore that he would protect all its citizens. In one mission, he accepted the empire’s mission and hid his identity. But unfortunately, he was spiritually polluted by his enemies. Under the control of darkness, he became cruel and crazy. He brought a disaster onto his comrades.

Under his comrades’ help, he recovered his mind but started to feel full of regret. So he left the fleet and went to an unfamiliar planet. He couldn’t get back what he had lost, so he started to do his best to help others.

“But mother said everything is forgiven”. The little girl said,” Even though I was sad to see her leave, but I believe that she will come back to me.”

“But the main character didn’t even say goodbye to his comrades. Will they forgive him?”

It was this remark that made Nick realize something. He left the small town after Christmas, but citizens in the town still remember the old man. They decided to keep Nick’s party as a tradition. After that, every Christmas Festival, old people and kids get together and enjoy happiness and warmth, and pray to see their families again.
story.STORY_FLEET_150:
Frost Jr. is a man without a past.

There are many “men without a past” in the empire. Some of them conceal their pasts, while other have completely thrown away their former selves. The young Frost Jr. is the only one who clearly remembers who he is, and yet is unable to prove whether or not what he remembers is true. 

He has flown home in his ship countless times, but the coordinate where he remembers his house being is just a blank space. Imperial files show no traces of a place that resembles what he remembers his home to be: a fairy tale like planet, eternally covered in blue frost. The people there have remarkably long lives and the ability to control frost. On his planet, everyone from young children to the elderly has a kind and sincere heart. All those who visit Frost Jr.’s planet say the people there are “fairy tale frost masters.”

However, regardless of whether his memories are correct or not, he is already the universe’s last “ice master.” Elsa oftentimes goes together with Frost Jr. to the place he remembers his home to be. Frost Jr. never doubts his past, and he doesn’t feel down when others question the memory of his home. Just like a happy child, he doesn’t give up on happiness just because of some bad dreams. When he returns to that place he remembers his home to be, he feels downtrodden with the memories of his past, and talks about it with Elsa. But when he gets back in his ship, he’s still the same fun-loving Frost Jr. as he has always been. In battle, freezing ice is his weapon, but he always treats his friends with warmth. 

“Hey, Elsa! Let’s see who can make a better ice sculpture,” he says while looking up with his blue eyes into the stars and laughing.
story.STORY_FLEET_139:
A widely spread rumor circulated among the Empire’s fleet that Zooey, who put on a brilliant display in the Mandala Nova battle, is actually the youngest daughter of the former emperor. That means she once was Princess Zooey.
It is said that the former emperor greatly loved Zooey, but her siblings envied her. To protect his daughter, the former emperor wouldn’t let his daughter become too involved in politics, and instead he sent her to study battle skills in the Conservatory. He just wanted her to be able to protect herself and not get too involved in the politics. However, this delicate looking princess had great natural prowess for battle, and she quickly surpassed her teachers. She even applied to graduate early from the Conservatory. 
The death of the emperor threw the royal family into chaos. The new Emperor Rasyon was weak, and everyone of royal blood with inheritance rights began fighting for the power to rule the throne and become the most powerful person in the galaxy. The powerful princess so beloved in the Conservatory also became wrapped up in the power struggle. Some wanted to help Zooey claim the throne and usher in a new generation of Imperial fleet commanders.
But while the princess was on her way to graduate, she disappeared! The news was everywhere, but it was quickly covered up by other news stories. The new emperor sent out an emergency message, and those who coveted the throne celebrated the elimination of a strong competitor while at the same time trying to guess what really happened to her. But during those times, the disappearance of a princess wasn’t really a big surprise. 
 When Zooey appeared, some people said that the princess had long since died while on her way to graduation. Others, according to the direction of the princess’ travels, deduced that this was in fact the princess Zooey. Regardless of her previous status, battle in the vastness of space was still her favorite place.
story.STORY_FLEET_155:
F-12183 tried to destroy the hermetically sealed lab, said to have lost control, killed.
The fifth batch of experiments all died, and the gene mutation lab failed again.
        I lifted my gaze and saw that this was the secret lab set up by Shadow Will for the humans. It had state of the art equipment, perfect temperature and humidity control, and was always bright as day. But every living thing in here, including us, are just the Shadow Will’s test subjects.
        The Apostles under control of Shadow Will were getting forced back in the galactic war. To try and make a comeback, they began studying us humans. It was to this end that the genetic mutation lab was born. They were able to obtain some DNA from some of the greatest human warriors, and they hoped to create more powerful warriors by adding Apostle genes to the human DNA.
        With the sixth experiment about to start, Shadow Will decided to use high intelligence, high willpower individuals. Before the experiment began, my assistant calmly took off his white coat and passed through the sanitation passage. Losses on the battlefield made the high quality experiment materials even harder to come by. This time, my assistant placed Shadow Will’s orders in my drawer and stood in my place as the sixth test subject.
        I didn’t want to see his familiar face during the test procedures, as he gradually mutated into Asgard from the human propaganda videos. I certainly also didn’t want to see this strong young man turn into an alien creature or vicious beast. But these weren’t Shadow Will’s orders, these were his slaves. If the sixth experiment failed, I would become the seventh test subject. All of us on the team faced death. Moreover, I wouldn’t have another assistant foolish enough to sacrifice himself for me. 
        A scream broke out from within the lab. Powerful stimulants rapidly mutated the creature, and it threw off its shackles, smashing the lab’s mechanical arm. Our researches tried their best to calm him down, but those two brown eyes shown on the monitor had already transformed to look like those of a beast. There was nothing familiar in those eyes, only infinite pain and rage. 
        I snatched the microphone, surprising the desire to return his howl, and began reading letter he had affixed within the command papers. The Apostles didn’t allow for too much communication since emotions are uncontrollable. Shadow Will believed all uncontrollable factors could harm experimentation, and thus communication was banned. 
        You may not believe it, but S-12978 began to calm down. The gene changes got rid of a subject’s humanity and rational thought, leaving them as a cold shell, a warrior that could just follow orders. But I still believe that the success of S-12978 was due to residual humanity deep inside of him. If not, how could he have controlled his rage once I read the sentence “I love you” written in the letter? He became the sole survivor.
story.STORY_FLEET_149:
There is nothing quite like returning home after a hard day’s work and enjoying a hot cup of cocoa poured by your granddaughter. The old general Katiya of the City of Furious Wind, stood in solitude outside his door. Inside, not a single glimmer of light shone, and the overturned chair remained unmoved from when he had left that morning. 
        When did his sweet memories fade away? Katiya absent-mindedly sunk into the maglev rocking chair, which emitted an irritating buzzing sound when the electromagnetic waves passed through the metal. He took the hot cocoa served by his robot housekeeper and sipped it slowly, but its bland flavor made him even more tired. He considered having the robot make him something to eat, but upon remembering the disastrously peppery steak and awful mushroom soup from last time, he dropped the idea. He missed Celeste’s wonderful cooking.
        But Celeste had left long ago. That damn old geezer’s grandson was such a nuisance. It must have been him who bewitched Celeste. How else could such a sweet, obedient girl just up and leave her home to venture into the galaxy? All just to prove that “true love” exists? More and more, Katiya realized that he didn’t understand the youth of today. It’s like Celeste transformed overnight. Still beautiful and full of energy, but somehow unfamiliar. 
        She remained, however, his favorite granddaughter. He had to admit that he often would think back on the everyday joys of those times, like cleaning the garden or baking in the kitchen together. He of course knew that she was grown up. She would find a husband and have a grand wedding. She made herself a new home and kept busy with battle and her family. She was only able to take some time during the holidays to bring her family to visit. There is no way that Celeste’s future family could me that sinister old man’s grandchildren.
        But the world is such a vast, strange place. Would Celeste be able to take care of herself in that new, unfamiliar world? Wouldn’t she miss her favorite fruit from home. He heard that no other place in the galaxy grew that fruit. He was proud of his granddaughter’s strength, but he could never stop worrying about the trouble a young girl out in the galaxy may run into.
        Soon, Katiya decided to return to the Empire. After all, he was once a legendary pilot. If not for his granddaughter, though, he never thought he’d return to this galaxy. With a whole ship filled with his granddaughter’s favorite fruit, Katiya made his way to the Empire. He swore to keep his feelings in check upon meeting his granddaughter. If she refused to come home, then he’d stay in the Empire.
        Although the development of technology added years to his life, the time he had to spend with his granddaughter was still limited. He couldn’t miss another one of her smiles as long as he lived.
story.STORY_FLEET_148:
When you enter the human’s territory, don’t get eaten!”
Dingo’s twin sister, Maka, offered this advice before he set off. But really Dingo wasn’t worried. Considering the level the human’s civilization had reached, they wouldn’t kill an ally and serve him for dinner. 
A few months ago, the first time human explorers came into contact with Dingo’s countrymen, talks were carried out in an awkward yet friendly manner. Of course, it was just the humans that wore awkward expressions, but the friendly Tuchians didn’t understand the meaning of their expressions. They thought that this fleshy expression was just the way humans expressed kindness.
Later, after deepening their understanding and coming to the empire’s interstellar Halloween party, the Tuchians finally understood the meaning behind the humans' soft, fleshy facial contortions Yes, they called it a contortion. Some hotblooded Tuchians, ignoring the human government’s explanation and direct orders from their elders, angrily steered their ships into the galaxy. In the name of wanton slaughter and cruelty, they launched a battle against the humans. Even though this “Halloween Incident” was later explained by scholars as “Friendly Cultural Exchange,” and didn’t really affect the relationship between the two sides, it must been accepted that in the eyes of some Tuchians, the humans had become cruel like the alien bugs.
As the Tuchian representative hero, Dingo’s understanding of the universe was not as shallow as those like his sister within the tribe. Actually, unbalanced education has always been a serious problem within Tuchian society. His sister thinks this is an obvious plot from the elders. Dingo tried to explain it to her many times that this is a glorious mission for their entire planet.
“As the Tuchian representative hero, you have to show the humans how strong we are.” Dingo remembers well the order given to him from the elders: “You must tell the humans to stop eating turkey. This is the real hidden goal of our support mission.”
There is truly a long way to go in order to stop the humans from eating turkey!
story.STORY_FLEET_154:
Year 50489 of Atlan Calendar - Windflow. This is our first time passing through the space portal. We have come to a strange place. The strong gravity here caused some of us to experience symptoms of heart failure. After losing some of our own, we have hurriedly developed armor that can help balance the effects of the gravity. We of course will encounter many problems after our first time through the space portal, but we trust that under Felix’s protection, we will be able to find intelligent life here. This is our most important goal.
        Year 50501 of Atlan Calendar - Nevernight. We have already used the space portal quite a number of times, and we have been surprised to find that 90% of the places we have ventured to have gravity stronger than that of our home. This certainly is not a happy discovery, and we felt it necessary to make record of it. 
        Year 50513 of Atlan Calendar - Lunar Frost. We saw them! This is such an exciting discovery! They even have a different energy cognition system from us. We cannot understand the element they call “Silicon,” or how it can be used together with “electricity” to produce such indescribable, marvelous  things. We hope to bring these things back to our home.
        Year 50513 of Atlan Calendar - Falling Leaves. We can’t believe it’s actually year 83210 of the Atlan Calendar. It is difficult to describe the heartache. We hope that Felix provides peace for our former world. 
        Year 1 of New Atlan Calendar - Rebirth. I swear to the petrified tree of the world that I will inherit the title of new king after 30,000 years. Distortions in time have buried the past in the year 50513 or maybe it’s 83210. We say goodbye to the rose colored sky and start a new space portal. Though it is impossible to bridge the gap of 30,000 years, with us here, New Atlan will its documentation.
        Time has banished us from our original world. But our culture doesn’t die.
story.STORY_FLEET_153:
“Three cups Darkness, one cups blood, five parts despair, and essence of suppression....Oh! And a spoonful of hope! It’s perfect, perfect! This is the most perfect dream I have ever crafted!”
        Acc’tan is Nightmare Planet’s top Dream Crafter. On this planet, dreams are an advanced science and a mystical art. With the power to create dreams, you can win the respect of all denizens on this planet. 
        Acc’tan dedicated his life to the study of dreams. His approach was to take advantage of the standardized reactants of science to give people dreams like no one had even imagined possible. However, for Acc’tan, who dreamed of spreading his created dreams throughout the universe, found it difficult to spread his product with the humans. The difference in beauty standards between the two races were really quite frustrating. 
        What could be more damaging to the fragile heart of a scientist than to meet misunderstanding and defamation? Ignoring his friend’s advice, Acc’tan decided to go visit the humans by himself. He chose a planet and then diluted his dream making mixture into the water supply so that the children would fall asleep. Acc’tan naively though that only pure-minded children could be the most fair testers. 
         After the children turned into what was seen as an “alien attack”, Empire ships quickly came to the planet in order to repel this creature from the Nighmare Planet. Alarmingly, the alien bugs somehow caught word of the humans’ plans and decided to take advantage of this situation to destroy some of the Empire’s most powerful ships. If their plan succeeded, the human ships would face a disastrous fate.
        During the crisis, Acc’tan decided to make a deal with the Empire. He helped them ward off the attack, and then he formed a secret deal with the Empire’s higher ups in order to join the Empire’s fleet!
        Though those from the Nightmare Planet were often suspected of being dangerous by some commanders, Acc’tan’s original intention had never changed. He wants to better understand the humans so that he can make dreams for them that they like.
story.STORY_FLEET_205:
On a barren planet off in space, Scarlett crash landed near the mountains at the end of a small battle. She looked out into the expanse of the beautiful, starry expanse of space. Commanders fight their fierce battles among those same stars, but without peace of mind, it is difficult to feel the full brunt of their glory. We are so small when compared to the infinite universe.
        Standing there in silence, Scarlett thought of how each one of the stars she could see were once just points on her battle map. Now though, she realized how much more beautiful the stars were in person and not just on a screen. With this chance to relax, she shook off all worries of battle and called out to the stars in the name of her sister Kit. 
        The light brown “Chestnut,” orange “Amber,” sky blue “Dolphin,” dark green “Emerald”... Although there are many desolate and freezing planets, they aren’t necessarily strategic strongholds. With the right dreams applied to the exterior of them, they can become beautiful gifts. 
        But Scarlett doesn’t have time to weave dreams right now... She may be adopted, but she and Kit are like real sisters. Kit is already one of the Empire’s most brilliant shining stars. Scarlett always wanted Kit to just be a normal girl who could grow up without being touched by war. But Kit chose her own path. 
        It’s time to return to the fleet! Scarlett said as she returned: “Regardless of how you made it here, we all share a common goal — to protect humanity!”
story.STORY_FLEET_113:
Everyone in the Empire’s fleet knows O’Neal to be a funny guy, but he has always wanted to be taken as a serious commander. He still hasn’t been able to fulfill that goal, though.
        Where is the problem, he wonders? He decided to ask some other commanders their opinion.
        Batis: “Problem? Lemme see..patrol mission complete, side mission complete, tactics meeting complete...It looks like all is going well. Commander O’Neal, keep up the good work!”
        Sylver: “Ha ha ha, what a cute kid! How can you joke around without laughing yourself too? Lyon could never really tell a good joke.”
        Lyon: “...If you just stop talking to Sylver so much you won’t have any problems.”
        Richter: “ A serious commander? That’s no fun, haha. You wanna join our prank team? Realize your comedic destiny!”
        Acc’tan: “I’ve been trying to study the human concept of ‘humor.’ Why would you question the humor of your own race?”
