Is it possible the humans are capable of even more forms of expressions? Hmm...

Krill curses. He's frustrated to be "stranded" in the Pandemonium. He's learned a lot from the humans since his first interaction with them. This makes him unique, and gives him advantage over the other Lords in the Abyss district. According to Krill, "learning" is a form of "greed". How could you stop the urge to learn and own all that is new to you?

But the humans are so weak and fragile. Krill has been to the human fleet many times, but the humans were too stupid and weak to see his true self. Their ways and habits disgust him. So ugly, with their hairy bodies, protruding eyes; food mixed with digestive fluid entering through the same hole, then exiting through their extracting organs; red, merlot-like fluid flowing inside their bodies. (This text came from the human culture)...

Perhaps the Salamander guy at the Elemental Dimension district has something to teach him...to compress his body and power, and live among the stinky humans of the fleet.

"Krill" is such a perfect name, maybe the human author of the book had visited the Abyss district before.
story.STORY_FLEET_306:
Ooo...hungry...starving... 
Cat keep sending feeding requests to its master, only being electonically zapped as punishment in return. Although to Cat, this level of electricity does not amount to much - it is merely able to kill its parasites. But Cat understands, this is a sign of a mandatory order from its master. 
But why?
So much delicious food, right before its eyes, making Cat drool endlessly, those delicious humans are just within reach, but Cat would not dare to attack without receiving a command from its master. Slave Bugs’ central nerve system is connected to their masters. Even a powerful alien bug like Cat will die instantly from its central nerve system being torn away from the telepathic will of its master. 
There can only be one master for a Slave Bug’s entire life. But a well-trained, powerful Alien Bug Warrior has the ability to control several Slave Bugs at the same time. 
Of course, Cat is one of the most unique of its kind. The Alien Bug race spent one hundred years developing Cat, so that it is able to directly transmit requests and emotions to its master. The enhanced nerve system enables Cat an increase in its destructive power to 200%. The only flaw is, if Cat dies, its master will never be able to control another slave bug. 
Oh, those humans are busy working on Cat’s body. A layer of steel armor covers Cat’s natural shell, Cat hates this cold and hard steel the most. In the times when it can fight humans freely, these cold steel armors cover the most delicious parts of humans, that its digestive fluid struggles to break down. 
To a Slave Bug, you can scold its low fighting ability, but you cannot doubt their digestive ability, because it is like making jokes about their pride. 
Cat hates humans, because of what they created to battle against Cat, who was sent to fight the Empire Fleet, causing Cat to be scolded by the low-class bugs whose jobs were to package foods. 
“Cannot eat humans, cannot attack human ships.” Cat’s master kept transmitting this order to its nerves. It does not understand why it has to bow to these weaklings, but orders are orders, Cat will follow the orders on its life. 
Hopefully there are new delicious foods. Cat is starving. After taking off the steel armor, Cat is awarded with fresh meat. 
Ooo~ although humans taste better, but these four-legged animals are good enough to satisfy Cat’s empty stomach, for now.
story.STORY_FLEET_197:
The faint sound of currents flowing through the nerve-sensing devices, the sound of the tip of a virtual art pen writing on coarse paper; Roxy is enjoying this rare artistic moment drawing at home, during this even rarer vacation. 
The temperature at Gemini #11 artificial planet is a lot higher than the temperature at the Empire Home Planet. An unknown type of bug constantly chirps, voicing its annoyance at the unbearable heat. Even inside an air-conditioned room, you can still feel the summer heat wave. 
The sound of an antique mechanical-clock reminds her of the footsteps of the Devil. Roxy rushes to upload her artwork ten minutes before the editor gets off; she taps the “send” key. A draft-submission deadline is every artist's nightmare. Editors are essentially their debtors. Roxy purposely ignores the flashing requests to connect with her; she shuts her PC down just to silence the editor. 
The best period of the vacation just started. Roxy is planning on taking some orange-flavored pills to get rid of the headache shes is nursing from pulling an all-nighter to finish her artwork - she turns the AC dial all the way up and hides herself under a thick blanket. That editor can wait until later. 
“Commander of the Empire Fleet” is the job title on her business cards. But as well as that, she is a well-known web artist. Who says that an Empire Fleet Commander must always be serious? Roxy says she is hoping to double her number of fans. 
Dual-identity doesn’t just mean double-the-stress. Sometimes it can mean double-the-surprises.
story.STORY_FLEET_177:
Tanyar wanders tirelessly. 

He swats away the butterflies resting on him like he is a moving tree stump. Light from the sunset has cast a long and skinny shadow on Tanyar through the tree tops. Nightfall is coming; vision will be poor amongst the dense fog, which will also gradually take away body warmth. More unknown danger awaits. 

There is a familiar smell in this forest, but it’s giving him a splitting headache when he tries to remember. He does not know how much further he has to walk.

No torch, no suitable camping ground, bodies of lifeless organisms form layers and layers of rotting substances. Countless emerald wisps are twinkling in the darkness. He does not have the courage to slow down. Even though there is a scientific explanation on how wisps are formed, the constant fear continues to unnerve him. He starts to miss the butterflies that are hovering around him. 

All he can hear is the sound of his own steps; the sound of leaves crushing underneath his feet; the sound of his uniform brushing against the bushes; the sound of howling wind; the sound of butterflies flapping their wings...

Sound of butterflies flapping their wings? No it can’t be! Butterflies do not come out during the night! Those green-colored dots are not wisps... they are eyes of Vulturines! This is Tissot planet R_21d, well known for over 78% casualty rate in battles taken on this planet. However, at least three squadrons have lost their lives here before the intelligence leak by the Empire Informant Center! 

Run! That’s not sound of butterflies flapping their wings, but the most-feared killers in this forest! 

Eventually, Tanyar has run into those green-colored eyes. 

He awakes suddenly from sleep. 

“Ah-ha, congratulations for making it through the final stage.” Says Vulturine from Bartorian planet, who works part-time for the Empire as a psychological-interference counselor. Bartorians’ unique ability is to interfere with the minds of any living organisms to a certain degree. The Bartorian crystal array not only can be used on shield and armor, they also have a hallucinating effect on targeted humans. 

Only those who have the courage to face their fear, can conquer their fear and heal from their past. To Vulturine this procedure is just a walk in the park, but to the victims of their pasts like Tanyar, this procedure is their savior.
story.STORY_FLEET_309:
9.46E+009 seconds ago, Sirenne was torn to pieces by the mighty jaws of alien bugs. He was prepared to enter infinite sleep, but he was startled and awakened by a blood-red eyed, blanket-wearing shadow from his dream. 
The moment after he regained conscious, he did not feel the existence of his body. Disturbing current; flashing lights and wandering strings of characters keep penetrating his thoughts... what in the world is this cursed place! 
What would you do the moment you awaken from death? Laugh and jum around in celebration of life? Find your family and push open the doors to a good life? Or go far, far away and live a new life under a different identity? Sirenne simulated a few hundred scenarios just in 1.21E-007 seconds, he looks around him, realizing the “reborn” has brought him a gift that he was not able to simulate. 
This is not the world he once knew. 
He realizes where he is, after another 1.21E-007 seconds. 
Before becoming a space commander, Sirenne entered an amateur Galaxy Computing Competition and finished in the Top 8. That was a great experience for him, at least he wouldn’t be a nobody in the networking world because of lack of computing knowledge. 
Yes, he has become data, a program, or something similar to a computer virus.
Oh, perhaps... starting today, the world just became more interesting.
story.STORY_FLEET_189:
Kerom is a madman, without a doubt, Greene mentioned this when he was alive, he has never seen warmth in human emotions in his entire life. 

Ever since Greene died whilst serving the Empire, no one would dare to cross looks with Kerom. Even though there was no way to verify whether the rumor was true, nearly every commander in the Empire Fleet is aware of this saying, that this is the “No. 1 Rule when you inevitably have to deal with Kerom.”

“But isn’t this quite lonely?” Kerom obsessively fondles the snow-white blade of his triton dagger. Cold steel weapons have long ago been retired from the Galaxy war stage, but his childhood experiences have made him trust weapons that he can touch and feel. Because all technologies have certain limits, for example, laser gun and particle cannon would not function with lack of energy. Greene’s accident has proved this point. That poor man was stranded on a barren planet while the rescue team was delayed and his Oscillating Particle Dagger ran out of power. As a result, he became Vulturines’ dessert. 

Humans are the same, they entrust their lives to something that they cannot understand fully. He rather trust his spaceship that he knows won’t betray him as long as he takes good care of it. Kerom’s file before he joined the Empire Fleet has been destroyed, no one knows the reason for his apathy towards his colleagues or his enemies alike.
story.STORY_FLEET_311:
“Killer bees have a deadly attacking ability. The crude rule of nature has forced them to evolve to a stage that far-exceeds the attack ability of any similar species.”
Stratus just sank the 18th ship in this battle. “The Protectors of Truth” base has been completely flattened, many ships were destroyed before they were able to take-off, Stratus pushed himself to 200% battle ability to intercept the Empire fleet hordes. The Empire has left us no choice, let us live, or prepare to die! 
“Killer bees fights as a group, as a society. They utilize the strong bonds of their group to crush their enemies”. 
Stratus has become a fugitive of the Empire. After his base was destroyed, he led over 100 squadron pals to play a game of hide-n-seek with the Empire fleet. They confused the Empire Fleet by leaving fake traces and killed off their ships one by one, gradually weakening their fleet. Do not underestimate a killer bee swarm. They are well-known for killing off animals that are several-times larger than them by attacking as a group. 
“Killer bees have great reproductive abilities, they expand the population quickly and effectively take over the enemy's resources”.
Stratus has again successfully convinced the scout fleet at Mega star district to swear their allegiance to the “Protectors of Truth”. Not only are the new members the fresh blood of the fleet, they are vital to escaping the Empire’s pursuit!  Stratus appreciates the fact that he has doctorates in Sociology and Psychology, he knows the Empire’s every weakness, and targets the dissatisfaction hidden in each person’s heart. 
“The Queen is the commander of the killer bees, all members of the family group will obey the queen’s commands.”
Stratus proves his loyalty to the fleet by taking orders and accomplishing missions. He once led a fleet across many a star district in pursuit of defenseless prey, but no one ever tells him what do to if the order he receives is “to betray”. This is his 237th day as a fugitive, Stratus has successfully established communication with HQ for the first time, but the commander informs him that the “Protectors of Truth” has surrendered to the Empire. The final order is to lay down his weapons. The foundation of trust crumples in the commander’s voice.  For the first time, Stratus feels disgust in his life.
“Can killer bees be tamed? The question now returns to the creator of the killer bees.”
story.STORY_FLEET_308:
Gunpowder firearms have long since been retired from the battlefield, but that's not an issue for fans of ancient weaponry. Seagal is the proud owner of an ancient twin-barrel shotgun, he made it himself by using archeological magazines and television shows as reference material. As the owner of a steel-making factory, making and putting some steel parts together was no tall task. 
Personal preferences aside, this bulky thing which glimmered with the gloss of cold steel, when compared to modern weaponry is far less efficient.  Even if you were to take it to go hunting in the forest, it would ruin the fur of the prey with the bullet holes. 
But it’s such a pity if you can only view them in holographic images...
As a qualified fanatic of ancient firearms, Seagal firmly believes in his responsibility to carry on the ancient culture. Answering to the Empire’s call to all young men to join the Empire Fleet, he brought his twin-barrel shotgun with him to the fleet as a lucky-charm. A few years later, he even built an ancient-firearms-themed ship. 
He wonders how effective “multi-shot” weapons can be. With famous “multi-shot” firearms like the Colt Revolver; Desert Eagle; FNC Carabrine and AK47 Assault Rifle in the display cabinet, he steps onto the battlefield carrying the relics of an ancient culture.
story.STORY_FLEET_174:
Zach
Not everyone is able to experience traveling to another dimension.
Inside the control room, an unfamiliar star map is projected onto the wall; the humming from particle engines fills the air as does the smell of steel. The unique smell of filtered air... everything lightly brushes the tips of Zach’s every nerve. This is what’s exciting about inter-dimensional traveling, visiting unknown territories, never-before-seen scenery, experiencing lives that used to exist only as glimmers inside imaginations, following the principles of traveling: freeing yourself from the gravity of a planet, freeing yourself from the stresses of real life and releasing your true self!
Study space guidelines and get familiar with the structure of the spaceships by training at the virtual piloting station, giving you a chance to pilot a spaceship for real. Every commander in the Empire Fleet only gets to fight in real wars after years of military training. However, after Zach arrives in this dimensional space, he entered a “special training” course with help from Dexter: he was directly integrated into brain wave training sessions, using special nerve-stimulation-currents to enhance the brain’s reflexes. It was all done under a safe procedure unharmful to the human body, and its result is allowing Zach to master the knowledge that typically takes years in just a matter of months. 
In a short amount of time, Zach has received his certificate to pilot a spaceship, passed the test and become an official commander of the Empire Fleet. “Participating in star wars after learning sufficient space battle knowledge” is one of the guidelines of the contract that Zach signed with Triton Traveling Agency. Everyone is ready, just waiting on the moment to launch.
story.STORY_FLEET_312:
On Christmas 20 years ago, Chris was playing on the swing outside of his house; he refused to head home with his parents who had just returned from a lengthy campaign. Household Interior Cleaning was in progress, he did not wish to see anyone disturb the work of Retrobot, including his parents and himself. 
Chris’ parents were members of the Empire Frontier Campaign Fleet Force. Even though warping technology had advanced to a level that it only takes one year to travel around the Galaxy, the Frontier Campaign Fleet’s mission was much further. Each campaign to the outer Galaxy system would take years and even decades to complete. 
Before embarking on the campaign, for the sake of protecting their son’s safety and taking care of his day-to-day living, Retrobot became Chris’ “Nanny Robot”, and the situation far exceeded their expectations. Compared to the parents that Chris could only see from holographic communication devices, Chris grew ever more affectionate towards Retrobot, the robot who was living beside Chris every day, helping, teaching and playing. 
In fact, the Empire has published countless articles and announcements that it is crucial for parents to care for young children. Household AI is capable of handling all household chores, but it can never replace human love and care. 
Twenty years later, Chris has graduated from the Empire University of Technology. On his thesis: <<Do Robots Have Feelings? A Thesis on the Differences between AI and Humans>>, a few hundred years ago, Robots became the gears of human society. Can this be taken one step further? Can robots become one of us? 
Military AI that was designed based on Retrobot has passed the Empire Science Center’s evaluations. It is ready for mass-production. Chris is looking forward to meeting “him” again – his first childhood friend.
story.STORY_FLEET_307:
“The Frozen Queen was usurped because of her greed. The Crimson Dragonfly has brought “summer warmth” back to the valley. Friends are dancing under the sun once again and it seems they are going to live happily after ever”.
“Okay, that’s the entire story of the Forever Valley, Annie, shall we leave it there and say good-night?” Tyke places his mechanical hand on Annie’s forehead and strokes her hair. The girl’s body is over 40% smaller than other children of her age; her pale, purple-ish skin is fragile like paper; she blinks twice with her bright-eyes to transmit the message “good-night” to Tyke. 
Annie is one of many victims of the “Empire S.S. Bob Leakage” Incident. This incident has been one of the most severe of its kind in the entire history of the Empire. This cargo ship is the largest galactonite transportation ship in the Empire, and when the ship crashed due to “poor handling by intern operators”, billions of tons of galactonite energy fluid leaked into the only planet in this star district that houses life. Immediately, the crude energy fluid emitted deadly radiation whilst simultaneously swallowing energy on the planet - nearly half of the planet became a frozen shell. 
Tyke was the commander in charge of the escort fleet to the cargo ship at the time. He was among the first to respond to the incident. Wearing a protective biohazard suit, he rushed to the surface of the planet with other rescue teams and saved as many survivors as he could by bringing them to facilities under a protection shield. 
But from that point, things just simply did not get better. The victims exposed to the radiation, even though they were transported to a safe zone, were unable to escape death. Their skin and flesh just withered and dropped off as fast as the eye could see; dying in the hands of rescue teams one after another in agony. 
Even the rescue team members may have been infected by the victims’ radiation, not even the high-tech protective suits can guarantee the safety of the rescuers after extensive exposure to radiation. Tyke was one of the first to be infected by second-hand radiation that had to seek medical attention. Fortunately, he has woken from a 67-hour coma. 
Radiation did not deprive him of life, but it did change his body forever. For reasons unexplainable by medical science, Tyke’s stamina and reaction speed has surpassed his previous limits and he is even able to compete with the so-called “prodigy” commanders. He is able to pilot the ships that require extreme-pilot-abilities and accomplish the most challenging battle missions. 
However, in the end, Tyke has chosen to command the only SS-class hospital ship in the Empire Fleet “Crimson Dragonfly”, S.S. Bob’s incident has forever-changed his path in life.
story.STORY_FLEET_171:
Since arriving from the distant Sula Planet, Cryptor has caused a “botanical-fever” throughout the Empire. Who would’ve imagined his spaceship is actually a slow-growing botanical life form? A group of commanders with have great interest in botanical species surrounded Cryptor, hoping to witness a “miracle of Mother Nature.” But Cryptor just stared at his new friends, confused as to what they meant by “spaceship.” “Kira” is his life-long companion. They grew up together, communicated and fought many battles as one, and have always entrusted their lives to each another, . 
Kira’s armor started to flicker intensely; this is its way of communicating to Cryptor that it feels nervous. Cryptor responded in the same way to calm Kira down. Eventually, the naturally-shy Kira gathered its courage and showed its welcome and friendliness to the humans by emitting bright lights, although it made some of the more sheepish ones cry out in surprise. 
According to the analysis in The Human Study, “curiosity” is a unique emotion: simply put, it is the urge to analyze and understand any unknown matters that humans come across. However, we Humans do not have light-emitting organs. We have no known methods to communicate with Kira using this type of “language.” Looks like this “curiosity” will last for a while. 
Hopefully this situation will not affect the current ways of life and battle. Cryptor is an understanding person. Since the Empire revised the Colonization Policy, he is one of the first colonists to be invited to join the Empire Fleet and become a commander.
story.STORY_FLEET_195:
Sima was a harmless, friendly, vegetarian fish, whose only intentions in life being “survive” and “reproduce”. She sat at the bottom of the food chain of the Giant Bird Planet, constantly running from other carnivorous fish and sea birds. Each day, she spent all its time wandering among the giant seaweeds, gathering necessary food to survive the next cold winter.  

One day, her life changed forever. The calm and warm ocean suddenly felt weightless, as if the liquid was nonexistent. She spat out oxygen in order to equalize the pressure, only to be blinded by a bright light. Before passing out, she saw the warm, blue ocean shrinking into the distance, and all she could hear was her persistent heartbeat. 

Her once-proud scales were peeled off one-by-one from her flesh; her flexible spine was replaced with alloy metal. The fish named Sima is dead; all that remain are its brain and nerves, which have been reprogrammed into the central command-core of some kind of mobile armor. 

Inside Dark Lazarus’ brain, countless data is stored along with Sima’s memories. She is no longer a naïve deep sea fish; she is a commander of a space fleet. The burden of armor and electric current means Dark Lazarus can no longer return to her beloved ocean, but instead possesses the power to roam across the galaxy. Is this new power compensation for what the Makers did to her, or is she simply the most terrifying mobile weapon in the galaxy? 

Of course, before commands from the Makers were transmitted into Dark Lazarus’ central-control-module, she still had her freedom. 

Of course, before the Empire, ruler of the Galaxy, is able to decrypt Dark Lazarus’ data bank, mankind should be safe.
story.STORY_FLEET_196:
Since the day she was born, Shamen Queen always wished to control everything within her grasp. Every planet in the Elemental Dimension is beautiful and fertile, like everlasting diamonds. Every person longs for precious things and want to take control of them. 

A person's might is determined by the amount of planets they can control, that’s the ancient law of the Elemental Dimension. 

Tens of thousands of suns and moons have passed, and Shamen Queen has become a formidable warlord. No matter how dangerous missions were (life-and-death situations, dangerously-close explosions from particle cannons blasts, laser attacks falling from the sky like rain, completely-destroyed ship armor), the space around her ship has always flickered elegantly. It purges the unwillingness inside her heart; the scale of planets may make us realize our insignificance, but the rewards to be reaped always make her take the risk and bet with her life. 

At long last, she stands at the top of the Elemental Dimension. Every planet that can be seen with her eyes is engraved with Shamen emblems.  

This violent and aggressive beast can finally calm down and rest upon on her throne, gazing at the fruits of her conquest with beautiful, yet indifferent eyes.
story.STORY_FLEET_316:
“The inferno of the Hell Gate can melt souls; those who pass Hell Gate's trial shall be granted the Crown of Flames”. 

This is the legend of the Hell Gate in the Salamander Star District. According to research on human history, there may be some truth to the majority of legends. As time passes and words get passed from generation to generation, legends only become more and more mythical and eventually become too incredible to believe.

The Hell Gate is an exception. Before the Empire's main fleet was able to penetrate into the deepest space of the Salamander Star District, Goodman and his squadron had already arrived near the Hell Gate under top-secret orders from Empire Fleet Command. The orders were to collect as much data as possible on the Hell Gate, so as to create an effective battle plan for the Empire Fleet warring in the district. 

Goodman did not intend to lose any of his men, but apparently he underestimated the terror of Hell Gate. 

It would be nice to win every war without losing a single soldier; it would  been great that the statue of Peace did not need to be built upon sacrifices and tombs. 

Goodman was on route to complete his mission ahead of schedule. The Empire Fleet could then gain control of the Hell Gate before the war started and thus could avoid confronting the aggressive Star Burners. However, as his squadron approached the Hell Gate, under the scorching heat, many of his men’s ships started to deform, warp and eventually explode. 

He sees the lives of his men as his own, but for the sake of saving the lives of all soldiers, even those “clone soldiers”, he ordered his men to march to death. 

Later, Goodman desperately eyes the radar; he has neither the will nor the ability to issue any more orders, because there are no more ships on the radar to command. His squad has been obliterated.

The infernal heat begins to affect his mind. Goodman has no time to transmit the data back to the Empire Fleet, nor was he able to conclude on any findings that would ensure victory for the Empire. He sends all engines on his ship “Eden” into overdrive and dashes straight into the flames of Hell.
story.STORY_FLEET_317:
On the night before returning to the Empire Fleet, Maximilian reached over for that bottle that kept “jumping” away from him and accidentally knocked it over. The sound of glass shattering was like a lovely symphony to him, the reflections from the glass fragments so colorful and dreamy. After staring trancedly at the ground for some time, he checked to make sure the carpet was not stained by the spilled liquid. 

Lamentably, even if he had guessed the position of the bottle correctly, he still would not have been able to drink even a drop of “Trip of Madness.” 

The Empire Fleet had banned the use of nerve-stimulant drugs such as “Trip of Madness.” During his several years of drifting through space as an interstellar refugee, Maximilian had often purchased this drug from the Goblins, hoping it would stop his reoccurring nightmares and finally allow him to sleep in peace. 

Might and Weakness corrrespond to day and night, respectively. As such, Humans have invented many different ways to illuminate the night, and have even created artificial stars to provide continuous heat and light; but alas, they have never been able to invent a way to eliminate their fear of the dark. 

A fearful past; a regretful past; a shameful past... all are difficult to let go of. 

The old Maximilian used his past as a source of will and encouragement, but that’s also the reason why his past is so difficult to let go of. 

Returning to the Empire Fleet was a decision he made after lengthy, serious consideration. He realized that the path he was on would only lead to self-destruction. Nerve-stimulant drug abuse was the beginning of the end, no doubt. 

Since no one can escape their past, it must be faced head-on and with persistence. The strong are able to wield their might only because of their ability to adjust and adapt, and their resolve to face their pasts. 

Tomorrow will be a new beginning.
story.STORY_FLEET_199:
Is it true that a soft heart cannot be hurt? 

Okto, while watching his 9th sweetheart turn and leave, shed a few drops of green-colored tears from that pair of eyes protruding from his forehead. 

Are all cross-species romances doomed to fail? Okto is from the distant Lancer Planet. On a mission to arrest an interstellar terrorist, he pursued his prey across 32 star systems to Galaxy Empire and terminated the criminal. However, his homing-coordinate-navigator was damaged during the battle and he was unable to return home.  

He traded all of his “tools” for a corner advertisement space in the Galaxy Times, hoping someone would know how to bring him home, but faced only disappointment day after day. Okto lost it all and ended up homeless, until the day he met his first sweetheart. 

What a beautiful girl! She brought Okto home, who was dwelling on top of hover-train carts at the time, and gave him clean water and delicious fish jerky. She brushed him gently and soothed him to sleep. At sunrise the next day, she brought Okto into a different building, waved at him, smiled and left. Who would’ve known that was goodbye? 

The second sweetheart that came into his life unexpectedly: realizing that the first sweetheart would never return, the heart-broken Okto repeatedly struck himself, hoping to relieve his pain. A gentle-voiced girl lead Okto to tour the building. What a kind girl! Okto found something called a “flower,” that he was told human girls love, and wanted to give it to the girl.. but he saw that the girl was taking a furry creature on the exact same tour as the one she just gave Okto. 

Afterwards, he met his third sweetheart, a nurse that took care of him; the fourth sweetheart, a housewife that adopted him; the fifth Sweetheart, a lively neighbor girl...

It is truly sad. Okto has a body softer than any human, but that doesn’t mean his heart is the same way. 

In the end, he fled from his home, away from the “crazy women” and stumbled into the application center of the Empire Fleet. Everyone was surprised to find out that this “creature” was actually a talented commander from an distant planet. 

The Empire helped cover up his unmentionable past: homeless and winding up in a pet shop, then later being sold. The Empire promised to help him find a way to get home, back to Lancer Planet. 

Still not knowing what a set shop is, Okto flies a real spaceship for the first time today. To be honest, using tentacles to control a human spaceship simulator feels awesome!
story.STORY_FLEET_302:
The Empire’s flag has been placed in all corners of the galaxy. The “real” humans in the fleets have become somewhat of a "rare species” amongst clone soldiers, battle machines, and alien liveforms. Now, the creatures from that small blue planet in the Solar system indeed are few and far between when compared with every other lifeform in this vast universe.
According to Empire Law, of all the members in service, battle machines hold the lowest status, as dispensable as cannon fodder. Non-conscious clones come in 3rd place, for they are implanted with nothing other than battle instincts and skills. Conscious clones are placed 2nd, clones of course who are bred from the genes of specially skilled Commanders selected by the Empire. After these Commanders agreed to donate genes, the genes are nurtured into clones and they become the backbone of the battlefield. These conscious clones are in charge of making all decisions which require any sort of analysis or judgement. Finally, human beings and natural alien lifeforms are of the highest status. The Empire does all it can to guarantee their safety.
Whether you like to admit it or not, some sort of hierarchy has always existed either covertly or overtly throughout the history of the Universe.
Besides strategy, Raizer loves and knows much about history. He loves to analyze issues from the perspective of history. In his mind, no matter how far away history is, things which have happened in the past are undoubtedly the best instruments through which we can analyse our existence.
Technically speaking, the hierarchy in Empire fleets is the result of social evolution. The costs of war have to be paid with the sacrifice of battle machines and non conscious clones who are at the bottom of any Empire war.
Raizer belongs to the tiny minority of human beings, actually, the one and only.
Although he enjoys the security and rights of the highest level according to Empire Law, he long ago began to realize that this hierarchy designed purely to fund the costs of war is, essentially, unreasonable and ridiculous.
Leaving battle machines aside, the Empire provides life for a large number of clones but removes their consciousness just to throw them onto the front line. For decision-making during wars,  the Empire collects elites’ genes, nurtures them, and orders them to lead their “LUCKIER” fellow clones to serve the Empire. In Raizer’s view, this hierarchy is much more savage than any Slavery System in the ancient time on Earth.
If there is no human who will speak out about this, then who else will?
It remains a shame that victory horns have long been echoing within Empire territories and victory reports have filled the airwaves. Even when something unreasonable exists, who can really reveal the truth which remains obscured behind victory propaganda and political jargon?
Revolution from ever since has always been difficult. However, with life is evolving, history can always saw early-awaken pioneers fighting, bleeding, and even sacrificing themselves for their revolution.
And Raizer would love to be one.
story.STORY_FLEET_200:
The emerald planet rotates around the Gemini Star slowly in the telescope lense. The cockpit is so quiet that Alfred is only aware of the sound his coarse breathing makes, the result of an injury in his early years. As his chest expands and contracts, his deep breaths sound like an ancient Grandfather Clock in a house of death.
He is well aware that in 10 seconds, this beautiful emerald planet is going to collapse and disappear from the universe.
As sound cannot travel in a vacuum, Alfred imagines just how angry and sad the swangsong of this planet will be. Still, in his cramped cockpit, he can only hear his rhythmic breathing as he watches the planet head to the grave.
It’s not the first time Alfred has carried out orders on a planet-destroying mission. Nothing is more suitable in demonstrating human power in conquering nature than witnessing the destruction of a planet. He can destroy a great natural miracle just by calculating the energy to be used and the weak points to be attacked.
Now after “burying” another planet, this loyal Commander of the Empire, Alfred, orders his spaceship to another battle field.
story.STORY_FLEET_183:
From the first day of his arrival at the Empire fleets, Moracle, a distant cousin of Thantos, has left many Commanders somewhat disappointed, in terms of what they expected him to be knowing that he is a relative of Thantos. No one has ever said that the cousin of a happy-go-lucky baffoon must by definition also be a happy-go-lucky baffoon. Chatting with Thantos is always quite an amicable and pleasing dialogue, yet we should not assume that by extension Moracle is easy-going too.
When he was made aware that Thantos had signed a sales contract lasting 20 galaxy years with some of the most despotic and negligible human beings just to acquire Empire Aerolite Cores, Moracle could not contain his anger, crushing Thantos' shoulder and rendering it immobile for a day or two. However, for Thantos (the descendant of Gaea) this was nothing more than a graze or cut and he smiled with mercy and leniency. Thantos then went on describing the relaxing life he leads in the Empire Fleets and how passionate battles can be.
“Look, just think about it, Moracle, as long as you devote yourself to the fleets for 8 hours, and then go fight when the enemies attack, you can use Aerolite Cores at will! You can even earn human currency. These little people have so many gadgets you’ve never even heard of in the Elemental Dimension!”
Thantos gave Moracle an adorable rubber duck. In return, Moracle kicked this principle-betraying distant cousin back to his spaceship. He then glanced at the rubber duck with a somewhat gentle and unknowing expression.
If that which humans make is all so delicate and lovely but can be exchanged only using human currency, maybe we should have a think about that damned work contract.
story.STORY_FLEET_198:
General Lertz slammed the Peace Treaty down on his desk. Prohibiting self-defense? Cutting the military budget? Disbanding all fleets sent to conquer mankind?? NO! This is an outrageous agreement that only idiots could come up with! This is madness! What cowardly diplomats could agree to such an insulting Treaty? 

The Goblin Planet was severely damaged in a rare particle-storm. Severe resource scarcity has brought great economic depression and unease to the citizens. The monarchy is in jeopardy, and so the King has sent diplomats to negotiate peace with the Humans. This, however, has enraged the top commander of the Goblin Planet Fleet – General Lertz.

What would happen to the soldiers if we signed a Peace Treaty with the Humans? They would be discharged and become normal citizens: doomed to work mundane jobs in factories day after day, losing their battle instincts and their pride as Goblin Fleet soldiers. 

The future of the Goblin Planet looks grim. Lertz dares not imagine the lives of his Goblin brothers after they lay down their weapons. A living nightmare. 

Uneasy citizens, rapidly-depleting resources, economic depression...the Humans are surely orchestrating it all to destroy our Goblin Kingdom! 

The King has signed the Peace Treaty. It looks like all is lost, but a loyal soldier does not give up easily, even when defeat is certain. Lertz will never bow to another species! 

“Then why has Lertz, the last hope for our noble race, joined in the Empire Fleet?” 

“Shhhh..." whispers the General. "My plan is to become an Empire Fleet commander in order infiltrate the command center and dismantle the Fleet from within, thus restoring the pride of our Goblin Kingdom!”
story.STORY_FLEET_320:
Tuck in to some energy beams shot from laser cannons? Chew on space tornados like you would a hard sweet? It is not at all different to how we would consume carbohydrate-rich or protein-rich food and nor is it really scary at all. The Abyss race feeds on pure energy, as do their ships which devour energy like nothing else.
It was a total disaster when the human fleets first encountered the Abyss fleets. No matter how powerful the human weapons were (even those which could instantly emit the same amount of power as a small sun) dealt no damage whatsoever to these black ships which were left completely undamaged viewed through the telescope. That is without even mentioning the carnage caused when the human attacks were absorbed, amplified and then sent back at the Empire Fleet.  
Facing an enemy like this, human hearts were indeed shrouded in fear. 
Dor always maintains hope that humanity will one day rid itself of its fear of the Abyss race. Since the end of the Second Abyss War, after both war-torn humanity and the Abyss had signed the peace treaty, Dor decided to assume the form of a human and join the Empire fleet. As a wise man once said, all humans are fond of good appearances, a good start is half the way to success, smiles are the deadliest weapon in the universe......
However, we suggest that Dor first studies official materials like "Human Morphology", "A hundred meanings of a smile", amongst others. There is usually a gap between subjective expectations and reality: a grey face decorated with an uncompromising, stiff facial expression lacking the softness of human emotion would instill the same fear in people that a zombie horror movie does.
story.STORY_FLEET_175:
A century ago, a report commissioned by the Empire Science Academy pointed out that when a human brain is extremely stimulated or develops to a certain extent, humans gaining a "super power" allowing them to control magnetic fields or alter the particle attributes of other objects would become a possibility. 
To turn said theory of creating super soldiers into reality, scientists once rigorously selected dozens of qualified candidates who held comparatively strong individual magnetic fields from tens of thousands of volunteers, expecting them over time to gain "super powers" with the help of drugs or physical stimulus. The hope was to one day be able to employ them on the battlefield as a special force. However, after a hundred years had passed, not one single candidate had ever demonstrated any power exceeding the normal range of magnetic field strength or magnetic control index, which left the Empire with no other option but announce the failure of this project. Perhaps all the talk of super powers should have been left in all the "crazy scientist" research reports or Sci-fi products, that is, had it not been for the appearance of Penelope.
Penelope's profile is a total blank, she has no prior memories. DNA certification has also failed to ascertain anything about her birth. The first records of her in the Empire Fleet detail her passing out right in front of a laser gun target indicator shooting course being carried out by the 4th fleet. There she lay in an army uniform dated to the last century with no insignia or tags on it. 
Could she be one who passed the "super power" test a century ago? Though the experiment logs were destroyed in an incident and so unverifiable, Penelope's super power is undeniable to the Empire: without using any device, she was able to create a magnetic field to hold off the power of a mega laser gun. Were she to be provided aid in the form of an amplification device, she would even be able to use it in space battles!
The surprise arrival of such a powerful commander exhilarated scientists, once soldiers as powerful as Penelope were acquirable, battlefield casualties could be significantly lowered. However, following research had turned out to be problematic. Scientists had drawn out Penelope's DNA blueprint but failed to apply it in the laboratory, rendering Penelope unique.
To be confined to the lab for research purposes was never Penelope's intention. After having left enough samples and data, she hopped in her ship and headed for the most dangerous battlefield of the Empire. This gentle female commander cares little about her empty memory and super power, what she wants most is to exert her power to protect people. It is perhaps due to her purity that the Gods shined favor upon her a century ago, gifting her, and only her, with the strongest power amongst all the Commanders.
story.STORY_FLEET_318:
Can a promise be kept for eternity?
Phoebe was having a hard time maintaining her relationship with Taylor. Love is something which presents as fragile as a sand castle on beach. If sand is but a fragment of memory, what Phoebe yearned for was to at least have everything etched into the fragments of her memory before all happiness would end.
Time never pauses to halt the aging of lovers, that is except for Phoebe, who remains as youthful as ever. When the rings were exchanged, it was not as if they had not imagined what the future would bring, nor was it that they promised to be with each other forever. But what awaited them when that day really came? Sorrow, agony, depression, even envy itself rose its head and began to covet this sand castle built upon its foundation of love, each brick in the castle its own romantic memory.
With wrinkles scrawled across his forehead and silver threads hanging down, Taylor's deep gentle eyes were obscured from view. Phoebe proposed that they celebrate their anniversary basking in the candle light of the Roman restaurant. To Phoebe's surprise, Taylor turned her invitation, he could seemingly no longer overlook the age disparity between two faces. Over time, they had gone from being the sweet couple who drew looks of envy, to the lecherous old man and the naive young girl.
The following day, with no apparent cause, Taylor was brought down with an illness. On his death bed, as he stroked Phoebe's ever beautiful youthful face with his withered hand, an almost silent sigh escaped from between his lips, followed by an inaudible mumble of words.
After Taylor passed away, the house in which they had lived for 200 years was not sold, Phoebe still lives there as if the other dweller had never left her side. 
Can a promise be kept for eternity? It is a question which can only be answered on one's final day in this world.
story.STORY_FLEET_185:
Just a mention of the one person in the Empire who is more big headed than Dexter and everyone knows who we are talking about. It is of course Geoffrey, a man who spends his time gallivanting around claiming to be a futuristic fighter, boasting that he himself is the supreme problem solver of the Empire. "No matter how big the challenge, I will take it on" is a phrase you often hear coming out of his mouth as he claims to thrive on all kinds of challenges. 
When bored one day, Geoffrey was chatting with some ladies in the rest area on base and an interesting piece of news caught his attention: The Empire had set up a ring in the Matrix cluster for the truest of talents to take on, and as a reward, the final champion would be granted a unique skill!
This challenge order really got Geoffrey's blood boiling, the exquisite food in his mouth turned dull and flavorless and the sound of girls laughter faded into the distance. Geoffrey left the rest area and mounted his vehicle “Thunder”, heading for the Matrix with no care about what the challenges might actually be, or what the unique skill would be. He just simply took a challenge for a challenge and loved the taste of victory.
3 months later, when returning alone to the Empire fleet from the Matrix, unlike the old days, he bragged less about his triumph and had an air of humility about him. He did not broadcast to his fellow Commanders how he had won the challenge, or how powerful Lance’s skill was compared to his comrades, he had become steadier, calmer, a more serious man who would gradually place himself among the best in the Empire.
We may never know what happened to Geoffrey in the Matrix or what skill he was granted, but undoubtedly he grew in power after this experience. For him, this was the best reward.
story.STORY_FLEET_301:
Maggie, a well-known rock star of the Galaxy Empire. The 1/4-exotic species blood in her veins in her has given her a unique appearance, one that makes her even more popular. Her androgynous appearance grants her ability to take on a greater variety of roles and songs to perform. Not surprisingly, her fan base is gigantic. 

The 15th Interstellar Tour has just ended, and Maggie has returned to the Empire with a bounty of useful intelligence. She is much different than Opal and Valarie, who are true musical fanatics: using her rock star identity and the pretense of performance tours, she travels the galaxy and gather strategic intelligence for the Empire. Ensuring the Empire Fleet's advantage across its multiple frontlines requires no small amount of support networks. However, out of all intelligence agents, Maggie is the only one capable of successfully acquiring intelligence in such intricate and aggressive ways. 

Before the next Conquer the Cosmos battle, Maggie lead her team to perform at a star district near the battlefield. Anti-Empire groups set explosives at the performing stage to sabotage Maggie’s performance and ultimately kill her. Suddenly, a giant spaceship arose from beneath the stage, foiling the plan and revealing the entire Anti-Empire terrorist cell. 

Now, everyone realizes that Maggie is not just a spy. She is a critically-acclaimed rock star, an outstanding intelligence agent, and a competent fleet commander with profound knowledge of strategy and combat techniques. 

After that incident, Maggie took a break from performing and returned to the frontlines. No one dares underestimate this ex-rock star, lest they get a taste of her special skill, “Heavy Metal Rhapsody”?
story.STORY_FLEET_315:
A long, fruitless search was a true test of patience and Sally had honestly begun to doubt the existence of the plant she was looking for. In fact, regardless of whether searching for it on ancient earth or in the expanse of the universe, finding it was all but biologically impossible. This delicate quatrefoil composed of red, yellow, blue and white petals which blooms in the desert does, after all, disobey the laws of nature. 
Yet, Sally’s mother nonetheless firmly believed in the existence of the Yimi flower which had long since been etched on their family crest and she held onto the belief that only the most courageous and wisest man in the family could find it. Though there was only mother and daughter, her faith in finding the miraculous Yimi flower never swayed, for the prophecy had foretold that “A girl named “Sally” would once again bring back the flower of miracles and restore the honor of the Yimiers.
After countless arguments, Sally had given up on persuading her mother, it really didn’t matter whether the name “Sally” was chosen after the prophecy was foretold or before the fact. The flower of miracles could only grow out of natural soil, and humanity had searched everywhere within thousands of light years for such a flower - to no avail.   
How cruel would it have been to destroy her mother's one last strand of hope? Once, she traveled to three hundred planets in a year and entrusted friends in the Empire Science Academy with helping her discover genetic combinations. However, each time Sally returned home with fragile, beautiful flowers, her mother would retell her those same heroic stories of the ancestors and the old prophecy, gazing at her with a deep sense of expectation and inspiration that encouraged her to continue searching.
It was perhaps because of aging or excessive expectations that her mother’s mental condition had deteriorated, but searching for the flower of miracles had already become a custom for Sally. She saw flowers in deserts, by lava, in the depths of the sea and nearby strong radiation, all blooming stubbornly in the worst environments. They were all miracles of life. 
Eventually, after the burning star campaign, Sally returned home and was awarded a medal of honor. Her mother, instead of starting her usual inquiries about the flower of miracles, placed a family crest beside Sally’s medal and her eyes were wet with tears.
Seemingly, the legendary flower of miracles really cannot blossom in the Universe, nor it can be born in the laboratory, but is rather destined to be forged by Sally's own hands.
story.STORY_FLEET_314:
Chessiri, are a type of intelligent being which live in the depths of the ocean. They are covered with a pale skin and possess thin bones which provides them with an agile maneuverability in the water. Just as humans cannot live without air, when Chessiri are out of water, they must also wear “water-supply” equipment.
Paccar is a typical Chessiri. As a result of 90%  of its mother planet's surface being covered by ice and sea water, it has acquired every bit of knowledge about the ocean but knows almost nothing about land and space. When humanity first visited the Chessiri planet, with the help of detection equipment, the wonders which lay in the sea unimaginably broadened the horizons of humans; and as for the Chessiri, the arrival of humanity also opened a door through which they were able to observe other worlds. They started to acquire knowledge of the outside world. Is there ice and rock above the ocean? Is there gas above the rocks? Are there other stars? They wonder.
Let’s look back to thousands of years ago, to before the steam age, when humanity knew barely more than them. 
When the diligent Chessiri found out that the “Gas supply” suits which the clumsy humans were wearing turned out to be very nimble through the air, they began to consider sending students to the human world. The thirst for learning and knowledge is of the utmost importance for any intelligent being and its race. This is a universal fact of life which does not just apply to the Chessiri (who have just started reviewing their understanding to the land and space), but something which spurs a relatively developed race like humans to continue learning even more about the vast expanse which is the universe!
story.STORY_FLEET_319: In the Empire fleets, some people choose to be a soldier not because of their ideals but because of fate.The continuation of war produces a large number of interstellar refugees. The point being that regardless of how hard the main star, mainstream media boasts of the Empire’s glory or the war’s necessity to acquire resources and benefits for the Empire, it has only served to fail comforting people in the remote border areas. In those places where the brilliance of imperial glory scarcely reaches, social order has begun to collapse.Like many people living in the depths of the social chasm, Kerom has no Empire citizenship, which means his existence isn't officially recognized by the government. Even if he dies in the fires of war, he won't enter onto any victim list. The origin of Kerom‘s first memory traces back to the lowest deck of a dirty and broken refugee ship, whilst a brood of orphaned children carried by several adults was roaming about in the space. They traveled from planet to planet, doing what they can do for ‘tomorrow’, arduously living at the shattered edge of society.Without incidents, this pattern would probably span his whole life, right until the end.When an unexpected attack occurred, he fell prey to a plot, being lured into a restricted military zone. Yet, by being a sideline spectator, watching the incessant deaths of his deceitful “mates”, he remained indifferent, for he had a history in which he once betrayed a small child for a piece of bread - he was no better himself. It made him think back to the days when he was forced to be the bait or "cannon-fodder" for a half pouch of cubits. Morality and emotion, in his eyes, are as dead grey as ashes that would only be obstacles to survival and should all be disposed of.At last, there was only him.And he was stiffly still, fearing the terrifying plasma mines in this beautiful golden desert.Ironically, on this precipice of life and death, to stay right where he was standing turned out to be his best survival plan.The light of the blazing sun is the source of energy for the growth of everything, but by this point it had already become death itself, draining water from the human body.Just when Kerom was about to plunge into an eternal slumber, a man named Green who is the training instructor of the Empire 4th Fleet special forces found him.
story.STORY_FLEET_313:
Commanders of the Empire fleet must pass through the most rigorous training schedule, regardless of what they will be assigned to do once they pass out (whether it be a joint strike in a campaign, a lone wolf raid, a covert assassination mission or a reconnaissance mission. Every soldier who is going to war must be capable of handling himself in all eventualities, including those which may not be listed above.
 Lyle, is a member of the 'Cloud Panther' force. Though space battles are the most common form of combat in the space age, they are not the only type of battles being waged in the universe. The fleet which Lyle belongs to is an elite force that can execute all manner of operations, as an elite force should be able to do.
 As intel suggests, a species of evil plant, aka 'Demon Spores' are soon to land on the X-33 colony. Although their shells were destroyed by Lyle in the vacuum of space, tens of thousands of spores hidden in the shells have managed to enter the atmosphere of the colony planet. The matured Demon Spores can easily pass through red-hot thermal friction in the air, and even use the heat to accelerate their bloom. Oh, these dreadful outer space demons once caused the Empire huge suffering, but now the Empire has already devised a way to deal with them before they can even try to repeat it.
 Only a moment ago the now dazzling sunshine of planet Eden had been a void of darkness. The light filter on Lyle’s reflective visor has now auto-adjusted. Seeing the shooting stars burn up as they glide through X-33’s orange atmosphere, he turns the ship in the direction of the target, of course after having already sent the local governor an evacuation alert.
story.EX_TUTORIAL_1: Aha, flawlessly completed our objective! Now let's go claim our rewards!
story.EX_TUTORIAL_2: Class Chips are very rare: they can be used to make adjustments to the ship and significantly improve its performance. I can't wait to try them out!
story.EX_TUTORIAL_3: Latest News: the Empire’s Laboratory has just announced that the 'Reshape' function will be deployed in the frontier area! Haha, this means we can strengthen our ships at little cost!
story.EX_TUTORIAL_4: Reshapin is underway, now, please wait a moment until it's finished. After that, all of your ships can be strengthened.
story.STORY_FLEET_324: Faulty information resulted in Joya and her squad finding themselves a perilous situation.By order of the Empire, Joya and her men were entrusted with the task of arresting a group of rambunctious bandits. According to an informant, they were to pass through the Felix Sector as they carried out a secret arms-smuggling deal; the Empire could not allow such illegal activity to take place right under their noses, but they were not expecting to fall into an elaborate trap laid by the villainous bandits.The bandits laughed on, their arrogance bolstered even further by the Imperial Army's blunder. Commanding a fully-outfitted 'Smuggling Fleet,' they ambushed and completely surrounded Joya's forces. Then, using a live video feed, they mocked and insulted the Empire in front of the entire online world, calling Joya's fleet 'pitiful worms who can only act under the orders of the Empire.' This caused a stir in public opinion within the galaxy: if these criminals were already capable of accomplishing acts such as this against the Empire, then who could really guarantee the safety of the common citizenry?Joya could not allow common perception to continue to deteriorate in this way. Her support fleet had been intercepted by these dogs earlier, so there was no help on the way; this time, they could only rely on themselves.The Smuggling Fleet opened fire in earnest; even the most powerful ship could not fend off this onslaught of energy beams for very long. Knowing this, Joya nodded to her crewmen, and resolutely pushed her ship's self-destruct button. The Smuggling ship, full to the brim with live ammunition, was unable to defend itself from Joya's final attack, and was obliterated in the wake of the explosion. Knowing that there was no escape, this was all Joya could do to preserve the honor and dignity of her men.Years later, Joya's clones returned to the front lines once more, each one just as decisive and courageous as their predecessor, and just as willing to confront the forces of evil in the universe.
story.STORY_FLEET_321: When Fearsome Devil was three, his father died a martyr, a hero of the Empire and humanity, but a sinner to his mother and their family.Fearsome Devil seldom recalls his childhood: the intense situation of the frontier has compelled the Empire to invest heavily in war and its relevant technologies; as a result, their pension was small, and the loss of his father devastated his mother to the point of depression and alcoholism. During Fearsome Devil's childhood, he was always dreaming of owning a playland which solely belongs to him, so that he could avoid the daily torment of both his mother’s weeping face and the noisy ridicule of other children.A person's childhood often dictates what he or she will become. Despite having graduated from a military school (which was mainly due to cheap tuition and his mother’s wishes), his childhood desire was still there. In fact, it turned out to be quite influential to Fearsome Devil’s career path as he grew into an adult. Without any hesitation, Fearsome Devil joined the toy industry, and soon became the biggest toy manufacturer on planet Milun. It was the smiles on children’s faces that gave him unfailing solace, and allowed him to temporarily forget the noisy and bothersome toils of daily life.But can a man truly separate his past and present? His mother eventually died from alcoholism. The moment before she was passed away, she placed a medal in Fearsome Devil’s palm. This poor woman, who once held a unforgivable grudge against her husband, now could not help but try to take one last look at her husband’s reflection in their son. Later on, Fearsome Devil was woken up countless times by nightmares, which left him no option but to consider his psychiatrist's advice. That is, to first admit that deep inside his heart, he had hoped that his family would understand him; next, that all of his stubborn and rebellious characteristics originated from feelings of powerlessness in those moments where he would see his mother in tears.To face or acknowledge one's inner flaws and sorrows is relatively simple; the hard part is how to make changes.Running away from his childhood agony, plunging himself into a whimsical wonderland, starting his own career; the mingling of his present work and his past melancholy didn’t just help him outgrow his peers, but also gave him the courage to continue marching on.Fearsome Devil’s toy workshop will continue making model ships for children. Today, as he boards a real ship, wearing uniform armor once more even after graduating from his military school, he stands as tall as his father. Everything is just like a childhood dream once more; suppressed memories begin to resurface.Fate is cyclical: only the one who causes trouble can undo it; only through experiencing what his father had experienced can this son truly understand the weight of being both a hero and a sinner.
story.EX_TUTORIAL_101: Commander, the brand new assistant function is available. You can use it to jump to the frequently used systems now.
story.STORY_FLEET_330: The Empire's 4th fleet is collecting information. Please be patient, commander...
story.STORY_FLEET_334: “Keep away from the Empire's center of authority; only the pure one can endure loneliness.”Worthless iron ores fill every corner of Planet GT-9527. No living creatures, not even a breath of life, can be found on the surface. The only thing that can be found is meteor craters, which are everywhere. It's really just an unremarkable and useless planet similar to billions of other planets throughout the galaxy. In case of the unexpected, the Empire has still arranged a large number of UAVs to standby, hiding in the belt of the planet. Sokolov, security director of royal family, has also built up his base on this planet.The 2nd Abyss War caused the Empire to suffer great losses, but on the other hand, the academy of sciences got a lot of new research materials. The crazy scientists were actually even able to reverse-engineer incomplete energy absorbing technology from the ruins of Abyss Armies. Sokolov used it to build new fleets quickly, even though it would cost a lot of extra Galactonite Energy and Dark Aerosiderites."Humans can betray me, but machines won't."No men, women or children can be found in this cold base, AI are in charge of everything. But to Sokolov, this is just the "top security mode" according to his standards. Although, the Empire AI center is far away from this base, quantum technology is what makes communications possible.Raksha is still sleeping in a deeply frozen cabin.......Sokolov left the base, but he left behind a tiny gem emannating green light that looks as if it just might be an eye...
story.STORY_FLEET_328: "What is the meaning of war?""Recently, I've been waking up from nightmares, to find myself painfully moaning and gasping for breath. These sounds in my dreams are as clear as if I were awake. When I close my eyes, the disgusting pictures play again and again in front of me. But I'm not afraid since I'm a medic. No matter how badly a soldier is injured, as long as he is alive I still have a chance to save him. But I'm worried a lot and have no direction; I've started doubting the meaning, the meaning of everything.""You don't have to save clones, they are just walking, nutrient solution."Louise would once argue with her mentor Natalie, always trying to persuade herself that only natural humans are real humans. But, afterwards her team was sent to participate in a cruel war and she then saw the horrors of war with her own eyes. With her own eyes, she saw deformed human clones thrown into alien zerg's culture pool to be taken apart. Then these clones were woken up from the cultivate cabins only to be forced to take up weapons and continue fighting. When she saw all this for herself with her own eyes, she renounced her previous ideas about clones.After Louise demonstrated her great medical skills, using her "noble" natural human identity to her advantage, she finally got the permission to help heal the wounded human clones. Afterall, every "human" has the right to choose his right to live.No matter how just or righteous the war is claimed to be, these claims are just an elaborate facade which can't cover over the reality of the truth. Who can benefit from a war? Not the citizens, not the soldiers. The vested interest groups always sit in a safe position and play the game on their chessboard. What about the others? They are simply just the chess pieces on the board.
story.STORY_FLEET_345: Perhaps it can be said that a hero must have the ability to make choices decisively at critical moments. After all, it's character that determines fortune, isn't it? But I'm far away from being a hero.In Empire Year-753, Joya and her team were sent to Felix Sector to arrest a group of arms smugglers. At the same time, I was entrusted by Elite Fleet to follow them secretly as secure, backup assurance.You'll never believe what I saw: a huge swarm of Killer Bees! These particular 'Killer Bees' weren't just your ordinary, run-of-the-mill arms smugglers, but it turned out they were a team of doggone "Protector of Truth"! I hurried to turn off the engine and hide my ship in an asteroid belt while Joya and her team were surrounded by hundreds of Killer Bees!A battle is always short: Lock, fire and evacuate... So I thought those Killer Bees would just as before, take off as right after quickly slaughtering, that was until I saw a blazing light spreading from the central part of the battle field. Electromagnetic radiation passed through my body and turned off all electronic devices on my ship.It was my first time to observe the space of the universe without the help of the AR screen. I could see nothing but darkness, and the light was also fading away. My knowledge told me that sound couldn't transmit in the vacuum of outer space, but I was sure I could clearly hear the explosion which happened far away. It was like a beating heart... beating and then gradually turning into silence.Fortunately, I was found by the Support Fleet.Since the rest of the "Protector of Truth" smugglers were on the run in all directions committing crimes, the Empire desperately needed a "Hero" to restore the confidence of our citizens. What could be better than a commander who was both a handsome natural human and had also "destroyed dozens of Killer Bees"?As if overnight, I quickly became the idol for all young men and women and a model example for all Empire soldiers. The moment I was sworn-in to Elite Fleet was displayed over and over again on every screen. At this moment, the Empire became united once again.Although, it's possible the sacrificed hero may come back to the battle field in clone form a few years later from now, the real honor can only be given to a real, natural human...
story.STORY_FLEET_335: Everyone wants to become powerful, but not everyone knows the price, the price to become powerful.The very first time I opened my eyes, I saw a monster with six eyes through the window of the culture cabin. Yes, a monster, it's the only word I can find to describe it. I saw its opened mouth and heard its low roaring. It waved its tentacles unconsciously in the air, or perhaps it was just handling something. I thought that it just might be my mother. But I didn't think so for long as, I was soon afterwards brought to a short and skinny woman in a cold cage. She embraced me quickly and held me tightly towards her so I could suck the warm milk from her droopy breast. I stared into her warm eyes and realized that it was my mother.I missed these goneby days when I would sleep in my mother's arms. She would always murmur gently, "Ursa, Ursa." And I knew the meaning of my name after a long time. In my mother's hometown, Ursa means bear. This kind of animal has sharp teeth and claws but looks simple-minded and clumsy.After the monster with 6 eyes fed me with a kind of red liquid, I developed a high fever and became befuddled. I can still hear the crunching of my bones. I vaguely remember the six-eye monsters yelling in excitement, "The son of inferno! The son of inferno!"Empire Fleet surprise attacked the research institution after that. A six-eye monster was then sent to execute us. It bit off my mother's neck and her blood splattered on my face and into my mouth. It was salty and I thought I had drank something like this before. The six-eye monster approached slowly, but this time I was very conscious. Human skin peeled off, a giant appeared and broke its head easily with tentacles. Empire soldiers' weapons didn't work on me, on the contrary, the soldiers themselves were cut into pieces by reflected laser. I walked lonely and confused, then fell down on the ground suddenly, as if someone had taken all the energy from me.Now I have nothing but the name "Ursa".......
story.STORY_FLEET_347: Star Lord used to be the owner of "Kingdom of Fairy Tales", a toy company on Planet Laney. He designed many toys which was a source of great joy to the local children. Perhaps his unkind face made him look scary, but in fact he was quite a genial guy. Children of Planet Laney always called him "Uncle Big Mouth".Every year, on Christmas Eve, Star Lord would dress as Santa Clause and carry large gift boxes as presents for children. It must have been the happiest day of the year for children on Planet Laney who couldn't afford toys. Whats more, Star Lord was also a children rights activist. He expended himself to fight space pirates and he saved many abducted children. His toy company would also take in war orphans.On the one hand, Star Lord had a great reputation in the world of philanthropy; but on the other hand, space pirates just wanted him dead. In time, they finally found their chance at revenge. In a rescue operation, Star Lord was misled by space pirate's bait to Palle, a constellation 5 light years away from Planet Laney. In the end, the space pirates destroyed Star Lord's toy company by leveling it to the ground by the use of proton canons. When Star Lord finally returned, "Kingdom of Fairy Tales", the flagship building of Planet Laney, had already been burnt to the ground. Smelly children body parts and a half pair of silver goggles were the only things he found in the ruins.Since then, Star Lord has disappeared. Some people say a red ship was found in Elemental Phase which was far far away; another said a blue worm with one eye came into his toy shop; others said... anyway, it doesn't matter, nobody cares about it now. However, it's obvious that space pirates are getting fewer and fewer.
story.STORY_FLEET_360: Originally, Zagoev was simply a strong, smart, brown bear living in the forest of Russian Siberia. He or his fate gradually started to change starting from the the end of the 3rd Cosmos War. During the 3rd Cosmos War, it was the Empire Fleet that got the advantage and almost destroyed Pirate Legion completely. However, Pirate General still managed to escape with the help of an elite pirate protector fleet. They also made off with the most mysterious, most dangerous Cosmos Energy Core from the Empire Conservatory. The escape was in such a rush, that Pirate General had to hide the Cosmos Energy Core in a small corner of the earth called Siberia. He was so confident that he thought the proud Empire Fleet would never believe that the Cosmos Energy Core would ever be hidden on the earth. Soon after, Pirate General and his elite fleet left the earth to build a new base for his new pirate legion. Unfortunately, as he and his fleet approached the distance of 100 light years from the Earth, they encountered the largest black hole geomagnetic storm in the universe. In the blink of an eye, they were completely annihilated, scattered into oblivion along with the secret of the Cosmos Energy Core’s hidden location. The 3rd year after the end of the 3rd Cosmos War, EC918, when Zagoev was out looking for food, he accidentally fell into a cave and passed out. When he woke up, Zagoev discovered that he had completely changed, his brown fur having changed into white hair. “Wait a minute! How is it that I have become a human being?” Due to the effect of the Cosmos Energy Core’s gamma ray, he had mutated! He had many questions, but the only thing he could do at that moment was to look for a way out of the cave. Suddenly, a shiny green stone appeared in front of him. When his hands reached the stone, it jumped right into his chest fixing itself there. Powerful electric signals passed through his body, battle scenes and modern battle strategies all starting playing through his mind. His body became full of power, he then easily jumped right on out of the cave. He found his way back to his brown bear wife and kids, but quite a pity they could’t recognize him at all. At the same time, Empire Headquarters had detected the Cosmos Energy Core signal and immediately dispatched a combat team to earth. Nine years passed. Zagoev graduated from the Empire Conservatory and became the youngest commander to ever be awarded the Silver Medal by the Queen. After graduating, he chose the path of destroying galaxy pirates and defending the peace of the cosmos!

story.STORY_FLEET_590:
In the eastern star region of the Galaxy, the Crimson Flame Star System is renowned for its brilliant civilization and unique artistic style. The core planet of this star region, Hua chen Star, is named for its eternal spring and flourishing flowers. The annual "Galactic Spring Festival" is the grandest celebration in the Crimson Flame Star System, symbolizing reunion and hope. However, the peaceful life came to an abrupt end under the invasion of the Empire.
Chun hua was born into a family of artisans on Hua chen Star, where generations have drawn inspiration from traditional paper-cutting art to craft battle armor combined with high technology. Her parents were the most renowned masters in the Crimson Flame Star System, having created legendary works for countless interstellar rangers. From a young age, Chun hua displayed extraordinary talent, not only inheriting her family's craftsmanship but also harboring a deep longing for interstellar adventure. However, her homeland was reduced to ruins under the Empire's iron heel, and her parents chose to perish with their workshop to protect the family's legacy. Before parting, they entrusted her with the family's last core energy source, the "Crimson Flame Core," and urged her, "No matter how dark the Future may be, you must become the spring of Crimson Flame Star." Carrying her family's legacy, Chun hua donned the final armor her parents crafted for her, the "Crimson Phoenix Shadow," and embarked on a journey across the stars. Her goal was not only revenge but also to find survivors of the Crimson Flame Star System and bring them hope. Chun hua's battle armor, the "Crimson Phoenix Shadow," is the pinnacle of Crimson Flame culture and technology. The armor is primarily red, white, and gold, adorned with paper-cut patterns, exuding the elegance of Eastern aesthetics and the festive spirit of the Spring Festival. The core energy source, the "Crimson Flame Core," contains immense power, capable of unleashing blazing crimson flames in Battle. This power resonates with that of the modified human "Ignis", and perhaps the day they meet will unravel some mysteries.
story.STORY_FLEET_591:
Thousands of years ago, the first life form of the Incubis was born—Ulrich. He was formed from the permafrost and tundra on the planet's surface, absorbing the energy from the planet's core, gradually gaining consciousness and form. However, his awakening was not the end, but the beginning of the planet's life evolution. In his long solitude, Ulrich did not notice another slumbering golden crystal deep within the planet. This crystal, nurtured by the planet's core, absorbed energy and formed a subtle connection with Ulrich's existence.
After Ulrich left the Incubis, the planet fell into deeper silence, the ice fields rapidly expanded, and the cold became increasingly piercing. It was in this desolation that the golden crystal began to awaken. Slowly absorbing the remnants of Ulrich's energy, it gradually awakened and formed consciousness. Amber's body, composed of golden crystal and rock, was entirely different from Ulrich's frosty form. His growth was a long process, moving slowly from the depths of the planet to the surface. When Amber finally broke through the ground, he saw the icy world of the Incubis for the first time. The cold wind blew over his golden body, feeling both familiar and strange—this was his home, yet also his cage. He realized that there had once been another life on the planet, an existence of the same origin as himself. Amber began to roam the planet, trying to explore his origins. He discovered traces left by Ulrich: frost-covered mountains, cracked permafrost, and soul flames scattered across the ice fields. These traces gave Amber an indescribable sense of closeness, and he was certain that the owner of these traces had a profound connection with him. To seek answers, Amber embarked on an interstellar journey, searching for the giant who had once guarded this land in solitude.
