menu.FB_STORY_Desc_101_1: We have crushed those weaklings from the <enemyAlliance> alliance. Brothers, if you see this message just come and reap the points.
menu.FB_STORY_TITLE_101_2: <facebookName> is resisting the attack from <enemyAlliance> alliance
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_101_2: <enemyAlliance> alliance's guys are pushing forward to attack our fortress, who's with me to push them back to hole they came from?
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_101_3: Phase cannons ready, recharge, launch, hit! For our glory, defeat <enemyAlliance>, let's battle until the last moment!
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_101_4: Universe Report! Our alliance is being attacked by <enemyAlliance> in the Conquer the Cosmos campaign, please come and save us now!
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_101_5: It was a piece of cake to defeat <enemyAlliance>'s small ships, this time we will be victorious!
menu.FB_STORY_TITLE_102_1: <facebookName> has already signed up for the Cross Cosmos Competition.
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_102_1: I think I was born as the king of worlds. Perhaps you don't agree, then please allow me to refresh your thoughts with my cannon. I am waiting for you at the Final, till then don't let me hear that you've been finished off by another rookie.
menu.FB_STORY_TITLE_102_2: <facebookName> is inviting you to join the the Cross Cosmos Competition!
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_102_2: We aren't just brothers on the battlefield, but also rivals. Seeing as the Cross Cosmos Competition has started, don't refuse my challenge.
menu.FB_STORY_TITLE_102_3: <facebookName> has joined the Cross Cosmos Competition!
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_102_3: This is a fair platform allowing us to compete and show off our capabilities; yet this is also an unfair platform since I am so formidable, all of you will come crashing down!
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_102_4: A new session of Cross Cosmos Competition has begun, no matter who is my opponent, no one can stop me from taking the galactic throne.
menu.FB_STORY_TITLE_102_5: <facebookName> is inviting you to challenge the strongest commander!
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_102_5: Everyone wants to be the one on top of the universe, I am offering a chance for you to challenge, dare you take it?
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_103_1: Look at this magnificent ship, its lavish equipment and shining galactonite. Yes, <player> is the best! Trust my judgment and make your bet, you'll be amply rewarded.
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_103_2: As the Cross Cosmos Competition gets more and more intense, <player>, a dark horse who I have been observing for some time has already proven himself, trust me, I'm on the money here!
menu.FB_STORY_TITLE_103_3: <facebookName> has cast a valuable vote for <player>
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_103_3: Hey, buddy, come support <player>, he will no doubt be the champion, shh..... don't ask me where I got this info, I have my inner source in the 4th fleet that keeps me posted.
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_103_4: My good mate <player> is now preparing for a key match in the Cross Cosmos Competition, please help me in supporting <player>!
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_105_1: <player> is the Champion of the galaxy, a true hero of the Empire, and will be the flagbearer for all commanders to follow and look up to!
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_105_2: I have to admit that <player> is now more powerful, but eventually I will surpass <player> and become a greater entity!
menu.FB_STORY_TITLE_105_3: <facebookName> believes that <player> is the pride of humanity
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_105_3: Mighty fleet, state-of-art technology and supreme galactonite such a powerful hero is a common source of pride within humanity!
menu.FB_STORY_TITLE_104_1: <facebookName> wishes to share this battle with you!
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_104_1: Each single move is decisive in the duel between masters, though <胜利者> is indeed tactically superior, <失败者> is also worthy of our pity.
menu.FB_STORY_TITLE_104_2: Ultimate duel, come forth as the King
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_104_2: Here comes the ultimate duel of the galaxy! Oh,yeah! Their ships represent the ultimate power of humanity, how incredibly admirable they are!
menu.FB_STORY_TITLE_104_3: <facebookName> nodded in appreciation of this splendid battle.
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_104_3: Look at this battle, what a surprising turning of the tables. Battle ability forms a component part of power, just as formation and luck do.
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_106_2_1: This is an amazing supply station, Cubits, Tech points, Supplies, Equipments.......you can get whatever you can think of, or nothing~
menu.FB_STORY_TITLE_106_2_2: <facebookName>has got double resource rewards in Galaxy Slots.
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_106_2_2: Only double rewards? That’s not generous, I am the one who is going to conquer the universe!
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_106_2_3: People say sharing stories with friends will bring good fortune, no matter whether true or false, I am asking you to test it out with me.
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_106_4_1: Try another round to get more prizes? But I'm Empire Commander, with a lot on my plate, such a small amount of resources aren't worthy of me investing my time and energy.
menu.FB_STORY_TITLE_106_4_2: <facebookName> has won 4x rewards in the Galaxy Slots.
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_106_4_2: It's surprising that I got a '4 times' multiplier reward, although not the highest, it spells out good luck for me!
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_106_4_3: People say the Empire is manipulating the Rewards ratio of the Galaxy Slots. No one has ever seen '8-times' multiplier rewards, is there substance to this rumor?!
menu.FB_STORY_TITLE_106_8_1: <facebookName> has the God of Luck shining upon him.
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_106_8_1: My luck is unstoppable! Finally the supreme rewards from the Galaxy Slots are mine, everything will succumb to my fortune!
menu.FB_STORY_TITLE_106_8_2: <facebookName> got an '8 times' multiplier reward in the Galaxy Slots
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_106_8_2: After a long period of persistence and struggle, countless waiting and trying, I finally got an '8-times' multiplier reward. Don't envy me, I am a legend.
menu.FB_STORY_TITLE_106_8_3: <facebookName> is off to buy a lottery ticket!
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_106_8_3: Hahaha, my luck has already been way beyond what I could have imagined, maybe it is a good time today to buy lottery tickets, perhaps I am the next big winner!
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_107_1: Yes, at last I am an arena victor, what a exciting battle, I am one-step closer to being the Champion of the Arena.
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_107_2: As we are facing an ever-stronger enemy each day that passes, come to the Empire Arena, only true fights can improve the power of your fleet!
menu.FB_STORY_TITLE_107_3: <facebookName> has defeated <player>, and flexed his muscle!
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_107_3: The battle in the arena is already a piece of cake to me, anyone who dares come forth to challenge me, forgive my rudeness, yet your fleet poses no threat to me!
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_108_1: I have advanced to rank <rank> of the Empire Arena, The name - <facebookName> will be listed in the rankings of heroes and this moment will be remembered forever!
menu.FB_STORY_TITLE_108_2: The Arena rank <rank> has been reached! <facebookName> is exalted!
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_108_2: Congrats to me, my friends! I am now at rank <rank> and the new star in the Arena. At last, the countless effort and sweat I have shed has paid off!
menu.FB_STORY_TITLE_108_3: The true power lies in humbleness, <facebookName> has advanced to rank <rank> times in a row.
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_108_3: Oh, I was not aware that I have already been at rank <rank> in the arena? What a surprise, though not a big one, but I do feel slightly excited about it.
menu.FB_STORY_TITLE_109_1: <facebookName> is receiving daily rewards from the Empire.
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_109_1: Want rewards of huge amounts of Cubits and reputation? Come to the arena, once you maintain a certain rank, you can get ample rewards for building your legenday fleet every day.
menu.FB_STORY_TITLE_109_2: <facebookName> will defend the glory of humanity!
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_109_2: This is a testimony to hardwork, the medal of heroism, the honor of a warrior who gains through pain, the Empire will never hesitate to show her generosity to these diligent commanders. And you, have you received your fair share of rewards today?
menu.FB_STORY_TITLE_109_3: <facebookName> is at the pinnacle of the Empire fleet.
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_109_3: Look at what I got today, come participate in the arena, you may get such rewards every day! But note, if you are not strong enough, you will just be an underdog buried in the sand.
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_110_1: Hmm, I have held my grudge against <player> for a long time, and this time I found <player>'s auto-mining ships docking at the mining zone, surely I cannot show any mercy!
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_110_2: <player>, Don't blame me for plundering your mining ships, brother. This is a world dominated by cruel jungle rules, the strong rise up, and the weak perish.
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_110_3: Oh, come on, take it easy, buddy. I understand your sorrow at hearing your Cubits got robbed! But as long as I hold the plunder certificate issued by the government, the Empire will shelter my right to do so. I invite you to rob my ships anytime, but you are so pathetically weak against me it may not be worth it!
menu.FB_STORY_TITLE_111_1: <facebookName> is whipping <player> to make him work harder.
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_111_1: Build our interstellar empire with kindness and harmony? Are you dreaming, this is no fairy tale, <player>, work till you lay flat on the ground, I need you to feed me more Exp and Cubits to enhancing my fleet with!
menu.FB_STORY_TITLE_111_2: <facebookName>has reaped <player>'s planet, now praising the beauty of the space colonization era.
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_111_2: The grand space colonial era has come! Only the truly strong shall stand at the peak of the ecological chain. A guy on planet old Earth once said 'natural selection'. Keep it in mind, <player>, it is indeed the truth of universe.
menu.FB_STORY_TITLE_111_3: <facebookName> wants to build a harmonious galaxy with <player>!
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_111_3: Through tough fights, I have at last conquered another colony, send your pilgrimage to <player>, maybe I will bestow you some Exp and Cubits.
menu.FB_STORY_TITLE_112_1: <facebookName> has branded their name on <player>'s planet
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_112_1: Oh, don't be lazy, you must serve me for 24 hours according to the law, pay up all of your resources, remember that within these 24 hours your planet has been labeled with my name.
menu.FB_STORY_TITLE_112_2: <facebookName> is warning their colony <player> to be quiet
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_112_2: Colonies belong to the rulers? Of course that is not a rumor, you must accept everything I command, if you try anything funny, I will let you taste my phase cannon!
menu.FB_STORY_TITLE_112_3: Advice <player> to give up resistance? <facebookName> unleashed the sarcasm mode!
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_112_3: Don't worry, I'm not like those demons who will rob you of all your resources, but please respect my rules, maybe after 24 hours or so, I will give you some experience or some Cubits, so that you can fix your shabby little ship!
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_113_1: Hey, I have to warn <player> not to provoke me, do not think that colonizing me means free experience every day, one day I'm going to make you pay!
menu.FB_STORY_TITLE_113_2: <facebookName> is using force to tell <player> that they will not be bullied!
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_113_2: My people are being enslaved by <player>, although our strength is insufficient to overthrow the colonial rule, we will make <player> suffer a little!
menu.FB_STORY_TITLE_113_3: After <facebookName> teased <player>, they calmly presented The Rules of Colonization
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_113_3: The all new The Rules of Colonization states, that colonies have the right to attack, rebel, be uncooperative and tease their rulers, I don't think <player> will enjoy ruling over my planet anymore.
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_114_1: Power is the only law of this universe, I defeated ruler <player>, and from now on, I will remain as an independent planet and enjoy all the rights and glory of the Empire!
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_114_2: Don't think I can be bullied like a little lamb, my fleet has destroyed your garrison fleet, take your greedy paws elsewhere <player>, long live independence, long live freedom!
menu.FB_STORY_TITLE_114_3: <facebookName> has finally defeated ruler <player>, and has become an independent planet!
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_114_3: Previous shame is not the reason of the loser, but the momentum of the winner, finally ruler <player> is defeated, starting today, the morning star of the Galaxy will soon rise!
menu.FB_STORY_TITLE_115_1: <facebookName> is studying Empire Physical Research on Timespace
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_115_1: Have you ever heard of "Chaos Quasar"? It is said that inside are the training projections of Commanders from different countries and different space zones; enemies from different times, past, present or future, although knowledge of physics cannot explain it, it nonetheless truly exists!
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_115_2: Oh, must be that crazy old man Dexter, he adjusted the difficulty of Chaos Quasar, and compare to yesterday, the enemy's power has increased by 7.32% today! But this, of course, is not a problem, I remain the ultimate champion!
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_115_3: Who will the next enemies be, is it a Facebook celebrity, or is it the weak me from the past? More powerful enemies and richer rewards are all in the Chaos Quasar, dare you try it?
menu.FB_STORY_TITLE_117_1: <facebookName> wishes to thank all those who helped them!
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_117_1: Fighting in the vast expanse of stars, I have never felt lonely, because I have a group of friends who have accompanied and supported me, let us work together to reshape battleships and challenge more distant stars!
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_117_2: Only when everyone helps each other, can our Alliance grow stronger! Allies, please come and help!
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_117_3: Hey, seen my SOS message? I need more people to help me, don't worry, I will help you reshape your ship to upgrade its HP, because we are war buddies, we are brothers.
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_118_1: Dear <denfencerName>, the safety of <myAlliance>is in your hands, your brothers believe in your strength, <denfencerName> is the best!
menu.FB_STORY_TITLE_118_2: <denfencerName> is now protecting the glory of <myAlliance>!
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_118_2: Conquer the Cosmos is about to begin, <myAlliance>'s best Protector of all time is now in place, if you want to challenge our Alliance, get past <denfencerName> first!
menu.FB_STORY_TITLE_118_3: Under the protection of <denfencerName>, <myAlliance> has nothing to fear!
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_118_3: Congratulations! <denfencerName> has become the Protector of <myAlliance>, our glory is ours to protect, those who invade will perish and our legend will be forged in our blood!
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_119_1: Every little bit helps! Our Alliance will be built by all of us together, I hope that one day I will join my friends in <myAlliance>, standing on top of the universe!
menu.FB_STORY_TITLE_119_2: <facebookName> hopes that more friends will join hands to build the defensive fortress!
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_119_2: Hey, brothers! Can you see if your warehouse has extra Fortress Enhancement Modules? Don't let it gather dust in your warehouse, to build the Asgard Fortress of <myAlliance>, we need more support!
menu.FB_STORY_TITLE_119_3: <facebookName> calls on allies to donate materials!
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_119_3: look at this magnificent Asgard Fortress, it represents the enthusiasm and efforts of all Alliance comrades, bearing witness to our laughter and tears, let us work together to protect the glory of <myAlliance>!
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_120_1: Hey, do you know that <heroName>, legendary Commander of the Imperial fleet, has a secret past? Come and have a look at this story, you may see <heroName> differently afterwards.
menu.FB_STORY_TITLE_120_2: Latest files of <heroName> are finally out!
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_120_2: the 4th fleet's efficiency is horrible, only until recently did they collect detailed files of <heroName>, those who like to read stories, come and check this out!
menu.FB_STORY_Desc_120_3: <heroName>, although it is not what I had imagined, it's still a wonderful story, come and have a look, may it bring some pleasant surprises to you as well?

menu.SAVE_FORMATION_HELP:
Multiple Formation Explanation: 
1. Your equipment, Galactonite can be bound to a formation and saved with it, at the same time, you can edit the names of different formations. 
2. You can separately edit different formation configurations, and choose the formation you want to edit in places such as the fleet interface and Galactonite Center. 
3. The formation used for the first time will automatically become configured as the default formation. 
4. Equipment, Galactonite used in other formations will have the appropriate identificaton in the item's detail, please be careful with actions such as deleting or selling. 
5. If your backpack space is not enough which results in an overflow when switching formations, please deal with these items first.
6. In quick battle events such as Primus Battle, Primus Invasion and Pandora Cluster, players can enter the formation interface to select formation. 
7. If you have more than one Flagship, please tap the Flagship to change. A formation must have only one Flagship.

menu.LEAGUE_HELP:
Galaxy League
1. Galaxy League lets you compete with Commanders from other servers.
2. Each month is one season. The settlement date is the last day of the season, at which time you will not be able to compete, but you will be able to view the rankings and Wall of Honor, exchange items, and so on.
3. After the opening of a new season, your points will be reset and the League coins will be retained for you to spend at any time.
4. To maintain fairness, Paintcoats will have no effect in the League.
5. Neither winning nor losing defense battles will affect points.

menu.TC_HELP_DESC_NEW:
1. How to participate
Players of Lv70 and above can enroll when the sign up entrance opens. When the sign up period ends, players can enter the Pandora Cluster to battle. Players who don't sign up for this season can sign up for the next one.

2. Enemies
The system will group all players automatically based on their Force. Three groups of players with around the same force will be deployed into a Pandora Cluster. Each group represents a camp to contest with another two camps.

3.Areas
There are around 20 available areas in Pandora Cluster to occupy. Occupied areas will provide different rewards.

4. Occupation & Seizure
Occupation: Players entering into a free area will occupy the area.
Garrison: Players entering an ally-occupied area will provide additional defense to the area. The order of defense follows the same chronological order of ally players who entered the area.
Seize an occupied area: Players entering an enemy occupied area without garrison, or 
entering an area by defeating all its defenses, will occupy the area. 

5. Battle Supply
Players have 100 base supply points for joining battles and can't join battles when it reaches 0. Supply points will recover as time passes. Every battle will consume Battle Supply. Players will lose 100 points if the battle is lost.
Every 20 point decrease in supply reduces the max dispatch limit in battle by 1.

6. Battle Log
You can check battle details and replay your last 10 battles during this event.

7. Rewards
When you or your allies occupie an area, each member in the faction will receive rewards for this area.

8. Executive
The player with the most Influence Points within the server occupying the Ruling Star will become the Executive of the Pandora Cluster. 
The Executive is entitled to the highest rewards while the Pandora Cluster is active.
The Executive will be distinguished with a special crown icon in the chat and while marching in the Pandora Cluster.

9. Event
Complete the "Logistics Fleet" and "Beam Me Up" events for maximum rewards.
Event times will be displayed on the timeline.
So that the Empire Fleet can verify battle results, the Space Node should be held for 30 seconds after the event ends.

10. White Hole
White holes will produce rare resources periodically during events. Only the Fleets that are stationed at the White Hole will receive the resources.

11. Dock
If a fleet is stationed at a dock or defending it, the fleet will receive supplies from the Dock.
For the duration of the event, fleets can receive a temporary buff while holding a Dock. The buff will be lost if your fleet is defeated.

12. Headquarters
While stationed at Headquarters, commanders can periodically fire missiles which inflict great damage to all players.

menu.PLANETCRAFT_HELP_INFO:
As far as we know, the Stellar Territory Forest is the greatest within the entire universe. There are numerous galaxies, asteroids and independent planets here. If you want a treasure search exploration, welcome to the Stellar Territory Forest!

1. Each player has 5 FREE occupy chances every day. But one player can only occupy one planet at the same time;
2. You have to pay the price for an invasion to an occupied planet. If you fail to invade, it will become part of the defender's loot. But if you win, the price paid will be returned.
3. If you invade a planet successfully, you can loot some resources from the defender. The loot is stored on the planet;
4. A Defender's loot as well as the output are also stored on the planet. You can harvest them when you evacuate the planet or the occupation countdown is over. If you lose the planet, you can only take some of the resources which are stored on the planet.
5. Each planet can store a limited amount of resources. Once reached, you still have to pay the price for the invasion, but it won't become the defender's loot. The limit doesn't apply to the planet's output.

Wings of Edmonde, the new exploration constellation in Forest of Stellar Territory is now available for a limited time.

1. In Wings of Edmonde, players' solo attack and occupying chances are isolated from the other constellations. Each player has 6 free chances per day and players can join others' fleets without using up a chance.
2. Team system is open to all. Players from the same Alliance can team up for defense or attack. The team leader will have to pay a small amount of Credits to create the fleet.
3. The fleet will be disbanded in the following situations: When it is defeated; When it succeeds in occupying a planet; When the fleet time is over.
4. The team leader will first receive 30% of any loot. Then the rest of the loot will be distributed randomly or equally to all team members (including the team leader).

menu.ARTIFACT_HELP:
As the owner of the greatest ship of the whole universe, Manoinver knows the importance of developing science and technology. So the cabin of the ship "Creator" has become the paradise for all those who want to make a change!

1. Commanders can pay Dark Aerosiderites to Manoinver to upgrade Components. It's said that Dark Aerosiderites can be mined on many planets in the Forest of Stellar Territory.

2. Except for Components which can be found anywhere, Manoinver's collection also includes famous weapon systems, defense systems and strategy systems known to the whole universe. However, only the strongest Commanders are qualified to possess such legendary equipment and change the fate of the universe. Legendary equipment amplifies the effect of Components, and each equipment also has its own unique special effect which can be used to decide the final battle result.

3. If the color of the equipment matches with the slot, the power of the equipment can be furthered; if not, only passive effects can be provided.

4. Benefit from the mechanism of the whole system, each time Commanders upgrade a brand new Component, the equipment will get more powerful.

5. Commanders can sell abandoned equipment to Manoinver in exchange for a certain amount of Dark Aerosiderites.

6. If Commanders are unsatisfied with the result, Manoinver can help to reset to initial stats. But in this case, only some of the consumed Dark Aerosiderites can be returned. Of course, Commanders can spend a certain amount of Credits to use "Perfect Reset" and get all Dark Aerosiderite back.

7. If a Commander has enough resources, we recommended Auto Upgrade which can save a lot of upgrade time. Each Auto Upgrade can only upgrade the current page (Warrior's Power, Sage's Fortune, King's Heart) to the max level.

menu.SPACEWAR_DESC_MINING: The Sophitel area is one of the most important metal mine areas in the Empire. In exchange for Cubits to augment fleets, all Commanders will deploy auto mining ships to the area regardless of how busy they are.
menu.SPACEWAR_DESC_COLONIAL: The Empire encourages competition amongst Commanders, which doesn't only spur them on to make improvements to power, but also directly grants battle experience to Commanders. What else is more exciting than conquering colonies? Just be mindful of this though: be safe and do not overdo it.
menu.SPACEWAR_DESC_WORLDBOSS: 30 years ago, when the Apostles were still humanity's enemy, their ultimate tech "Primus" posed a formidable threat to us. Yet 30 years have passed and this unchained mega beast still adheres to its original settings, periodically invading the Empire.
menu.SPACEWAR_DESC_PRIME_WVE: Hundreds of years ago, after being defeated, the Empire's rival, Barnard Empire withdrew to the remote Andromeda galaxy and founded their Capital of Revenge - Stormrage. Later in time, after those looking for revenge secretly hacked the core technology of Primus, they re-ciphered the code and created many more Primus Class battleships to invade the Empire...
menu.SPACEWAR_DESC_TC: To regulate Empire Fleet occupation and gathering activity on White Hole, the Empire has revised the War Laws of Pandora  Sector; here, you can meet new allies, fight against evenly-matched foes, and seize even more precious resources!
menu.SPACEWAR_DESC_WD: Welcome to the most fierce battlefield in the Galaxy! It's a place where you can declare war against enemies across the entire Galaxy, carve your name onto a planet, and lead your allied troops in a fight for the ultimate glory of this world!
menu.SPACEWAR_DESC_WC: A battle doesn't just mean charging and attacking haphazardly; rather, a successful battle requires a great deal of both sound tactics and careful formation combinations. Employ both your power and wisdom to claim victory, so that people all over the world will cheer you on!

menu.MONTH_CARD_DETAIL:
1. Players can get Credits every day during the period of validity after a Month Card purchase. Different Month Cards will return different amounts of Credits every day. 
2. Players must head to the Month Card interface every day to claim Credits after the purchase; players can claim Free Month Card Credits without purchasing. If a player fails to claim Credits on a certain day, then the Credits for the day will disappear.
3. Players can enjoy either a Bronze Month Card or Silver Month Card bonus at the same time.
4. Players can claim 100 Credits each day from since the time of purchasing the Permanent Card but will not get corresponding Credits immediately as is the case with Month Cards.
5. Event Month Cards will be available occasionally, please keep an eye on the event interface.
menu.REBUILD_NEXT_PAGE_ALERT: Upgrade all current Armor Reshape parts to the max level to unlock the next page.
menu.LABA_DESC:
Galaxy Slot Description
1. Pull the stick and let it go to get items or resources randomly. Each icon represents a reward and icons of different sizes represent different amounts of rewards.
2. If you can get two or three icons of the same type, then you can get more rewards.
3. If the Dexter Coin falls into the bonus slot, then you can get resource rewards as the extra bonus.
4. The extra bonus doesn't apply to item rewards.

menu.MONTH_CARD_DESC_Bronze_Month_Card:
1. Purchase to get 600 Credits immediately and 180 Credits every day during the period of validity. If a player fails to claim Credits on a certain day, then the Credits for that day will disappear.
2. Players who haven't finished the first purchase for 600 Credits before can purchase this Month Card to get corresponding First Purchase Pack. The pack contains 600 Credits and high value items.
menu.MONTH_CARD_DESC_Silver_Month_Card:
1. Purchase to get 1250 Credits immediately and 400 Credits every day during the period of validity. If a player fails to claim Credits on a certain day, then the Credits for that day will disappear.
2. Players who haven't finished the first purchase for 1250 Credits before can purchase this Month Card to get corresponding First Purchase Pack. The pack contains 1250 Credits and high value items.
menu.MONTH_CARD_DESC_Permanent_Card:
1. Purchase to get 100 Credits every day during the period of validity. If a player fails to claim Credits on a certain day, then the Credits for that day will disappear.
2. Players who haven't finished the first purchase for 7000 Credits before can purchase this Month Card to get corresponding First Purchase Pack. The pack contains 7000 Credits and high value items.
menu.MONTH_CARD_DESC_Free_Month_Card: Players can get Free Month Card Credits once every day. If a player fails to claim Credits on a certain day, then the Credits for that day will disappear.
menu.MONTH_CARD_DESC_GOLD_Month_Card:
1. It's only available during event period. Purchase to get 2750 Credits immediately and 500 Credits every day during the period of validity. If a player fails to claim Credits on a certain day, then the Credits for that day will disappear.
2. Players who haven't finished the first purchase for 2750 Credits before can purchase this Month Card to get corresponding First Purchase Pack. The pack contains 2750 Credits and high value items.

Privacy Policy 
Last Updated: 05/2018
You acknowledge that you have read and understood this privacy policy. If you do not agree with this privacy policy, you must not use Tap4Fun Services. If you change your mind in the future, you may withdraw your consent to use of your personal information in accordance with this policy.
At Tap4Fun, we know your privacy is very important to you, so please take the time to carefully read our privacy policy. Our policy is designed to help you understand ：
1、What information do we collect about you；
2、How will we use the information about you;
3、Who do we share your information with;
4、How long do we keep hold of your information;
5、How can I exercise my rights over my information;
6、Dispute Resolution;
7、How will we notify you of changes;
8、Contact Information;
This privacy policy applies to all Tap4Fun services that directly reference or link to this policy, but does not apply to Tap4Fun services that have separate privacy policies that do not incorporate this policy.
SECTION 1：WHERE WE ARE A DATA CONTROLLER
1.The Types of Personal Information We Use
This section describes the different types of personal information we collect and how we collect it. We will collect and use the following information about you:
Information you provide us.
• when you register for the Game (including your nominated nickname,or custom accounts and information we import from your connected social media account (WeChat, Facebook) in order to set up your profile, including your name as it appears on your social media profile and your profile picture);
• when you log-in as a ‘guest’ in order to use the Game (your nickname); and
• when you participate in a survey in the Game (in which case we will process the information you provide to us as part of the survey).
• information you provide when seeking help from us such as your name, telephone number and records of the issues you experience; and
• Billing information, such as your name, payment card number and payment account details;
Information we collect about you.
We automatically collect certain data from you when you use the Game, including your IP address and device information (such as application version, network type, OS) and information regarding your use of the Game, such as date and time stamps of actions. We also collect and store your data each time you interact with us, for example, when you use in-app support to communicate with us.
Information you generate and display in the course of using the Game Services. 
You may provide additional information as part of your profile (such as gender). You may also provide or generate information when you communicate with other users in the Game (e.g., chat log data, chat content).
Data we collect from our partners.
• Data we receive if you link a third party tool with the Service (such as WeChat, Facebook)
• Demographic data (such as to determine the coarse location of your IP address)
• Data to fight fraud (such as refund abuse in games or click fraud in advertising)
• Data from platforms that the games run on (such as to verify payment)
• Data for advertising and analytics purposes, so we can provide you a better Service
Cookies.
We use cookies and other similar technologies (e.g. web beacons, log files, scripts and eTags) (“Cookies”) to enhance your experience using the Services. Cookies are small files which, when placed on your device, enable us to provide certain features and functionality. You have the option to permit installation of such Cookies or subsequently disable them. You may accept all cookies, or instruct the device (in the case of the Game) to provide notice at the time of installation of cookies, or refuse to accept all cookies by adjusting the relevant cookie retention function in your device. However, in the event of your refusal to install cookies, the Game may be unable to operate as designed.
2.How we use your personal information
We will use the information in the following ways:
（1）Nickname，Use：We use this information to create your account for the Game in accordance with your request.
（2）Social Connect Information:WeChat: Open ID, profile photo, alias, gender, region、Facebook: Name, Facebook ID, profile picture，Use：We use this information to: •create your account for the Game in accordance with your request; • share in-game photos on Facebook at your request.
（3）Generated Open ID，Use：We generate this and use this to store your Game data (including level and progress) with your profile.
（4）Game Play Statistics (Level, Score/s)，Use：We use this information to provide you with feedback and information about your gameplay and progress.
（5）IP Address，Use：We use this information to improve our services, including the functionality of the Game.
（6）Device ID, Device Information，Use：We use this information: • to improve our services, including the functionality of the Game; • for security and verification purposes; • identify and address bugs and assess game function for optimisation; and • to combat users registering for multiple accounts.
（7）Advertising ID，Use：If you click on a link that advertises the Game, we store the Advertising ID for that advertisement with your profile.
（8）Chat Data，Use：If you enable chat services (audio or text) then we will process such data in order to deliver your messages to other users.
（9）Transaction Records: payments on Google Play or iOS App Store ，Use：We use this information to maintain a record of your transaction history.
（10）Customer Support Ticket ID & User Communications with Support，Use：We use this information to:• improve our services;• provide troubleshooting such as addressing and remediating technical issues and bugs.
（11）Security-Related Information，Use：We use this information:• for security and verification purposes;•identify and address bugs and assess game function for optimis ation; •solve game crashes and optimise compatibility of devices with the game; and •to combat users registering for multiple accounts.
（12）Survey Information and content of survey responses
analyze, profile, and segment.
In all of the above cases and purposes, we may analyze, profile and segment all collected data.
Legal Basis for Processing
If you are a resident of the European Union, we rely on a number of legal grounds to process information about you. For example, we will process information about you where we have your consent, where we have a legitimate interest to do so, where the processing is necessary for the performance of a contract with you, and where we have a legal obligation to process your information. For example, we rely on our legitimate interests to serve targeted marketing and on contractual necessity to process information when you create an account. To learn more about the legal grounds on which we rely to process your information for any particular purpose, please contact us via the options in Contact & Complaints below.
3.How We Share Your Personal Information
We share your personal information with selected third parties in and outside your country, including:
• other players and users.Social features are a core component of our games. Other players and users may, for example, see your profile data, in-game activities and read the messages you have posted.
• partners working for Tap4Fun.Tap4Fun has partners to perform services for us. These partners process your data only at and according to Tap4Fun´s instructions to provide the Service, such as hosting, player support, advertising, analytics and fraud prevention.
• other companies and public authorities.In order to combat fraud and illegal activity, we may exchange data with other companies and organizations and provide it to public authorities in response to lawful requests.We may also disclose your data based on your consent, to comply with the law or to protect the rights, property or safety of us, our players or others.
• related group companies(Tap4Fun(Hong Kong)Limited., with whom we share your personal information to operate the Game Services;
• law enforcement agencies, public authorities or other judicial bodies and organisations.
• a third party that acquires all or substantially all of us or our business. We will disclose information to a third party in the event that we sell or buy any business or undergo a merger, in which case we will disclose your data to the prospective buyer of such business. We will also disclose information to a third party if we sell, buy, merge or partner with other companies or businesses, or sell some or all of our assets. In such transactions, user information may be among the transferred assets.
4.Data Retention
We will retain your personal information as described below (except if otherwise required to be retained by applicable law).

（1）Nickname，Retention Policy：Stored for the lifetime of your use of the Game (i.e. until account deletion in accordance with your request) and then deleted within 30 days.
（2）Social Connect Information:WeChat，Retention Policy：Stored for the lifetime of your use of the Game (i.e. until account deletion in accordance with your request or you revoke access to your social media account) and then deleted within 30 days. 
（3）Social Connect Information:Facebook，Retention Policy：Stored for the lifetime of your use of the Game, until account deletion in accordance with your request, upon which it will be deleted within 15 days.Where you do not request for account deletion, such data will be retained for 1 year after the Game is shut down, before it is deleted. 
（4）Game Play Statistics (Level, Heroes, Score/s)，Retention Policy：Stored for the lifetime of your use of the Game, until account deletion in accordance with your request, upon which it will be deleted within 15 days. Where you do not request for account deletion, such data will be retained for 1 year after the Game is shut down, before it is deleted. 
（5）Chat Communications (Audio message)，Retention Policy：Stored for 7 days on our servers and deleted automatically upon expiry of such period.
（6）Chat Communications (Text)，Retention Policy：Stored for the lifetime of your use of the Game, until account deletion in accordance with your request, upon which it will be deleted within 7 days. Where you do not request for account deletion, such data will be retained for 1 year after the Game is shut down, before it is deleted. 
（7）OpenID，Retention Policy：Stored for the lifetime of your use of the Game, until account deletion in accordance with your request, upon which it will be deleted within 15 days. Where you do not request for account deletion, such data will be retained for 1 year after the Game is shut down, before it is deleted. 
（8）IP Address，Retention Policy：Stored for the lifetime of your use of the Game, until account deletion in accordance with your request, upon which it will be deleted within 15 days. Where you do not request for account deletion, such data will be retained for 1 year after the Game is shut down, before it is deleted. 
（9）Device ID, Device Information，Retention Policy：Stored for the lifetime of your use of the Game, until account deletion in accordance with your request, upon which it will be deleted within 30 days.Where you do not request for account deletion, such data will be retained for 1 year after the Game is shut down, before it is deleted. 
（10）Advertising ID，Retention Policy：Stored for the lifetime of your use of the Game, until account deletion in accordance with your request, upon which it will be deleted within 15 days. Where you do not request for account deletion, such data will be retained for 1 year after the Game is shut down, before it is deleted. 
（11）Transaction Records，Retention Policy：Stored for the lifetime of your use of the Game (i.e. until account deletion in accordance with your request) and then for the duration of any retention periods for which such data must be retained in order to comply with our legal obligations.
（12）Customer Support Ticket ID & User Communications with Support，Retention Policy：Support data is deleted within 30 days of a lawful request from you for the erasure of such data (see the Erasure section of this privacy policy).
（13）Security-Related Information ，Retention Policy：Stored for the lifetime of your use of the Game, until account deletion in accordance with your request, upon which it will be deleted within 30 days. 
（14）Survey Information，Retention Policy：Stored for: (a) if you provide your email as part of the survey, up to 6 months (in order for us to follow up with you) and then the data is anonymised; or (b) if you do not provide your email as part of the survey, up to 1 month and then the data is anonymised.
Personal Information is kept until the end of its life cycle (as set out in the retention policy above). When destroying personal information, measures will be taken to make the personal information irrecoverable or irreproducible, and electronic files which contain personal information will be deleted permanently using a technical method which makes the files irreproducible.
In the event that the processing and retention period have terminated, but personal information is required to be retained continuously for other reasons including for the purposes as prescribed under applicable laws, the relevant personal information will be stored and maintained separately from other types of personal information. If you require us to destroy your personal information before the end of its life cycle (as set out in the retention policy above), we will destroy your personal information in accordance with local laws.
SECTION 2：YOUR RIGHTS
This section (“Your Rights”) applies to users that are located in the European Economic Area only.
You have certain rights in relation to the personal information we hold about you. Some of these only apply in certain circumstances (as set out in more detail below). We must respond to a request by you to exercise those rights without undue delay and at least within one month (though this may be extended by a further two months in certain circumstances). To exercise any of your rights, please email us at support@tap4fun.com.
1.Access
You have the right to access personal information we hold about you, how we use it, and who we share it with. You can access the personal information you have made available as part of your account by logging into your Game account and by contacting support@tap4fun.com. If you believe we hold any other personal information about you, please email us at support@tap4fun.com.
2.Portability
You have the right to receive a copy of certain personal information we process about you. This comprises any personal information we process on the basis of your consent (e.g., certain survey information) or pursuant to our contract with you , as described in the section “How We Use Your Personal Information”. You have the right to receive this information in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format. You also have the right to request that we transfer that personal information to another party. 
If you wish for us to transfer such personal information to a third party, please ensure you detail that party in your request. Note that we can only do so where it is technically feasible. Please note that we may not be able to provide you with personal information if providing it would interfere with another’s rights (e.g., where providing the personal information we hold about you would reveal information about another person or our trade secrets or intellectual property).
3.Correction
You have the right to correct any personal information held about you that is inaccurate. You can access the personal information you have made available as part of your account by logging into your Game account. If you believe we hold any other personal information about you and that information is inaccurate, please email us at support@tap4fun.com.
4.Erasure
You can delete your account, or remove certain personal information, by logging into your Game account. If there is any other personal information you believe we process that you would like us to erase, please email us atsupport@tap4fun.com.

You may request that we erase the personal information we hold about you in the following circumstances:
• you believe that it is no longer necessary for us to hold such personal information; or
• you believe the personal information we hold about you is being unlawfully processed by us. 

You can also exercise your right to restrict our processing of your personal information (as described below) whilst we consider your request. 

We may need to retain personal information if there are valid grounds under data protection laws for us to do so (e.g., for the defence of legal claims or freedom of expression) but we will let you know if that is the case. Where you have requested that we erase personal information that has been made available publicly on the Game Services and there are grounds for erasure, we will use reasonable steps to try to tell others that are displaying the personal information or providing links to the personal information to erase it too.
5.Restriction of Processing to Storage Only
You have a right to require us to stop processing the personal information we hold about you other than for storage purposes in certain circumstances. Please note, however, that if we stop processing the personal information, we may use it again if there are valid grounds under data protection laws for us to do so (e.g., for the defence of legal claims or for another’s protection). As above, where we agree to stop processing the personal information, we will try to tell any third party to whom we have disclosed the relevant personal information so that they can stop processing it too. 
You may request we stop processing and just store the personal information we hold about you where: 
• you believe the personal information is not accurate for the period it takes for us to verify whether it is accurate;
• you wish to erase the personal information as the processing we are doing is unlawful but you want us to retain the personal information but just store it instead; or 
• you wish to erase the personal information as it is no longer necessary for our purposes but you require it to be stored for the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims.
6.Objection
You have the right to object to our processing of personal information about you. We will consider your request in other circumstances as detailed below by emailing us at support@tap4fun.com .
7.Announcements
We may from time to time send you announcements when we consider it necessary to do so (such as when we temporarily suspend Game access for maintenance, or security, privacy or administrative-related communications). You may not opt-out of these service-related announcements, which are not promotional in nature. 
SECTION 3：MISCELLANEOUS 
1.Information security
We have implemented administrative, physical and technical security measures that are designed to protect your information from loss, theft, misuse, unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration and destruction. You should understand though that, despite our efforts, no security can be guaranteed as impenetrable.
2.Information about children
We do not knowingly collect or solicit personal information from or direct or target interest based advertising to anyone under the age of 16 or knowingly allow such persons to use our Services.If you are under 16, please do not send any information about yourself to us, including your name, address, telephone number, or email address. No one under the age of 16 may provide any personal information. In the event that we learn that we have collected personal information from a child under age 16, we will delete that information as quickly as possible. If you believe that we might have any information from or about a child under the age of 16, please contact us.
3.Links to Sites and Service Operated by Others
Tap4Fun Service may contain links to other sites, applications, and services. Because Tap4Fun does not operate those other sites, applications, and services, we cannot take responsibility for the privacy practices of the entities that operate them. We recommend that you consistently check privacy policies to understand an operator’s practices. As a reminder, this policy describes Tap4Fun’s practices.
4.Changes
Tap4Fun may update this privacy policy from time to time. When we update it, we will revise the "Last Updated" date above. If we make material changes in the way we collect, use, retain or share your personal information, we will notify you by sending you an email at the last email address that you provided us, or by posting notice of the changes on the services covered by this privacy policy.
4.International Transfer
We may transfer information that we collect about you to affiliated entities, or to other third parties across borders and from your country or jurisdiction to other countries or jurisdictions around the world. Please note that these countries and jurisdictions may not have the same data protection laws as your own jurisdiction, and we take steps to ensure adequate safeguards are in place to enable transfer of information and the use and disclosure of information about you, including personal information, as described in this Policy.
5.Contact & Complaints
Questions, comments and requests regarding this policy are welcomed. Please contact us via email at support@tap4fun.com, via phone at 0086-028-83313298, or via regular mail at Tap4Fun Co., Ltd, Attn: Privacy Administrator, Building A3, Tianfu software park, high-tech zone, Chengdu, Sichuan, China.
In the event that you wish to make a complaint about how we process your personal information, please contact us in the first instance at support@tap4fun.comand we will endeavor to deal with your request as soon as possible. This is without prejudice to your right to launch a claim with the data protection authority in the country in which you live or work where you think we have infringed data protection laws.

menu.VOTE_Hero: Looking back on our long journey, we once fought side by side with many heroes, shedding blood on the battlefield and standing together against formidable foes. Yet as time passes and eras change, those once valiant figures have gradually faded from the main stage, their glory sealed in the past. In this first phase of the Event, we have Filtered a selection of heroes who are highly requested by Player as the initial candidates for voting. The heroes who win the vote will unlock an all-new SP-grade form, which will exist as Overthrow from the original heroes and will not affect each other. SP heroes will fully inherit the core skills of their original counterparts, and, based on the results of this Player vote, will gain a new Player-designated exclusive skill, along with a brand-new official exclusive skill, carefully designed to RESHAPE these old warriors in every aspect and help them reclaim their honor and dignity. If Commander have other favorite heroes or suggestions for improvement, we welcome your feedback at any time. We will continue to gather opinions and refine future Event plans. Join the vote now to support your favorite hero and embark on a new beginning together! Once the new SP heroes are released, SP hero parts and related development rewards will be distributed according to each Player’s current rank of the corresponding original hero, helping Commander quickly upgrade and develop their SP heroes.

If Commander have other favorite heroes or suggestions for improvement, we welcome your feedback at any time. We will continue to gather opinions and refine future Event plans. Join the vote now to support your favorite hero and embark on a new beginning together! Once the new SP heroes are released, SP hero parts and related development rewards will be distributed according to each Player’s current rank of the corresponding original hero, helping Commander quickly upgrade and develop their SP heroes.
menu.star_trek_help:
①During the event, commanders will create fleets and head to the Burning Star. During the journey, battles with pirates may occur, resources can be explored in ancient ruins, and supplies can be purchased from the Stellar Merchant using Voyage Commemorative Coins. Additionally, there will be two powerful pirate bosses waiting for your challenge in each star sector. You may also encounter fleets from other players in the Galaxy Empire during your voyage.
②Each Fleet movement requires 10 Voyage Energy and advances 100 AU. Completing events earns you Voyage Commemorative Coins!
③The commander's fleet starts with 500 Voyage Energy. When the Voyage Energy is not at its maximum, 1 point will be restored every 90 seconds. You can also use Voyage Energy Packs to increase your Voyage Energy, which can exceed the maximum limit.
④While sailing, your radar can detect other players within a certain range in your region. You can choose to gift them Voyage Energy Supplies or plunder their Voyage Energy! You may also receive friendly gifts of Voyage Energy Supplies from other players or be plundered... Of course, you can activate your Energy Shield to defend against attacks from other fleets!
⑤You'll encounter 10 different levels of pirates, with higher level pirates being stronger. Defeating higher level pirates will earn you more Voyage Commemorative Coins as rewards! If you encounter difficulties attacking pirates, you can use 50 Voyage Energy to launch a Devastating Blast for a powerful bonus effect!
⑥A mighty pirate leader can be found every 5,000 AU. You can battle these using either Voyage Energy or Conquest Permits. The higher your damage ranking in the pirate leader conquest, the more rewards you can obtain from the Galaxy Empire! There are six special attack heroes divided into two groups, each with a 300% special attack bonus from the Galaxy Empire when fighting against pirate leaders.
⑦You'll always encounter a Stellar Merchant 100 AU before and after defeating a pirate leader. You can also spin the wheel at the Stellar Merchant's location! The merchant will leave once you've made your purchases or the time runs out, after which you can't use the wheel anymore!
⑧In the Stellar Voyage Arena, you'll compete against players of similar strength. You have 5 free challenge attempts per day, and you can purchase additional attempts with credit points or use Voyage Arena Tickets for extra attempts. Successful challenges earn you Courage Points, and the higher your Courage Ranking, the greater the rewards you'll receive!
⑨After the Stellar Voyage ends, the final Stellar Merchant will become available. Use this opportunity to maximize your strength and prepare for the Voyage Apex Wars! Players with a high rank in the Courage Ranking can participate in the Voyage Apex Wars and win massive resources!
⑩ Participate in the event to obtain the new SSS hero - Phoenix!
menu.star_trek_wcEntrance_help:
1. The top 512 players of the Stellar Voyage Arena Courage Ranking are automatically signed up for the Voyage Competition.
2. Each competition comprises three phases: Selections, Group and Finals.
3. The Selections are played in rounds, and you can set up a lineup for each round. Several powerful commanders will be promoted from each round to play in the Round of 32. Competition matchups will be decided by the system. Following the elimination, you can check the results of your battles. Each victory during this phase grants you rewards.
4. Following the Selections, 256 will be promoted to the Group phase and divided into 8 groups. Groups are played as Best of 3 elimination, and each group's champion will be further promoted.
5. Each group's champion gets promoted to the finals, in which the Voyage Competition's winner will ultimately be crowned.
6. All players can use Voyage Competition Coins to show their favorite player their Support in every match held during the Group and Finals phases in an attempt to earn more Voyage Competition Coins.
7. The Round of 32 phase will be played in two rounds over 1 day, with one battle being played every 4 hours. Participants may edit their lineups at any time before a battle begins.
8. The semi-finals and finals are played as Best of 5. The winners will receive the Empire's greatest honor.
9. Neither paintcoat buffs nor Star Alliance buffs from Conquer the Cosmos take effect during the competition.

menu.Flop_help:
Stacking Rewards

I. Prize Zone
1. You can reveal cards in the Prize Zone to get mystery rewards once the event has begun.
2. There are no prerequisites to reveal Prize Zone cards. These rewards reset at 0:00 every day.
II. Raffle Zone
1. Throughout the event, you can unlock the day's Raffle Zone by purchasing any pack. You'll be able to reveal all cards from floor 1 to your currently unlocked floor based on how many consecutive days you've bought packs.
2. You can reveal more cards the higher your VIP, with 1 extra reveal on VIP 5-7, 2 extra on VIP 8-10, and 3 extra on VIP 11-12.
3. Each card you reveal in the Raffle Zone awards 100 Credits and has a chance to grant you a Minor or Grand Prize. Your reward is multiplied based on the rewards for the floor you're on and what type of reward you win.
4. You can reveal more floors the more consecutive days you've purchased daily packs on. Your unlocked Raffle Zone floors reset if you miss a day, and you'll restart back at floor 1.
5. If you purchase a pack on a day but forget to reveal the cards, those Credits will be lost. So don't forget to reveal those cards.

Galaxy Legend
menu.trialField_help:
1. Defeat enemies in the Galaxy Trial to earn plentiful rewards.
2. Give Yvette the items in the event to earn one of two buffs. Combat Ward: Increases your combat capabilities. Cornucopia Boon: Victories grant you a set number of extra rewards.
menu.trialField_battle_help:
1. Completing a stage grants plentiful rewards, with a chance for extra rewards.
2. The Galaxy Trial comprises 10 stages. Completing a stage within 10 rounds unlocks the next one, with each becoming progressively more difficult. Naturally, more difficult stages grant better rewards when cleared.
3. You can select a Combat Ward for combat stat bonuses and a Cornucopia Boon for extra victory rewards in the Blessing menu before each battle. Give event items to Yvette to receive these buffs.
4. You start out with 50 challenges. Your challenges replenish to 50 at 00:00 (UTC) every day. You get no new challenges if you already have 50 or more.
5. Auto Battle: This will automatically challenge the selected stage. The Auto Battle will stop if you run out of Combat Wards, Cornucopia Boons, or challenge attempts.
6. Batch Challenge: This will challenge the selected stage 10 times in a row, with only the current battle being displayed.
7. Neither Combat Wards, Cornucopia Boons, nor challenge attempts are not deducted in case of defeat.
8. Trial Lord  :Stage 11 features the Trial Lord, where players will face a powerful BOSS and can challenge it repeatedly. The BOSS possesses stronger skills and exclusive effects, along with higher damage reduction and a shorter maximum round limit. If you respond correctly or even take advantage of these mechanics, you may find unexpected opportunities to counterattack and deal significant damage to the BOSS! No matter how much damage you deal during the challenge, it will be considered a successful attempt and you will receive corresponding rewards.
9. Highest Damage Leaderboard:Your performance in the Trial Lord battle is tracked by your highest total damage in a single challenge, which updates the live leaderboard. Challenge the boss multiple times to improve your personal best, climb the ranks, and earn better exclusive rewards.
menu.zhuanpan_godlike_birthday10th:
In this universe full of endless possibilities, godlike warriors always stand up in times of crisis, charge into the fray, and defeat the enemy.
To honor these extraordinary heroes, the Galaxy Empire will launch the [Godlike Wheel] during the event. The wheel contains a large number of extraordinary hero parts, which can make your team stronger and conquer every planet with you. Whether you are a brave captain or a veteran cosmic warrior, you can find your own extraordinary path here and show your bravery and determination. Join us and become an extraordinary warrior, creating your own interstellar legend!

Event content:
1. The wheel is divided into a regular wheel and a super wheel. The initial state is the regular wheel, You need to use the Godlike Ticket for this event to participate in the lottery.
2. Click the Lottery button to randomly receive a reward from the Wheel. Click the 10x Lottery button to randomly receive ten times the reward from the Wheel.
3. The 10x Lottery is only available for the Common Wheel.
4. For every 10 times you participate in the Common Wheel lottery, you can participate in the Super Wheel lottery once. There is a chance to obtain parts of godlike heroes in the Super Wheel.
menu.ActivityCommon_rank_help:
1. Vouchers affect your daily ranking, and reset at 0:00 (UTC) daily during the event.
2. Points affect your total ranking, and remain throughout the event.
3. The top 200 players at each day's rank tally will receive a part of the Credits from that day's reward pool.
4. Your daily rank is refreshed in real-time. You need a minimum of 1000 Vouchers to be ranked, with rewards being issued 5 minutes after the daily tally.
5. Any player who enters the Leaderboard can open the daily chest for their daily Leaderboard Gift, even if they end up dropping out.
6. The first player who achieves a certain amount of Apex Leadership Points/Vouchers on the total ranking will retain their superior rank if other players reach those points later on.
7. Rewards for the total ranking are issued after the event.
8. The event results will be displayed for one day after the event ends.
9. Rank changes are all based on the server time.
10. The final interpretation rights of the event belong to the Galaxy Legend team.
11. Point/Voucher acquisition info:
Event Wheel: Spin once to earn 10 points. Spin 10 times in a row to earn 10×10 points.
You receive 5 points for each card you reveal in the Stacking Rewards events.
You receive 30 points for each Starprism you illuminate in the Galaxy Formation event, or 30 points per each total Starprism you illuminate.
You receive 2 points for each victory in the Galaxy Trial event, and 10 * 2 for a 10-battle attack.
You receive 50 points for each pull in the Slots Frenzy event.
You receive 10 points for each pull in the Arcade event.
In the Treasure Hunt event, you will get 10 points for each chest you open.
You receive 10 points for each recruitment in the Potential Chip Recruitment Station
In the current tasks of the Bonus interface, you can claim 5 points as reward of each task. (progress and pass rewards don't count)
Wish Recruitment Event: Recruit once to earn 10 points, and 10 * 10 points for a 10x recruit.
menu.Potential_help:
1. Potential Chip: Equipping a Potential Chip provides additional skill capabilities to the ship.
2. Chip Equipment: Potential Awakening, Potential Breakthrough, and Potential Burst slots unlock at level 10, allowing the equipping of class-specific Potential Chips. Note: The same hero cannot equip two identical Potential Chips.
3. Chip Upgrade: Consume materials to enhance the level of Potential Chips, strengthening the chip's skill capabilities, with a maximum level of 3. Note: Grade A chips cannot be upgraded.
4. Chip Decomposition: Decomposing chips yields materials for upgrading Potential Chips. Decomposing an upgraded chip returns 50% of the materials used for its upgrade. Decomposing an SSS-grade chip additionally grants a Chip Crystal, which can be exchanged for Potential Chips during specific events.
5. Exclusive Chip: Only specific heroes can use this chip.
6. Note: If the skill capabilities provided by the Potential Chip are the same as the hero's own skill effects, they will not stack.

menu.startrekCollection_help_2:
The 12th Anniversary is here—we extend our heartfelt gratitude to all Commanders for another year of your support and companionship. This year, we’ve prepared four brand-new non-Flagship heroes: Ouros, Mu, Karon, and Teda. In this Hero Assemble Event, we’re offering generous rewards to all hero collectors celebrating the 12th Anniversary!

The event is divided into five reward stages. Once you meet the mission requirements, you can claim your rewards for free directly on the event page! You’ll also have the chance to acquire our powerful newly released Rover hero—Ulysses—and her SSS Exclusive Potential Chip!

All players start at Stage 1 upon entering the event page. After fulfilling the current mission requirements and successfully claiming the reward, the event will advance to the next stage. Please note: rewards can only be claimed once, and you cannot return to a previous stage or proceed to the next without claiming the current reward.

First Stage Task: Commanders must own any 1 of the 12th Anniversary heroes. Reward: Ulysses Ship Part * 120
Second Stage Task: Commanders must own any 2 of the 12th Anniversary heroes. Reward: Ulysses Ship Part * 120
Third Stage Task: Commanders must own any 3 of the 12th Anniversary heroes. Reward: Ulysses Ship Part * 120
Fourth Stage Task: Commanders must own all 4 of the 12th Anniversary heroes. Reward: Ulysses Ship Part * 40 + Ulysses SSS Exclusive Potential Chip * 2
Fifth Stage Task: Commanders must augment all 4 of the 12th Anniversary heroes to T Level. Reward: Ulysses Ship Part * 80 + Ulysses SSS Exclusive Potential Chip * 2

You can quickly check your progress by viewing the hero avatars displayed on the event page.
menu.skinlevel_help:
Exterior Upgrade: Upgrading a hero’s exterior grants stronger attributes.
1. Consume the corresponding Exterior Shards and Exterior Tokens to increase the exterior’s level.
2. Higher exterior levels grant greater attribute bonuses.
3. The current maximum exterior level is 5.
4. Some special event exteriors require Simulacrum Exterior Shards for upgrades, which can be obtained from the Exterior Shop.
menu.worldboss_help:
A wave of dark energy sweeps across the galaxy—the Void Lord of the Kuiper Rift has broken free from the shackles of time and space! Under its devastating power, seven colonial stars have been reduced to cosmic dust. The twisted dark energy field renders starship shields as fragile as paper, while stellar energy is recklessly devoured, pushing entire star systems to the brink of collapse.

The Lord draws eternal power from the rift—its quantum shields regenerate infinitely through a supply of dark energy. Attacks from a single fleet are in vain. Only coordinated strikes across multiple fleets can form a deadly closed loop! This is a decisive battle for galactic survival—no legends of lone heroes here, only the grand spectacle of ten thousand starships launching as one. When the light of the closing rift illuminates the starry sea, all participants will be immortalized for their interstellar deeds. This is the power of united civilizations—a monument to victory forged through cooperation!

【Void Rift Boss Gameplay Guide】

1. Event Overview
1) The Void Rift Boss is a server-wide PvE challenge event. Deal damage to the boss and participate in the global ranking to earn generous rewards.
2) All players can join, with a daily limit on challenge attempts. The boss’s HP is shared across the server during the event, and both progress milestones and personal tasks grant rewards. 
3) The final day of the event is for rank display only; combat is unavailable.

2. Gameplay Rules
1) The boss’s HP is shared server-wide, with all players’ damage collectively reducing the total HP. When the boss’s HP reaches certain milestones, all players can claim progress rewards.
2) Once the boss’s HP drops to zero, the “Overkill” phase begins, allowing continued participation for damage and rewards, but no further reduction of boss HP.
3) Training Mode: Practice boss battles unlimited times without consuming attempts or counting towards damage and tasks—perfect for learning boss mechanics.
4) Daily Challenge Attempts: Each day offers a set number of challenge opportunities. Attempts are deducted and rewards granted upon completion. Attempts reset at UTC 00:00 daily and do not accumulate if unused.

3. Environment Details
1) Each Word boss event features special environmental effects that impact certain heroes’ performance:
2) Recommended Heroes: Influenced by the environment, these heroes gain higher damage bonuses when deployed, clearly marked in the preparation interface.
3) Restricted Heroes: Some heroes suffer negative environmental effects, potentially reducing combat ability when deployed. Choose your formation wisely and leverage recommended bonuses for higher scores.
4) Damage Bonus Mechanism: Using recommended heroes in challenges grants extra damage bonuses (stackable, applies only to main formation, not lieutenants). The bonus directly affects final damage. (Bonus damage from this effect counts only towards ranking, not actual boss HP reduction.)

4. Boss Skills & Mechanics
The Void Rift Boss is extremely powerful, possessing multiple special skills that put immense pressure on all players—proceed with caution!
However, by carefully observing the boss’s skill patterns and characteristics, and making strategic use of its mechanics, you can often seize opportunities in the midst of crisis and turn the tide.

5. Reward System
1) In each event, the top 10 contributors will be permanently recorded by the Galaxy Empire, sharing your glory across the server and becoming role models admired by all!
2) Rank rewards: Total damage dealt to the boss determines your global ranking, with generous rank rewards distributed at the end of the event.
3) Server-wide Progress Rewards: Unlock rewards for all participants when the boss’s HP drops to specified milestones. Rewards are highlighted in the progress bar and can be claimed manually.
4) Personal Task Rewards: Earn rewards by accumulating boss challenge attempts. Rewards can be claimed at any time upon meeting the requirements.

6. Event Settlement & Display
1) The final day of the event is for ranking display only—no combat or training is available. You can view rankings, prize pools, and review history. 
2) Rank rewards are distributed after the display period ends; please claim progress and task rewards promptly.

7. Important Notes
Rankings can be viewed permanently for past events.
Join forces with players across the server to defeat the boss, push your limits, and win exclusive honors and luxurious rewards!
menu.outfit_buff_help:

help.KRYPTON_INFO_CHAR_1:
1. High level Galactonite Centers can allow your ships to be equipped with more Galactonite. 

2. Only players Lv. 50 and higher can see all the different kinds of Galactonite in the Laboratory. There are no restrictions in the Advanced Laboratory.

3. A single ship cannot be equipped with more than one of the same type of Galactonite at once.

4. Dual-Attribute Galactonite is considered two different types of Galactonite.

5. You can decompose Galactonite you don’t want in the Laboratory to get Galactonite Energy.

6. Galactonite Energy is used to upgrade Galactonite, which boosts its stats considerably.

7. Galactonite with high star level means higher base skills along with more ability for growth. Currently, R-8 is the highest level Galactonite. 

8. Stay tuned to Galactonite events to better implement your Galactonite resources.
help.KRYPTON_INFO_CHAR_2:
1.Composing Galactonite may increase energy levels. The current energy level is represented by the lights on the side of the reactor.

2.Higher energy levels raise the cost of composing Galactonite, but also provide a greater chance to compose high level Galactonite.

3.Galactonite will fail to compose sometimes. At a low energy level, some Cubits will be refunded after failure. At high energy level, no Cubits will be refunded.

4. Auto Compose:
You can use the Auto Compose function to compose large amounts of Galactonite automatically, at most 30 times, until your Galactonite storage is full or Cubits are depleted. 

5.Auto Decompose
Set a star level and all Galactonite less than or equal to that level will automatically decompose into Galactonite energy. This function will not influence already composed Galactonite

6.Instant Decompose
Set a star level and all Galactonite in your storage less than or equal to that level will decompose into Galactonite energy. This function will not influence your equipped Galactonite.
help.KRYPTON_INFO_CHAR_3:
1.The Advanced Laboratory has zero chance of failing to compose Galactonite because of its enhanced equipment.

2.The highest Galactonite the Advanced Galactonite Lab can make is R-7.

3.The Energy Bar on the right side of the equipment will collect lost energy during composing. Bonus energy can be collected after it has filled up. 

4. Auto Compose:
You can use the Auto Compose function to compose large amounts of Galactonite automatically, at most 30 times, until your Galactonite storage is full or Credits are depleted. 

5.Auto Decompose
Set a star level and all Galactonite less than or equal to that level will decompose into Galactonite energy. This function will not influence already composed Galactonite

6.Instant Decompose
Set a star level and all Galactonite in your storage less than or equal to that level will decompose into Galactonite energy. This function will not influence your equipped Galactonite.

help.TITLE_6: What is Prestige? How is it obtained?
help.CONTENT_6:
Prestige: It can used to increase your Rank, so you can get more daily rewards from the Empire; it can also unlock Form Cells and Flagship skills.

The main source of Prestige:
1. Sending out diplomat Roosevelt;
2. Participating in Infinite Cosmos
3. Defeating a storyline BOSS for the first time
4. Mining
5. Arena daily ranking rewards  
6. Primus ranking rewards  
7. Participating in Cosmic Expedition for your Alliance
