help.CONTENT_11:
The main sources of EXP:
1. Rush story battles can get EXP quickly. Don't forget to donate in the Alliance before that so you can get even more EXP from Rush.
2. Players can participate in story battles, Elite battles, colony, battle training, complete main tasks, and daily tasks to get a lot of EXP.
Note: Players of VIP5 and higher VIP level can skip battles, which can help new players to pass story battles quickly and become more powerful.
help.TITLE_13: What is the attack order in battle? How to attack first?
help.CONTENT_14:
When a ship gets 100 Accumulators in a battle (an accumulator effect will appear) the skill will automatically be used in the next attack.
A ship can get 25 Accumulators after attacking, counter or being attacked (except some special ships, please check the skill descriptions for each ship)
Ships can get more than 100 Accumulators but it will not show. Skills used at this time will be more powerful.

How to increase Accumulators: Equip Galactonites which has an accumulator attribute.
help.CONTENT_15: An important way to get ships is from the Celestial Portal. Pay close attention to the Event interface and you may have a chance to get the latest and most powerful ships.
help.TITLE_16: What are the differences between all the classes?
help.CONTENT_16:
Hero: Physical attack (ATK). Strong in all aspects.
Rover: Physical attack (ATK). Good at debuff and buff skills but weak in defense.
Ranger: Physical attack (ATK). Equal in attack and defense and skilled at dodging.
Protector: Physical attack (ATK). Strong in defense and skilled at blocking but weak in attack.
Striker: Physical attack (ATK). Strong in physical attack and also has a chance to deal critical damage but weak in defense.
Destroyer: Energy attack (E-ATK). Ignores physical defense (DEF) and has a chance to deal critical damage, but very weak in defense.
help.TITLE_19: What does the durability of a ship affect?
help.CONTENT_19:
Ships will lose 1% durability after each primary and elite battle. (Galaxy Servers)
Ships will lose 1% durability after each primary battle. (Except Galaxy Servers)
When a ship's durability is under 50%, the ship's attributes will be reduced.
Players can repair ships in the Construction Yard to recover its durability.
help.TITLE_20: How do I get more ships in formation?
help.CONTENT_20: Higher Prestige levels can unlock more characters for use in battle.The highest number of characters in battle is 5.
help.CONTENT_21:
- How do I obtain a Colony?
You can Colonize players in the Loser and Enemy categories.
Players that you defeat in the Arena will appear in your <Loser> list.
Players that have taken a Colony from you will appear in your Enemy list.
If your current status is “Colonized”, then you cannot attempt to Colonize other players.
Colonizing is limited to a certain amount of attempts each day in accordance to the Rules of Colonization.

- What are the benefits of being a Ruler?
Ruling a Colony will earn a significant amount of experience points (EXP).
A Colony produces EXP according its level. Higher level means more EXP. A Ruler can <Reap> the EXP at any time. Using Credits can increase the rate of EXP accumulation.
A Ruler can also use Command to earn EXP. 
Commanding is limited to a certain amount of attempts each day in accordance to the Rules of Colonization.

- What you can do if you have been Colonized?
If you find yourself in the unfortunate situation of being Colonized, you may attempt to Overthrow the Ruler to gain freedom of your planet.
If the Ruler is too powerful to Overthrow, you can send an SOS to your allies for help in Liberating your planet.
You can also try to Protest when feeling helpless, which also is an effective way to earn EXP.
Protesting is limited to a certain amount of attempts each day in accordance to the Rules of Colonization.
You will also gain EXP for being Colonized.

- Do I lose anything when I have been Colonized?
Colonized players do not suffer any losses, however they will not be able to gain EXP by Colonizing other players.

- Are there any other rules for the Colony System?
1. EXP gained from the Colony System is limited each day for all statuses (Ruler, Colony or Single Planet).
2. To create balance, the Code of Empires stipulates that the level gap between players cannot exceed 15. 
3. Command or Protest actions are limited and have cooldown times before they can be executed again.
help.TITLE_22: What are the advantages of joining an Alliance?  And how can an Alliance be upgraded?
help.CONTENT_22:
What are the advantages of joining an Alliance? 
1. An Alliance can help you to find like-minded allies, with whom you can chat privately
2. Donating to the Alliance once every day can increase your Rush Story Battle EXP acquisition
3. Get 6 Allies together and participate in Cosmic Expedition to get a Prestige reward. 
4. Band together with all of your Allies and take part in the monthly Conquer the Cosmos to win ample Rewards. 

 How do I upgrade my Alliance?
 Alliance will receive 1 Alliance EXP when a member of the Alliance gets 1 prestige.
Alliance will level up when the Alliance EXP reaches a certain amount.
Alliance member limit increases by 1 with every Alliance leveling up.
help.CONTENT_23:
Tap4Fun Chat Rules

1. You are responsible for chat posts originating from your account. It is strongly recommended that you do not share your account or login information with other players or individuals.

2. Respect others at all times. Trolling is not allowed on chat. Arguments should be kept off of world chat and handled through the mail system. Complaints should be directed towards the appropriate recipient via the mail system or by contacting support through the settings tab.

3. NONE of the following content is allowed in world chat and is INAPPROPRIATE: racism, threats, insults, sex, illegal drugs, alcohol, politics, religion, mocking countries or discusiing politics. Due to the diverse group of huamans (both in ethnicity and age) it is important that discussions that could be considered offensive are not carried on in world chat.

4. No swearing, cursing, cheating others to gain their game info, discussing or sharing game exploits or cheats that modify intended gameplay. Any post containing asterisks are considered offensive and should not be used. Using spaces or other methods to circumvent the filter is prohibited.

5. No spam. Spam is defined as anything that breaks the flow of chat and or repeting the same post. This includes, but is not limited to; excessive use of emoji, excessive use of capital letters (entire posts in caps), posting messages in such a length that doing so obstructs others enjoyment of the chat feature. Posting an ad or a message more than once every 5 minutes is considered spam. Any form of post that contains the same message by different league/alliance members is also considered spam.

6. Moderators will be available in the chat. Impersonating or claiming to be a moderator is not allowed. Information from moderators will have a different color than the other players.

7.The use of languages in World Chat on language specific servers is to be used as specified, or otherwise in English.

help.CONTENT_32:
Ship Attributes Guide:
HP: The life points of a ship. The ship will be destroyed if HP reaches 0 during battle. 
Shield: A unique attribute for Protector ships. Shield will take damage before HP. 
ATK: A type of attack. Determines damage inflicted on enemy by normal attack (except for Destroyers). Affects total damage inflicted by S-attack (except for Destroyers). 
DEF: A type of defense, reduces damage taken from physical attacks.
S-ATK: A type of attack. Affects skill damage inflicted on enemy (for all ship types).
S-DEF: A type of defense, reduces damage taken from S-attacks.
E-ATK: A type of attack. Determines the damage inflicted on the enemy from a normal attack (for Destroyers only). Affects total damage inflicted by S-attack (for Destroyers only). 
E-DEF: A type of defense. Reduces damage taken from energy attacks. 
Critical: Increase the chances of inflicting additional damage on enemy during attack. Affects both normal and S-attacks. 
Crit ATK: Increases the amount of damage by this percentage when inflicting critical damage to enemy. 
Anti Crit: Reduces the chances of taking critical damage from enemy attacks. 
Hit Rate: The chance of hitting enemy during normal or S-attacks. 
Dodge: The change of evading enemy attacks (including S-attacks). 
Block: The chance of blocking an enemy attack. If successful in blocking a normal attack, can reduce damage by 50% and counter –attack once with a normal attack. If successful in blocking an S-attack, can reduce damage by 50% only. 
Penetration: Reduces chance of normal and S-attack being blocked by enemy. 
Speed: The fleet with higher speed will attack first. 
Accumulator: The source of energy for ships to launch an S-attack. A ship’s accumulator will increase when being attacked. A ship can launch an S-attack when its accumulator is 100 or higher. If the accumulator is higher than 100 when launching an S-attack, the damage will increase in proportion to the accumulator. Accumulator will become 0 after launching an S-attack. 

Q-Interfere
1. Q-Interfere Based on the particle wave-particle duality, we can change the particle's micro characteristics through an interfering De Broglie wave. Nowadays, our scientists can use technology to change our equipment. As an emerging technology, there are still some questions about reliability. But it will still bring in larger harvests. 
2. Effect Interference materials can have different effects on different types of equipment. 
3. Interference Override Equipment can only be affected by one Q-Interference at a time. Using a new Q-Interference process will negate the effects of a previous Q-Interference. Handle With Care.

Augment：
1. Augment: Enhance your ships with new materials. The attributes of ships can be improved dramatically. The color of Heroes will change when an attribute has been increased to specific levels.
2. Augmentation Materials: Ship augmentations from +1 to +5 require corresponding class chips as materials. For example, Destroyer ships needs Destroyer Chips for augmentation. High level augmentations (+6,+7) require extra special materials: Pandora Power Cores. Augmentations from +8 to +15 require Pandora Power Crystals.
3. Earning Materials: Players of Lv70 and higher can earn different Ship Chips by participating in Pandora Cluster events on Saturdays, Sundays, and Mondays. Players of Lv50 and higher can earn Ship Chips and advanced augmentation materials by participating in the Galaxy League. Following our limited time in-game events will earn you better chances to get advanced materials.
4. Revert: You can recycle some materials by reverting ships. The augmentation level of reverted ships will return to level 0. After reverting, Ship chips will be recycled 100% while Pandora Power Cores and Pandora Power Crystals can only be partially recycled.
5. Augment Success Rate: There's a certain rate of failure for all ship augmentations. When an augmentation fails, 80% of all materials consumed are returned.

Cabin：
As the owner of the greatest ship of the whole universe, Manoinver knows the importance of developing science and technology. So the cabin of the ship "Creator" has become the paradise for all those who want to make a change!
1. Commanders can pay Dark Aerosiderites to Manoinver to upgrade Components. It's said that Dark Aerosiderites can be mined on many planets in the Forest of Stellar Territory.
2. Except for Components which can be found anywhere, Manoinver's collection also includes famous weapon systems, defense systems and strategy systems known to the whole universe. However, only the strongest Commanders are qualified to possess such legendary equipment and change the fate of the universe. Legendary equipment amplifies the effect of Components, and each equipment also has its own unique special effect which can be used to decide the final battle result.
3. If the color of the equipment matches with the slot, the power of the equipment can be furthered; if not, only passive effects can be provided.
4. Benefit from the mechanism of the whole system, each time Commanders upgrade a brand new Component, the equipment will get more powerful.
5. Commanders can sell abandoned equipment to Manoinver in exchange for a certain amount of Dark Aerosiderites.
6. If Commanders are unsatisfied with the result, Manoinver can help to reset to initial stats. But in this case, only some of the consumed Dark Aerosiderites can be returned. Of course, Commanders can spend a certain amount of Credits to use "Perfect Reset" and get all Dark Aerosiderite back.
7. If a Commander has enough resources, we recommended Auto Upgrade which can save a lot of upgrade time. Each Auto Upgrade can only upgrade the current page (Warrior's Power, Sage's Fortune, King's Heart) to the max level.

Breakthrough:
1. Breakthrough: Heroes can use the “Breakthrough” function at Augmentation +15.
2. Breakthrough Effects: New Accumulator effects, new Augmentation levels, and Legendary Equipment of higher star levels can be equipped to the Cabin.
3. New Augmentation Materials: New Augmentation materials are required for the Breakthrough and new Augmentation levels.
4. New Revert Rules: Once the Breakthrough is complete, the first revert will reset the Hero’s Augmentation level to +15. After that, the Hero’s Augmentation level will be reset to +0. Once successfully reverted, all materials will be returned.
help.EMPIRE_COLOSSEUM_RANKING:
Ranking is decided by the score, success rate,and victories respectively.
1. Score: For each 3vs3 battle, if you win the victory and have 6 surviving ships or more, then this will be marked as "perfect" and you will get 5 points; if you win the victory but have less than 6 surviving ships, then this will be marked as a "victory" and you will get 3 points; if you fail, then you will get 1 point.
2. Success Rate = Victories/Total battles 
3. Victory: The current total victories
In the ranking:
1. Players with the highest scores will rank first;
2. Players having the same scores, will then have their ranking determined by whomever has the higher success rate;
3. Players having the same scores and the same success rate, will then have their ranking determined by whomever has less victories.
help.EMPIRE_COLOSSEUM_INSTRUCTION:
1. Empire Colosseum is a strategy 3vs3 system. Only players Lv90 and above can participate in it.
2. In Empire Colosseum, players can choose ships,and  lieutenants from a ship pool which is provided randomly by the system. Players can only choose Flagship and its lieutenant once for the three formations, but players can change the Flagship position and skill in different formations.
3. In Empire Colosseum, all ships are of Lv100 and Augmentation+15, max Tech level and Armor Reshape. For ships of the same class, attribute bonuses from Module, Galactonite, and Manoinver's Cabin are all the same and high-level.
4. During the formation submit, players can change the formation and submit, but only one can be saved finally. The final one includes three formations.
5. When the formation submit is over, players will be randomly be matched for 20 battles. Each one is a 3vs3 battle, and whomever has all ships destroyed first is the loser.
6. Players can enter the Empire Colosseum to check detailed battle reports, battle results and history rankings, after each battle. Recent battle reports of the Top 32 ranking players can also be displayed.
7. Cumulatively win a certain amount of victories every day to get corresponding items and resources as a reward! Unclaimed rewards will be sent to the My Reward interface automatically the next time you enter Empire Colosseum. Don't forget to check!
help.SPACE_STATION_CONTENT: It's a space station filled with amazing and great surprises! Here you can collect Space Patterns and then exchange them for the the rewards that you want. Space Patterns will also appear on Cosmos Passes! Each time you spend a certain amount of Credits or items, you can get 1000 Cubits and a Cosmos Pass as an extra reward. You can also get abundant rewards for making a certain amount of purchases. Notice: Any time you reset the progress in a round of purchase, your unclaimed rewards and unused Space Patterns will disappear.
help.MEDAL_GLORY_ROAD: Here you can get the Glory Medals, which represent the Empire's ultimate honor! You can also have the chance to get Red Medals, the medals of the highest quality here!
help.MEDAL_STORE:
Find different surprises here every day!
Notice: Each appeared item can only be purchased once.
help.MEDAL_RECYCLE:
1. Here you can reset and split the medals which are not equipped. 
2. Only enhanced or upgraded medals which are not equipped can be reset. After the reset, the medal will become Lv.1 and the rank will become 0. You will get back most materials which have been used to enhance and upgrade the medal.
3. After splitting a medal, the medal will disappear and you can get a certain amount of exploits which can be used in Merchant to purchase items. Please note that only purple, golden and red medals can be split. Medals of better quality can provide you with more exploits after being split.
help.MEDAL_LEVEL_UP:
Enhance the medal to boost its stats greatly! Only green and blue medals and medal EXP items can provide EXP for medal enhance.
Please note that upgraded green and blue medals can also provide EXP for medal enhance, but once used as EXP materials, you will not be able to reclaim upgrade materials.
help.MEDAL_RANK_UP: Upgrade the medal to boost its stats greatly! Please note that only medals of Lv.1-4 can be used as upgrade materials. Get a bonus speed stat increase when you upgrade a Red Medal to rank 7 or higher
help.MEDAL_SYSTEM:
The Empire's Holy Land of Honor! Here you can get Glory Medals which represent Empire's ultimate honor! Each medal provides certain bonus effect for your fleet, which will take effect when equipped on your ship!
Glory Medals are very precious, and there are green, blue, purple, golden, red medals (the quality increases from the left to the right). Red Medals are the medals of the highest quality! It’s possible to find and get all medals from Medal Secret. By the way, the mysterious merchant is wandering every corner of the Empire carrying a lot of treasures collected by him. You can always go to the merchant and find your own surprises there!  
Notice: In Medal Reclaim, you can reset your medals. After the reset, the medal will become Lv.1 and the rank will become 0. You will get back some of materials used to enhance and upgrade the medal.
help.MEDAL_GLORY_ACHIEVEMENT:
1. After getting a certain amount of Honor Points (you can consume medals in Medal Archives to get Honor Points), you can activate Achievements here to get great stats bonus which will take effect on all ships;
2. If you have used “Reset” function in Medal Archives, then the obtained Honor Points will be deducted correspondingly. And only the corresponding achievement stats bonus will be obtained with the current Honor Points.
help.MEDAL_BOSS:
1. Here you will get free challenge chances daily (challenge chances refresh at 0:00 UTC). After a successful challenge, you will get tons of items and resources as rewards.
2. You'll also get free refresh chances to change your challenge targets. Get more rewards for successfully challenging a higher-difficulty target. Commander, please select the most appropriate difficulty for you when starting a challenge.
3. Supreme Challenge Coupon: using a Supreme Challenge Coupon to conduct a challenge will not cost you any free challenge chances, but will provide [2]x the item and resource rewards (does not include Luck) if the challenge is successful.
4. Supreme Refresh Coupon: [7]-Star enemies are guaranteed to appear if you use a Supreme Refresh Coupon to change targets.
5. Failed challenges: the used free challenge chance or Supreme Challenge Coupon will not be returned if you fail a challenge.
6. Luck: you will earn Luck corresponding to the star (difficulty) level for each successful challenge. When your Luck is at max, [7]-Star enemies will appear. Except for those spawned using Supreme Refresh Coupons, [7]-Star enemies that appear in any other circumstances will reset your Luck.

help.doubleEleven2023_main_help_describe:
11.11 Shopping Festival Event and Benefits Description:
1) Event Time: 2023-11-11 00:00 UTC ~ 2023-11-20 23:59 UTC
2) The 11.11 Apex Leaderboard event will end at 23:59 UTC on 2023-11-20, with an additional day for display.
3) A new 11.11 Arcade event has been added. Participate in the event to win a large number of Commemorative Coins.
Event Time: 2023-11-11 00:00 UTC ~ 2023-11-20 23:59 UTC
4) During the event, the augmentation success rate for the new hero Tyrone is increased to 100%.
5) During the event, complete daily missions to get additional event-exclusive items - 11.11 Scissors and 11.11 Game Coins. You can get bonus rewards after completing the day's event missions by going to the Calendar interface.
6) During the event, VIP players can claim extra rewards every day on the 11.11 event main interface. The higher the VIP level, the richer the rewards!
7) During the event, players who obtain Commander Theel:
The number of Mystery Copper Eggs obtained will be multiplied by 3, and you will also get additional 11.11 Commemorative Coins. The higher the modification level, the more commemorative coins you will get;
Players who obtain Theel, in the last 4 days of the 11.11 Shopping Festival Event, after participating in the Military Academy for the first time each day:
a) If Theel's modification level is 1-15: You can get an additional Lieutenant Gift Box;
b) If Theel's modification level is T-T2: You can get an additional 2 Lieutenant Gift Boxes;
c) If Theel's modification level is T3: You can get an additional 3 Lieutenant Gift Boxes;
8) During the event, complete the Galaxy Trial to randomly obtain 11.11 event items and other valuable rewards.
Ordinary Gift Bag: get up to 180 for free daily.
Exquisite Gift Bag: get up to 72 for free daily.
Luxury Gift Bag: get up to 27 for free daily.
Magnificent Gift Bag: get up to 6 for free daily.
(One Magnificent Gift Bag is guaranteed per 20 sweeps in the Galaxy Trial. Players can get up to 6 per day.)
9) During the event, players can get additional rewards from the day's first five occupations in Forest of Stellar Territory. Get [20x 11.11 Commemorative Coin] per occupation.
During the event, players can get additional rewards from the day's first five invasions in Forest of Stellar Territory. Get [30x 11.11 Commemorative Coin] per invasion.
During the event, players can get additional rewards from the day's first five mining. Get [20x 11.11 Commemorative Coin] per mining.
During the event, players can get additional rewards from the day's first five plunders. Get [30x 11.11 Commemorative Coin] per plunder.

help.ms_choose_hero_help:
Hero's class, quality, and augmentation level all vary, providing different levels of bonuses to the cabins.

A hero's class directly affects their compatibility with specific cabins, and each cabin has a class that fits best:
Command Cabin: Flagship
Weapon Cabin: Striker
Energy Cabin: Destroyer
Armor Shell: Protector
Shield: Rover
Cockpit: Ranger
help.ms_cabin_help:
Cabins: Cabins can be upgraded, and the higher the cabin level, the stronger its attributes. Cabin attributes directly affect the overall attributes of the Mothership. Deploying heroes can enhance the cabin's stats bonus.

Weapon Cabin: The mothership comes with one weapon that cannot be replaced. Additionally, the weapon bay can be equipped with two extra weapons. Weapons can be upgraded by consuming materials, and different weapon upgrades will bring different effect bonuses.

The corresponding attributes for each cabin are as follows:
Command Cabin: Durability
Weapon Cabin: Firepower Attack
Energy Cabin: E-ATK
Armor Shell: Armor
Shield: Shield
Cockpit: Speed
help.ms_fleet_help:
Energy: Energy can be allocated to each cabin. The more energy allocated to a cabin, the higher the effectiveness of that cabin's attributes. The higher the star level of the Mothership, the more energy available for allocation.

Fleets: A fleet can deploy up to three Motherships. To participate in battles, a Mothership must be deployed in the Armada slot.

Fuel: Fuel is the power source for Motherships, and each battle consumes fuel. Fuel can automatically regenerate, but automatic regeneration will pause when the fuel is full. Items can also be used to quickly replenish fuel.

Cabins: Cabins can be upgraded, and the higher the cabin level, the stronger its attributes. Cabin attributes directly affect the overall attributes of the Mothership. Deploying heroes can enhance the cabin's stats bonus.
Cabin attributes are as follows:
Command Cabin: Durability
Weapon Cabin: Firepower Attack
Energy Cabin: E-ATK
Armor Shell: Armor
Shield: Shield
Cockpit: Speed
help.ms_pve_levels_battle_help:
1. Gameplay Instructions
(1) Assemble your Fleets and challenge the Sector Stages. Each challenge will cost 15 Fuel from each Mothership.(Fuel is consumed separately for each Mothership).
(2) Winning Battles will grant a large amount of Mothership EXP, which can be used to level up the Mothership. Clearing a Stage for the first time will reward you with Cabin Cores and Interstellar Coins.
(3) Elite Stages are more difficult but offer richer Rewards.
Mothership Win-Loss Rules Explanation:
(1) Victory Condition: The player wins the match by defeating the enemy Armada within 8 rounds.
(2) Defeat Condition: The match is considered lost if the player's Armada is defeated by the enemy within 8 rounds.
(3) Draw Condition: If both the player's Armada and the enemy Armada are still alive after 8 rounds, the match is considered a draw.
Notes: The Armada is positioned in the center in the battle interface.
help.ms_system_help:
A total of 5 Fleets can be deployed.
Select a Fleet and Mothership to enter the detailed deploy interface for the related Mothership.
help.ms_training_help:
Mothership Level: Upgrade by consuming mothership materials. The mothership level will directly affect the maximum level of all cabins.

Mothership Star Level: The initial star level of the mothership is Gold Star, which can be upgraded to Orange Star. Star Increase requires consuming the same type of mothership. Different qualities of motherships correspond to different numbers of star levels. The number of mothership star levels determines the number of times it can be upgraded to Orange Star: a 1-Star mothership can only be upgraded to Orange Star once; a 2-Star mothership can be upgraded to Orange Star twice; a 5-Star mothership can be upgraded to Orange Star five times. The number of Orange Stars on the mothership will affect the total amount of energy that can be allocated.
Note: If the number of motherships selected during the Star Increase process exceeds the required amount, the excess motherships will not be returned.

Mothership Reset: After resetting, all materials consumed to upgrade the mothership to the current level and the current Orange Star, and all materials consumed to upgrade all cabins to the current level will be returned. The mothership level, mothership star level, and all cabin levels will revert to their initial state. If there are weapons equipped in the weapon cabin, they will be automatically unequipped during the reset (excluding the mothership's own weapons).

Mothership Decomposition: After decomposition, the mothership will disappear, and the mothership's own weapons, equipped weapons, all materials consumed to upgrade the mothership to the current level, all materials consumed to upgrade the mothership to the current Orange Star, and all materials consumed to upgrade all cabins to the current level will be returned.
Note: There is a limit to the number of weapons obtained from decomposition. When the limit is reached, the obtained weapons will be converted into mothership tokens. Tokens can be exchanged for items in the token shop.

help.ms_season_desc:
Mothership season system:

1. The first season will last 45 days, with 42 days of main competition and 3 days of settlement; the duration of subsequent seasons will be adjusted based on feedback.
2. A new season will begin after the current season's settlement period. In the new season, the commander's game progress and rankings will be partially reset.
3. At each season's conclusion, we will gather feedback and analyze data to implement ongoing adjustments and improvements. Each season will introduce new content and experiences, including potential balance changes. We encourage commanders to share your valuable insights and suggestions.

Season Rules Explanation:

(a) Season Time
(1) For the season end time, please pay attention to the countdown on the event page.
(2) For the start time of the new season, please refer to the event time description in the update notice.

(b) Data Processing
The commander's various data will be processed accordingly when entering the new season.

The following data in the Mothership system will be retained in the new season, including but not limited to:
(1) Mothership and Weapons: The mothership itself, the star level of the mothership's star upgrade, and the weapons already owned.
(2) Items: Consumable items used for mothership draws.

Apart from the data retained above, all other Mothership system data will be reset at the start of the new season, including but not limited to:
(1) Development Data: Mothership Level, Weapon Level
(2) Related Consumable Items: Weapon Essence, Cabin Core, Interstellar Coins
(3) Formation Data: Mothership formation, energy point allocation, assigned crews and their skill choice, mothership weapon configurations
(4) Stage Data: Overall Progress of Stellar Exploration (PVE), including Records of normal stage completions, records of first kill rewards for normal stages, records of elite stage completions, and records of first kill rewards for elite stages.
(5) Arena Data: Formation Data, Obtained Military Awards and Points
(6) Mothership Missions: All Progress and Rewards. Please remember to CLAIM the corresponding rewards in time before the reset.

help.redpacket_help:
1. Distribution & Collection: Players can use the "Red Packet" item in their inventory to distribute Red Packets. Other players who claim them will receive a random amount of Credits. 
2. Red Packet Resources: Distributed Red Packets contain a fixed number of shares and total Credits, and do not deduct Credits from the sender. 
3. Distribution Channel: When distributing, you can choose to post in [Alliance Channel], [World Channel], or [War Channel]. After posting, all players in the selected channel can claim the Red Packet. 
4. Claim Limit: Each Red Packet can only be claimed once per player. 
5. Validity Period: Red Packets are valid for 24 hours. Unclaimed Red Packets will expire, and any remaining Credits will be reclaimed by the system. 
6. Daily Claim Limit: There is a daily limit on the number of each type of Red Packet a player can successfully claim: 
Normal Red Packet: Up to 20 per day 
Advanced Red Packet: Up to 10 per day 
Deluxe Red Packet: Up to 5 per day 
7. Item Validity: The Red Packet item itself is permanently valid with no usage time limit.

help.alliance_box_help:
1. Event Overview
During the event period, participate in [Galaxy Trial] to accumulate [Alliance Gift Boxes] for your Alliance. After the event ends, the system will distribute rewards to eligible players according to specific rules.
All times listed below are in UTC.
2. Event Phases and Timeline
Contribution Phase: UTC 2026-07-21 00:00~2026-07-30 23:59.
During this period, players may contribute to accumulate gift boxes for their Alliance.
Reward Display & Claim Phase: UTC 2026-07-31 00:00~2026-08-04 23:59.
Players may view their final reward and manually claim it during this period.
3. Eligibility and Contribution Mechanics
Basic Eligibility: Players must join a valid Alliance during the Contribution Phase.
Contribution Action: Each successful completion of [Galaxy Trial] (via manual battle or sweep) during the Contribution Phase grants a base chance to earn 1 [Alliance Gift Box] for the player's current Alliance.
Drop Bonus: The base drop chance is influenced by the current Alliance's level—higher Alliance levels increase the drop chance for all members.
Progress Tracking: Players can view their Alliance's total accumulated [Alliance Gift Boxes] in real time via the event interface.
Progress Notification: Upon first login each day, the system broadcasts the current total number of gift boxes in the player's Alliance channel.
Reward Allocation Logic:
Eligibility Lock Time: Set at UTC 2026-07-30 23:59 (end of Contribution Phase).
Eligibility Check:
Players must belong to an Alliance at the lock time to qualify for rewards.
Players not in any Alliance at the lock time receive no rewards.
Reward Source: Eligible players receive rewards exclusively from the public reward pool of the Alliance they belonged to at the lock time.
Reward Quantity: Each eligible player receives a number of [Alliance Gift Boxes] equal to the total in their Alliance's public pool at the end of the Contribution Phase (UTC 2026-07-30 23:59).
Fairness Principle: Reward quantity is unrelated to individual contribution count. All qualified members of the same Alliance at lock time receive identical rewards.
Alliance Change Note: If a player changed Alliances during the Contribution Phase, their final reward depends solely on the Alliance they were in at lock time, regardless of prior contributions.
4. Reward Claim Method
During the Reward Display & Claim Phase (UTC 2026-07-31~2026-08-04), eligible players must actively enter the in-game event interface and click the "Claim" button to receive their rewards.
5. Additional Notes
Data Finalization: All data (including total gift boxes, individual contributions, and final eligibility) are based solely on server records.
Time Zone Notice: All times mentioned in this event are in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

help.FIFA2026_activity_rules:
1. Event Period
June 10 – July 19, 2026 (UTC)

2. Event Overview
During the World Cup, use Prediction Tickets via the event interface to forecast match outcomes.
Earn Points and Betting Coins based on your predictions—redeemable for exclusive rewards.

3. Core Gameplay
1) Obtain Prediction Items
World Cup Prediction Ticket: Used to submit match predictions.
Ways to obtain:
a. Earned for free by completing designated tasks (login, top-up, consumption, etc.);
b. All packs purchased during the World Cup event include bonus Prediction Tickets.
Emergency Recall Voucher: Purchasable with Credit Points; allows you to cancel a submitted prediction (not usable within 1 hour before kickoff).

2) Submit Predictions
In the event interface, select a match that hasn’t started and begins in over 1 hour.
Choose your predicted outcome (Win / Loss / Draw).
Enter the number of Prediction Tickets and submit.

3) Prediction Status
Unpredicted: No prediction submitted for this match.
Recallable: Prediction submitted but match not started; can be canceled using an Emergency Recall Voucher.
Locked: Within 1 hour of kickoff—prediction cannot be changed.
Settled: Match concluded; system has calculated and awarded Points.

4) Points & Rewards
Correct Prediction: +10 Points per Prediction Ticket.
Betting Coin: 1 Coin awarded per Point earned; redeemable for items in the World Cup Shop.
Leaderboard Rewards: Additional prizes awarded post-event based on Points ranking.

5) Global Prediction Stats
View server-wide prediction data:
Group Stage: Shows percentage distribution of tickets for “Team A Win,” “Draw,” and “Team B Win.”
Knockout Stage: Shows percentage for “Team A Win” vs. “Team B Win.”

6) Settlement Rules
Match results will be updated within 24 hours after the match ends.
In knockout stages, draws are resolved by penalty shootout results.

4. Notes
For Round of 32 and later knockout matches, teams will display as “TBD” until fixtures are confirmed.
Predictions lock 1 hour before kickoff and cannot be modified.
Ensure all available rewards are claimed before the event ends.
